english: Heavy summer storms arrive fast. Dig channels along the slope (swales) and small ponds before the rains start in August or September, so the water soaks in instead of running off. Make tanks big: at least 50 litres for every square metre of roof that drains into them. Dig dams long and narrow — about 3 times longer than wide — on gentle slopes.
afrikaans_draft: Swaar somerstorms kom vinnig. Grawe kanale langs die helling (kontoerslote) en klein damme voordat die reëns in Augustus of September begin, sodat die water insyfer in plaas daarvan om weg te loop. Maak tenks groot: ten minste 50 liter vir elke vierkante meter dak wat daarin dreineer. Grawe damme lank en smal — ongeveer 3 keer langer as wyd — op sagte hellings.

english: Summer brings short, heavy thunderstorms. On every slope, dig channels that follow the land gently downhill (about a 1m drop for every 1,000m across) to spread the water instead of letting it rush away. Winters are dry, so storing water matters. As a rule: 1 square metre of roof catches about 1 litre of water for every 1mm of rain.
afrikaans_draft: Die somer bring kort, swaar donderstorms. Grawe op elke helling kanale wat die grond saggies afdraand volg (ongeveer 1m daling vir elke 1,000m oor) om die water te versprei in plaas daarvan om dit te laat wegjaag. Winters is droog, daarom is wateropberging belangrik. As reël: 1 vierkante meter dak vang ongeveer 1 liter water vir elke 1mm reën.

english: Rain falls only in winter, so do earthworks in late autumn (March to May), before the rain comes. Small banks along the contour and shallow mulched basins work well. Size your water tanks carefully — summer (December to February) is dry. Reused household water (greywater) is fine for food-growing areas, but never for the natural Fynbos — it is too rich in nutrients for it.
afrikaans_draft: Reën val slegs in die winter, doen dus grondwerk in die laat herfs (Maart tot Mei), voordat die reën kom. Klein walle langs die kontoer en vlak bekkens met deklaag werk goed. Bepaal die grootte van jou watertenks versigtig — die somer (Desember tot Februarie) is droog. Hergebruikte huishoudelike water (gryswater) is goed vir voedselverbouingsareas, maar nooit vir die natuurlike Fynbos nie — dit is te ryk aan voedingstowwe daarvoor.

english: On slopes facing west, shade netting can catch water from fog. Build a small raised rim around each plant to trap every drop of rain where it falls. Reusing household water (greywater) is worth doing here. Every 100mm of rain matters — even a small roof tank is valuable.
afrikaans_draft: Op hellings wat wes wys, kan skadunet water uit mis opvang. Bou 'n klein verhoogde rand rondom elke plant om elke druppel reën vas te vang waar dit val. Dit is die moeite werd om huishoudelike water (gryswater) hier te hergebruik. Elke 100mm reën tel — selfs 'n klein daktenk is waardevol.

english: Shade netting can catch water from fog in the air. Design channels to catch sudden flash floods safely. Store water underground, where it stays cool and does not evaporate. Plant trees as windbreaks — they reduce evaporation and give shade before you plant crops.
afrikaans_draft: Skadunet kan water uit mis in die lug opvang. Ontwerp kanale om skielike vloede veilig op te vang. Stoor water ondergronds, waar dit koel bly en nie verdamp nie. Plant bome as windskerms — hulle verminder verdamping en gee skaduwee voordat jy gewasse plant.

english: Rain is heavy, so managing floods matters more than collecting water. Use shallow channels to slow water down on steep slopes. Raised beds stop plants sitting in water. Channels along the contour also help prevent landslides on clay soil. Run downpipes from your roof into underground tanks.
afrikaans_draft: Reën is swaar, daarom is vloedbestuur belangriker as om water op te vang. Gebruik vlak kanale om water op steil hellings te vertraag. Verhoogde beddings keer dat plante in water staan. Kanale langs die kontoer help ook om grondverskuiwings op kleigrond te voorkom. Lei afvoerpype van jou dak na ondergrondse tenks.

english: Grazing animals often compact this soil hard. Loosen it below the surface before digging channels or ponds. Plant oats or vetch as a winter cover crop to protect and feed the soil. The soil is usually mildly acidic (pH 5.5–6.5) — add agricultural lime if it is more acidic than that. Build up organic matter with compost and biochar.
afrikaans_draft: Weidende diere trap hierdie grond dikwels hard. Maak dit onder die oppervlak los voordat jy kanale of damme grawe. Plant hawer of wieke as 'n winterdekgewas om die grond te beskerm en te voed. Die grond is gewoonlik effens suur (pH 5.5–6.5) — voeg landboukalk by as die grond suurder is as dit. Bou organiese materiaal op met kompos en biochar.

english: Do not add compost, lime or phosphorus to natural Fynbos areas — it kills the plants, which are adapted to poor soil. Grow food separately, on soil brought in from elsewhere. Mulch food beds with Fynbos plant material. Cape reeds help hold the banks of water channels in place naturally.
afrikaans_draft: Moenie kompos, kalk of fosfor by natuurlike Fynbos-areas voeg nie — dit maak die plante dood, wat by arm grond aangepas is. Kweek voedsel apart, op grond wat van elders ingebring is. Bedek voedselbeddings met Fynbos-plantmateriaal as deklaag. Kaapse riete help om die walle van waterkanale natuurlik in plek te hou.

english: Your location is rounded to about a kilometre before it is saved — never your exact homestead. Based on {name}.
afrikaans_draft: Jou ligging word tot ongeveer 'n kilometer afgerond voordat dit gestoor word — nooit jou presiese opstal nie. Gebaseer op {name}.

key: Winter — protect seedlings from frost; harvest greens & roots.
english: Winter — protect seedlings from frost; harvest greens & roots.
afrikaans_draft: Winter — beskerm saailinge teen ryp; oes groente en wortelgewasse.

key: Remove spent tomato plants before disease spreads
english: Remove spent tomato plants before disease spreads
afrikaans_draft: Verwyder uitgediende tamatieplante voordat siekte versprei

key: Protect tender seedlings from frost with shade cloth or row cover
english: Protect tender seedlings from frost with shade cloth or row cover
afrikaans_draft: Beskerm sagte saailinge teen ryp met skadunet of rybedekking

key: Prepare spring beds — dig in compost before the heat arrives
english: Prepare spring beds — dig in compost before the heat arrives
afrikaans_draft: Berei lentebeddings voor — grawe kompos in voordat die hitte kom

key: Remove frost cloth as days warm — let sun strengthen seedlings
english: Remove frost cloth as days warm — let sun strengthen seedlings
afrikaans_draft: Verwyder rypdoek soos die dae warmer word — laat die son saailinge versterk

key: Water daily in the morning — evening watering invites fungal disease
english: Water daily in the morning — evening watering invites fungal disease
afrikaans_draft: Gee daagliks soggens water — saans water gee lok swamsiektes uit

key: April is the best time to plant garlic in most of South Africa. Use healthy large cloves from disease-free stock. Spinach germinates well now — thin seedlings to 15 cm apart for big leaves. Cooler nights mean less pest pressure: advantage yours.
english: April is the best time to plant garlic in most of South Africa. Use healthy large cloves from disease-free stock. Spinach germinates well now — thin seedlings to 15 cm apart for big leaves. Cooler nights mean less pest pressure: advantage yours.
afrikaans_draft: April is die beste tyd om knoffel in die meeste dele van Suid-Afrika te plant. Gebruik gesonde groot huisies van siektevrye voorraad. Spinasie ontkiem nou goed — dun saailinge uit tot 15 cm van mekaar vir groot blare. Koeler nagte beteken minder pesdruk: voordeel vir jou.

key: Succession sow spinach every 3 weeks from May through July for a continuous harvest window. Carrots sown now will be ready by August. Autumn is also the ideal time to improve soil — dig in mature compost now and the earthworms will do the rest over winter.
english: Succession sow spinach every 3 weeks from May through July for a continuous harvest window. Carrots sown now will be ready by August. Autumn is also the ideal time to improve soil — dig in mature compost now and the earthworms will do the rest over winter.
afrikaans_draft: Saai spinasie elke 3 weke van Mei tot Julie in opeenvolging vir 'n aaneenlopende oesvenster. Wortels wat nou gesaai word, sal teen Augustus gereed wees. Herfs is ook die ideale tyd om grond te verbeter — grawe nou volryp kompos in en die erdwurms sal die res oor die winter doen.

key: June is the coldest month in the Highveld. In frost-prone areas, protect spinach seedlings overnight with fleece or dry grass. On the coast and in the Cape, June is actually ideal growing weather — focus there on maximising yields before spring heat arrives.
english: June is the coldest month in the Highveld. In frost-prone areas, protect spinach seedlings overnight with fleece or dry grass. On the coast and in the Cape, June is actually ideal growing weather — focus there on maximising yields before spring heat arrives.
afrikaans_draft: Junie is die koudste maand op die Hoëveld. In rypgevoelige gebiede, beskerm spinasiesaailinge snags met vlies of droë gras. Aan die kus en in die Kaap is Junie eintlik ideale groeiweer — fokus daar daarop om opbrengste te maksimeer voordat die lentehitte kom.

key: August signals transition. Sow tomato seeds indoors now — 6 to 8 weeks before your last frost gives transplants a running start. In frost-free coastal regions you can direct-sow tomatoes in the ground by late August. Begin loosening winter-compacted soil in every bed.
english: August signals transition. Sow tomato seeds indoors now — 6 to 8 weeks before your last frost gives transplants a running start. In frost-free coastal regions you can direct-sow tomatoes in the ground by late August. Begin loosening winter-compacted soil in every bed.
afrikaans_draft: Augustus dui op oorgang. Saai nou tamatiesaad binnenshuis — 6 tot 8 weke voor jou laaste ryp gee oorplantings 'n voorsprong. In rypvrye kusstreke kan jy tamaties teen laat Augustus direk in die grond saai. Begin om winterverdigte grond in elke bedding los te maak.

key: November brings the first summer rains in many regions — a welcome relief after spring dry spells. Do not skip watering: rain is unpredictable and surface-shallow. Deep irrigation weekly beats shallow rain every time for root development. Protect young maize from strong wind after rain.
english: November brings the first summer rains in many regions — a welcome relief after spring dry spells. Do not skip watering: rain is unpredictable and surface-shallow. Deep irrigation weekly beats shallow rain every time for root development. Protect young maize from strong wind after rain.
afrikaans_draft: November bring die eerste somerreëns in baie streke — 'n welkome verligting ná lente se droë periodes. Moenie water gee oorslaan nie: reën is onvoorspelbaar en dring net vlak in. Weeklikse diep besproeiing is elke keer beter as vlak reën vir wortelontwikkeling. Beskerm jong mielies ná reën teen sterk wind.

key: Open My Records and choose Picked. Pick the crop, enter the weight and save. Do this as soon as you pick, so you never have to remember a number later.
english: Open My Records and choose Picked. Pick the crop, enter the weight and save. Do this as soon as you pick, so you never have to remember a number later.
afrikaans_draft: Maak My rekords oop en kies Gepluk. Kies die gewas, voer die gewig in en stoor. Doen dit sodra jy pluk, sodat jy nooit later 'n getal hoef te onthou nie.

key: Compare harvests, sales and expenses in Charts. Open invoices, choose Saved and open an existing invoice to find Share PDF and Print. See how the farmer keeps a digital record; you do not need to send anything to a buyer.
english: Compare harvests, sales and expenses in Charts. Open invoices, choose Saved and open an existing invoice to find Share PDF and Print. See how the farmer keeps a digital record; you do not need to send anything to a buyer.
afrikaans_draft: Vergelyk oeste, verkope en uitgawes in Grafieke. Maak fakture oop, kies Gestoor en maak 'n bestaande faktuur oop om Deel PDF en Druk te vind. Sien hoe die boer 'n digitale rekord hou; jy hoef niks na 'n koper te stuur nie.

key: A fictional warm KZN farm with vegetables, staples, fruit, nuts, berries, eggs, milk, honey and fish. View its monthly calendar, young trees and printable plan. Shown in English.
english: A fictional warm KZN farm with vegetables, staples, fruit, nuts, berries, eggs, milk, honey and fish. View its monthly calendar, young trees and printable plan. Shown in English.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Fiktiewe warm KZN-plaas met groente, stapelvoedsel, vrugte, neute, bessies, eiers, melk, heuning en vis. Bekyk sy maandelikse kalender, jong bome en drukbare plan. Word in Engels gewys.

key: Changes stay in this tour session. Resetting or reloading starts fresh. Signing in is not required and switching views never changes your real account permissions.
english: Changes stay in this tour session. Resetting or reloading starts fresh. Signing in is not required and switching views never changes your real account permissions.
afrikaans_draft: Veranderinge bly in hierdie toersessie. Terugstel of herlaai begin van voor af. Aanmelding is nie nodig nie, en die wissel van aansigte verander nooit jou regte rekeningtoestemmings nie.

key: Growing areas exclude buildings, paths, tree areas and unused space. Photos illustrate the setting; they do not measure the land.
english: Growing areas exclude buildings, paths, tree areas and unused space. Photos illustrate the setting; they do not measure the land.
afrikaans_draft: Groeigebiede sluit geboue, paadjies, boomgebiede en ongebruikte ruimte uit. Foto's illustreer die omgewing; hulle meet nie die grond nie.

key: Evidence comes before claims. These reporting references inform the structure; they do not certify this programme or replace an evaluation.
english: Evidence comes before claims. These reporting references inform the structure; they do not certify this programme or replace an evaluation.
afrikaans_draft: Bewyse kom voor bewerings. Hierdie verslagverwysings rig die struktuur; hulle sertifiseer nie hierdie program nie en vervang nie 'n evaluering nie.

key: DEMONSTRATION RECORDS: all figures in this report are illustrative and must not be used as evidence of real programme results.
english: DEMONSTRATION RECORDS: all figures in this report are illustrative and must not be used as evidence of real programme results.
afrikaans_draft: DEMONSTRASIEREKORDS: alle syfers in hierdie verslag is illustratief en mag nie as bewyse van werklike programresultate gebruik word nie.

key: Review missing evidence for {list}. Confirm whether gaps reflect consent, access, or incomplete recording; do not pressure farmers to share.
english: Review missing evidence for {list}. Confirm whether gaps reflect consent, access, or incomplete recording; do not pressure farmers to share.
afrikaans_draft: Hersien ontbrekende bewyse vir {list}. Bevestig of leemtes toestemming, toegang of onvolledige aantekening weerspieël; moenie boere druk om te deel nie.

key: Readable books do not guarantee complete records.
english: Readable books do not guarantee complete records.
afrikaans_draft: Leesbare boeke waarborg nie volledige rekords nie.

key: Current record-based flags. One farmer may appear in more than one row; counts must not be added as unique people. Owners and due dates must be agreed with the team.
english: Current record-based flags. One farmer may appear in more than one row; counts must not be added as unique people. Owners and due dates must be agreed with the team.
afrikaans_draft: Huidige rekordgebaseerde vlae. Een boer kan in meer as een ry verskyn; tellings mag nie as unieke mense bymekaargetel word nie. Eienaars en sperdatums moet met die span ooreengekom word.

key: Record food you have kept, bought or carried from an earlier harvest. Choose its months yourself. The plan does not work out a safe shelf life or a preservation recipe.
english: Record food you have kept, bought or carried from an earlier harvest. Choose its months yourself. The plan does not work out a safe shelf life or a preservation recipe.
afrikaans_draft: Teken kos aan wat jy gehou, gekoop of van 'n vroeëre oes oorgedra het. Kies self die maande daarvoor. Die plan bereken nie 'n veilige raklewe of 'n preserveringsresep nie.

key: Use these records to compare with what you actually collect. They do not predict the coming year or set picking dates.
english: Use these records to compare with what you actually collect. They do not predict the coming year or set picking dates.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik hierdie rekords om te vergelyk met wat jy werklik insamel. Dit voorspel nie die komende jaar nie en stel nie plukdatums vas nie.

key: The next ten years, starting this month. Add planting dates and expected yields under each plant above. Missing yields remain visible; young trees do not receive a mature-tree yield.
english: The next ten years, starting this month. Add planting dates and expected yields under each plant above. Missing yields remain visible; young trees do not receive a mature-tree yield.
afrikaans_draft: Die volgende tien jaar, vanaf hierdie maand. Voeg plantdatums en verwagte opbrengste onder elke plant hierbo by. Ontbrekende opbrengste bly sigbaar; jong bome kry nie 'n volwasse boom se opbrengs nie.

key: These are your observations; they do not promise a yield.
english: These are your observations; they do not promise a yield.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is jou waarnemings; dit belowe nie 'n opbrengs nie.

key: Vegetables and staples from the beds. Fruit, nuts and berries from the food forest. Eggs, milk, meat, honey and fish alongside them.
english: Vegetables and staples from the beds. Fruit, nuts and berries from the food forest. Eggs, milk, meat, honey and fish alongside them.
afrikaans_draft: Groente en stapelvoedsel uit die beddings. Vrugte, neute en bessies uit die voedselwoud. Eiers, melk, vleis, heuning en vis saam daarmee.

key: The two receipts total R120.00. Invoice P01 is now settled in this example. Keep both receipts and the original invoice; do not add their values as separate sales.
english: The two receipts total R120.00. Invoice P01 is now settled in this example. Keep both receipts and the original invoice; do not add their values as separate sales.
afrikaans_draft: Die twee kwitansies is altesaam R120.00. Faktuur P01 is nou in hierdie voorbeeld vereffen. Hou albei kwitansies en die oorspronklike faktuur; moenie hul waardes as aparte verkope bytel nie.

key: The app currently records paid in full or unpaid. Keep part payments and the remaining balance in a separate checked record; do not mark the invoice fully paid after only a deposit.
english: The app currently records paid in full or unpaid. Keep part payments and the remaining balance in a separate checked record; do not mark the invoice fully paid after only a deposit.
afrikaans_draft: Die app teken tans volledig betaal of onbetaal aan. Hou deelbetalings en die oorblywende saldo in 'n aparte, nagegaande rekord; moenie die faktuur as volledig betaal merk ná slegs 'n deposito nie.

key: Invented receipts and payments for learning. These controls do not change My Records.
english: Invented receipts and payments for learning. These controls do not change My Records.
afrikaans_draft: Versinde kwitansies en betalings om te leer. Hierdie kontroles verander nie My rekords nie.

key: These records do not show full profit. Use your own source documents for a real farm.
english: These records do not show full profit. Use your own source documents for a real farm.
afrikaans_draft: Hierdie rekords wys nie volle wins nie. Gebruik jou eie brondokumente vir 'n regte plaas.

key: Try every calculation before checking. You can read out or point to your reasoning while a facilitator writes it down. These self-checks do not award course credit.
english: Try every calculation before checking. You can read out or point to your reasoning while a facilitator writes it down. These self-checks do not award course credit.
afrikaans_draft: Probeer elke berekening voordat jy nagaan. Jy kan jou redenasie voorlees of daarop wys terwyl 'n fasiliteerder dit neerskryf. Hierdie selfkontroles gee nie kursuskrediet nie.

key: Full profit is unknown. The source pack does not supply complete production costs, stock values, equipment use and other relevant adjustments. Do not treat a cash balance, cash change or the difference between sales and the two payments as full profit.
english: Full profit is unknown. The source pack does not supply complete production costs, stock values, equipment use and other relevant adjustments. Do not treat a cash balance, cash change or the difference between sales and the two payments as full profit.
afrikaans_draft: Volle wins is onbekend. Die bronpakket verskaf nie volledige produksiekoste, voorraadwaardes, toerustinggebruik en ander betrokke aanpassings nie. Moenie 'n kontantsaldo, kontantverandering of die verskil tussen verkope en die twee betalings as volle wins beskou nie.

key: The gap is outside both bed outlines. Do not count it as bed area.
english: The gap is outside both bed outlines. Do not count it as bed area.
afrikaans_draft: Die gaping is buite albei beddinguitlyne. Moenie dit as beddingoppervlakte tel nie.

key: The downloaded diagram includes its model dimensions. Its size on paper depends on the print settings: do not measure the print with a ruler and assume a ground distance unless you have established and checked the printed scale.
english: The downloaded diagram includes its model dimensions. Its size on paper depends on the print settings: do not measure the print with a ruler and assume a ground distance unless you have established and checked the printed scale.
afrikaans_draft: Die afgelaaide diagram sluit sy modelafmetings in. Die grootte daarvan op papier hang van die drukinstellings af: moenie die afdruk met 'n liniaal meet en 'n afstand op die grond aanneem nie, tensy jy die gedrukte skaal vasgestel en nagegaan het.

key: The water point, growing area and home-to-gate route suggest journeys to discuss with the people doing the work. They do not establish a measured travel time or an agreed workload.
english: The water point, growing area and home-to-gate route suggest journeys to discuss with the people doing the work. They do not establish a measured travel time or an agreed workload.
afrikaans_draft: Die waterpunt, groeiarea en roete van huis na hek dui op trajekte om met die mense wat die werk doen te bespreek. Dit stel nie 'n gemete reistyd of 'n ooreengekome werklading vas nie.

key: The supplied route footprint and gap are fictional geometry, not access standards. They do not establish drainage, crop spacing, soil suitability or safe working clearance. The original growing area remains existing evidence when B is displayed; do not count both outlines as active production.
english: The supplied route footprint and gap are fictional geometry, not access standards. They do not establish drainage, crop spacing, soil suitability or safe working clearance. The original growing area remains existing evidence when B is displayed; do not count both outlines as active production.
afrikaans_draft: Die verskafde roete-voetspoor en gaping is fiktiewe geometrie, nie toegangstandaarde nie. Dit stel nie dreinering, gewasspasiëring, grondgeskiktheid of veilige werkspeling vas nie. Die oorspronklike groeiarea bly bestaande bewyse wanneer B vertoon word; moenie albei uitlyne as aktiewe produksie tel nie.

key: Use this unit’s own opening balances and source cards. Do not carry a previous unit’s totals into this exercise.
english: Use this unit’s own opening balances and source cards. Do not carry a previous unit’s totals into this exercise.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik hierdie eenheid se eie openingsaldo's en bronkaarte. Moenie 'n vorige eenheid se totale na hierdie oefening oordra nie.

key: Find your way and keep work safe
english: Find your way and keep work safe
afrikaans_draft: Vind jou pad en hou werk veilig

key: {harvest}: Plot A ({plot}) harvest weighed {quantity} kg. This weight is supplied by the imaginary harvest card; do not derive it from the plot area.
english: {harvest}: Plot A ({plot}) harvest weighed {quantity} kg. This weight is supplied by the imaginary harvest card; do not derive it from the plot area.
afrikaans_draft: {harvest}: Perseel A ({plot}) se oes het {quantity} kg geweeg. Hierdie gewig word deur die denkbeeldige oeskaart verskaf; moenie dit van die perseeloppervlakte aflei nie.

key: Work at a pace that allows field observation, discussion and another attempt after feedback. Eighteen reading pages do not establish a course duration or replace seasonal evidence. The facilitator reviews what you can explain and demonstrate.
english: Work at a pace that allows field observation, discussion and another attempt after feedback. Eighteen reading pages do not establish a course duration or replace seasonal evidence. The facilitator reviews what you can explain and demonstrate.
afrikaans_draft: Werk teen 'n tempo wat veldwaarneming, bespreking en nog 'n poging ná terugvoer toelaat. Agtien leesbladsye stel nie 'n kursusduur vas of vervang seisoenale bewyse nie. Die fasiliteerder hersien wat jy kan verduidelik en demonstreer.

key: Use a notebook, drawings or supported spoken answers. The supplied fictional worked demonstration supports the lesson method; a real field plan still needs checked measurements, evidence and review. These pages do not certify a design or award assessed progress. Audio and translations are not yet available; save the pathway from its overview before leaving signal.
english: Use a notebook, drawings or supported spoken answers. The supplied fictional worked demonstration supports the lesson method; a real field plan still needs checked measurements, evidence and review. These pages do not certify a design or award assessed progress. Audio and translations are not yet available; save the pathway from its overview before leaving signal.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik 'n notaboek, tekeninge of ondersteunde mondelinge antwoorde. Die verskafde fiktiewe uitgewerkte demonstrasie ondersteun die lesmetode; 'n regte veldplan het steeds nagegaande metings, bewyse en hersiening nodig. Hierdie bladsye sertifiseer nie 'n ontwerp nie en ken nie geassesseerde vordering toe nie. Klank en vertalings is nog nie beskikbaar nie; stoor die leesroete vanaf sy oorsig voordat jy uit sein gaan.

key: Imaginary site in metres, with no real location. Plot A is only a reference for these source cards. Dimensions do not establish harvest, rights, safety or a planting recommendation.
english: Imaginary site in metres, with no real location. Plot A is only a reference for these source cards. Dimensions do not establish harvest, rights, safety or a planting recommendation.
afrikaans_draft: Denkbeeldige terrein in meter, sonder 'n regte ligging. Perseel A is slegs 'n verwysing vir hierdie bronkaarte. Afmetings stel nie oes, regte, veiligheid of 'n plantaanbeveling vas nie.

key: The loan card confirms cash received and the same principal still owed at month end. No loan repayment occurs here. Terms and interest are not supplied: do not recommend this loan or assume it is free.
english: The loan card confirms cash received and the same principal still owed at month end. No loan repayment occurs here. Terms and interest are not supplied: do not recommend this loan or assume it is free.
afrikaans_draft: Die leningskaart bevestig kontant ontvang en dieselfde kapitaal wat aan die einde van die maand steeds verskuldig is. Geen leningsterugbetaling vind hier plaas nie. Voorwaardes en rente word nie verskaf nie: moenie hierdie lening aanbeveel of aanneem dat dit gratis is nie.

key: Confirm the group’s languages and access needs. Bring an existing core lesson, its printed still and transcript, plus ordinary objects for a safe practical.
english: Confirm the group’s languages and access needs. Bring an existing core lesson, its printed still and transcript, plus ordinary objects for a safe practical.
afrikaans_draft: Bevestig die groep se tale en toegangsbehoeftes. Bring 'n bestaande kernles, sy gedrukte stilbeeld en transkripsie, plus gewone voorwerpe vir 'n veilige praktiese oefening.

key: Confirm ACT’s register and consent wording before collecting real data. Ask separately before photographing or sharing anyone’s work. Do not use a shared device for private household records.
english: Confirm ACT’s register and consent wording before collecting real data. Ask separately before photographing or sharing anyone’s work. Do not use a shared device for private household records.
afrikaans_draft: Bevestig ACT se register- en toestemmingsbewoording voordat jy regte data insamel. Vra afsonderlik voordat jy enigiemand se werk afneem of deel. Moenie 'n gedeelde toestel vir private huishoudingsrekords gebruik nie.

key: The two days refresh the teaching method and practise selected lessons. They do not cover or assess all ten modules in full. Choose a published, available lesson that fits the local group and check its source and media before use.
english: The two days refresh the teaching method and practise selected lessons. They do not cover or assess all ten modules in full. Choose a published, available lesson that fits the local group and check its source and media before use.
afrikaans_draft: Die twee dae knap die onderrigmetode op en oefen gekose lesse. Hulle dek of assesseer nie al tien modules volledig nie. Kies 'n gepubliseerde, beskikbare les wat by die plaaslike groep pas en kontroleer sy bron en media voor gebruik.

key: ACT decides any attendance record or certificate wording under its own policy. Do not call this refresher an accredited qualification.
english: ACT decides any attendance record or certificate wording under its own policy. Do not call this refresher an accredited qualification.
afrikaans_draft: ACT besluit oor enige bywoningsrekord of sertifikaatbewoording volgens sy eie beleid. Moenie hierdie opknappingskursus 'n geakkrediteerde kwalifikasie noem nie.

key: Let pairs describe one observation and one uncertainty; then model a safe action whose exact core-lesson source and local limits you have checked.
english: Let pairs describe one observation and one uncertainty; then model a safe action whose exact core-lesson source and local limits you have checked.
afrikaans_draft: Laat pare een waarneming en een onsekerheid beskryf; modelleer dan 'n veilige handeling waarvan jy die presiese kernlesbron en plaaslike beperkings gekontroleer het.

key: Return to the core modules for the relevant teaching point. Do not turn an illustration into proof of a site condition.
english: Return to the core modules for the relevant teaching point. Do not turn an illustration into proof of a site condition.
afrikaans_draft: Keer terug na die kernmodules vir die betrokke onderrigpunt. Moenie 'n illustrasie in bewys van 'n terreintoestand omskep nie.

key: Test on a trainer device or demo account; do not sign in as a farmer or use someone else’s records.
english: Test on a trainer device or demo account; do not sign in as a farmer or use someone else’s records.
afrikaans_draft: Toets op 'n opleierstoestel of demo-rekening; moenie as 'n boer aanmeld of iemand anders se rekords gebruik nie.

key: Assign a role and a safe action to every learner.
english: Assign a role and a safe action to every learner.
afrikaans_draft: Gee elke leerder 'n rol en 'n veilige handeling.

key: Model a simple soil, water or seed observation using local materials after checking the method and site; pause if the action is unsafe.
english: Model a simple soil, water or seed observation using local materials after checking the method and site; pause if the action is unsafe.
afrikaans_draft: Modelleer 'n eenvoudige grond-, water- of saadwaarneming met plaaslike materiaal nadat jy die metode en terrein gekontroleer het; hou op as die handeling onveilig is.

key: A revised practical with a safe role for each learner.
english: A revised practical with a safe role for each learner.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Hersiene praktiese oefening met 'n veilige rol vir elke leerder.

key: Use the same case on a printed base map; do not enter a private household’s data into a shared trainer device.
english: Use the same case on a printed base map; do not enter a private household’s data into a shared trainer device.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik dieselfde geval op 'n gedrukte basiskaart; moenie 'n private huishouding se data op 'n gedeelde opleierstoestel invoer nie.

key: Identify the local language to use, the exact English source when a translation is a draft, materials, access support and a stop point for unsafe or unverified advice.
english: Identify the local language to use, the exact English source when a translation is a draft, materials, access support and a stop point for unsafe or unverified advice.
afrikaans_draft: Identifiseer die plaaslike taal om te gebruik, die presiese Engelse bron wanneer 'n vertaling 'n konsep is, materiaal, toegangsondersteuning en 'n stoppunt vir onveilige of ongeverifieerde advies.

key: The observer records what was seen: invitation to participate, safe practical action, source/uncertainty, check for understanding and response to feedback.
english: The observer records what was seen: invitation to participate, safe practical action, source/uncertainty, check for understanding and response to feedback.
afrikaans_draft: Die waarnemer teken aan wat gesien is: uitnodiging om deel te neem, veilige praktiese handeling, bron/onsekerheid, kontrole vir begrip en reaksie op terugvoer.

key: Pauses unsafe or unverified farming advice and identifies the next source or practitioner check.
english: Pauses unsafe or unverified farming advice and identifies the next source or practitioner check.
afrikaans_draft: Stop onveilige of ongeverifieerde boerdery-advies en identifiseer die volgende bron of praktisynkontrole.

key: Survey responses are self-reported. Small groups are withheld; these figures alone do not establish project impact.
english: Survey responses are self-reported. Small groups are withheld; these figures alone do not establish project impact.
afrikaans_draft: Opname-antwoorde is selfgerapporteer. Klein groepe word teruggehou; hierdie syfers alleen bewys nie projekimpak nie.

key: Trace a boundary on a satellite view of the real farm, then lay out beds, water systems, earthworks and structures directly on that ground — not a generic template.
english: Trace a boundary on a satellite view of the real farm, then lay out beds, water systems, earthworks and structures directly on that ground — not a generic template.
afrikaans_draft: Trek 'n grens op 'n satellietaansig van die werklike plaas, en lê dan beddings, waterstelsels, grondwerke en strukture direk op daardie grond uit — nie 'n generiese sjabloon nie.

key: Ten modules, 33 lessons, covering permaculture ethics, reading the landscape, water harvesting, soil health, seeds, plant guilds, food forests, livestock and market gardening — each lesson with a short quiz.
english: Ten modules, 33 lessons, covering permaculture ethics, reading the landscape, water harvesting, soil health, seeds, plant guilds, food forests, livestock and market gardening — each lesson with a short quiz.
afrikaans_draft: Tien modules, 33 lesse, oor permakultuuretiek, die lees van die landskap, wateropvang, grondgesondheid, sade, plantgildes, voedselwoude, vee en marktuinbou — elke les met 'n kort vasvra.

key: ImbewuField home screen showing the farm’s weather forecast, a heat warning, and the next suggested step
english: ImbewuField home screen showing the farm’s weather forecast, a heat warning, and the next suggested step
afrikaans_draft: ImbewuField-tuisskerm wat die plaas se weervoorspelling, 'n hittewaarskuwing en die volgende voorgestelde stap wys

key: Today’s weather, a heat warning, and what to do next on this farm.
english: Today’s weather, a heat warning, and what to do next on this farm.
afrikaans_draft: Vandag se weer, 'n hittewaarskuwing, en wat om volgende op hierdie plaas te doen.

key: AI-generated site report showing rainfall, soil texture, frost risk and elevation, plus the site’s mapped land parcels
english: AI-generated site report showing rainfall, soil texture, frost risk and elevation, plus the site’s mapped land parcels
afrikaans_draft: AI-gegenereerde terreinverslag wat reënval, grondtekstuur, rypgevaar en hoogte bo seespieël wys, plus die terrein se gekarteerde grondpersele

key: Rainfall, soil, frost risk and elevation for the exact site — plus its mapped land parcels.
english: Rainfall, soil, frost risk and elevation for the exact site — plus its mapped land parcels.
afrikaans_draft: Reënval, grond, rypgevaar en hoogte bo seespieël vir die presiese terrein — plus sy gekarteerde grondpersele.

key: What are the chickens for: eggs, meat or both?
english: What are the chickens for: eggs, meat or both?
afrikaans_draft: Waarvoor is die hoenders: eiers, vleis of albei?

key: Is clean drinking water always available?
english: Is clean drinking water always available?

key: Secure reliable clean drinking water before buying more birds.
english: Secure reliable clean drinking water before buying more birds.
afrikaans_draft: Verseker betroubare skoon drinkwater voordat jy meer voëls koop.

key: Every breed needs clean drinking water, suitable feed and protected housing.
english: Every breed needs clean drinking water, suitable feed and protected housing.
afrikaans_draft: Elke ras het skoon drinkwater, geskikte voer en beskermde behuising nodig.

key: You reported frost. Check winter shelter and chick warmth with a local adviser.
english: You reported frost. Check winter shelter and chick warmth with a local adviser.
afrikaans_draft: Jy het ryp aangemeld. Kontroleer winterskuiling en warmte vir kuikens met 'n plaaslike adviseur.

key: Growing water is limited. Check drinking water separately; garden water does not confirm a safe poultry supply.
english: Growing water is limited. Check drinking water separately; garden water does not confirm a safe poultry supply.
afrikaans_draft: Water vir verbouing is beperk. Kontroleer drinkwater afsonderlik; tuinwater bevestig nie 'n veilige watervoorraad vir pluimvee nie.

key: An egg-and-meat option. It outperformed the other indigenous breeds for eggs in a managed ARC trial; those results do not predict this farm.
english: An egg-and-meat option. It outperformed the other indigenous breeds for eggs in a managed ARC trial; those results do not predict this farm.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Opsie vir eiers en vleis. Dit het in 'n bestuurde ARC-proef beter as die ander inheemse rasse vir eiers gevaar; daardie resultate voorspel nie hierdie plaas nie.

key: An ARC-conserved indigenous option for eggs and meat; check local stock and care needs.
english: An ARC-conserved indigenous option for eggs and meat; check local stock and care needs.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Inheemse opsie vir eiers en vleis wat deur die ARC bewaar word; kontroleer plaaslike voorraad en versorgingsbehoeftes.

key: Consider only after checking reliable feed, drinking water, housing, health care and managed lighting. Breed and supplier still need local confirmation.
english: Consider only after checking reliable feed, drinking water, housing, health care and managed lighting. Breed and supplier still need local confirmation.
afrikaans_draft: Oorweeg dit slegs nadat jy betroubare voer, drinkwater, behuising, gesondheidsorg en bestuurde beligting gekontroleer het. Ras en verskaffer moet steeds plaaslik bevestig word.

key: Needs dependable balanced feed, water, suitable housing and management. Confirm chick supply and a meat outlet before choosing.
english: Needs dependable balanced feed, water, suitable housing and management. Confirm chick supply and a meat outlet before choosing.
afrikaans_draft: Het betroubare gebalanseerde voer, water, geskikte behuising en bestuur nodig. Bevestig kuikenvoorsiening en 'n vleismark voordat jy kies.

key: Live calf weaning weight from communal Nguni herds in Limpopo; not meat weight.
english: Live calf weaning weight from communal Nguni herds in Limpopo; not meat weight.
afrikaans_draft: Lewende speengewig van kalwers uit gemeenskaplike Nguni-kuddes in Limpopo; nie vleisgewig nie.

key: Milk-recorded Jersey and Holstein herds, per lactation; not an annual total.
english: Milk-recorded Jersey and Holstein herds, per lactation; not an annual total.
afrikaans_draft: Melkaangetekende Jersey- en Holstein-kuddes, per laktasie; nie 'n jaartotaal nie.

key: Commercial industry reference at slaughter; not a household flock forecast.
english: Commercial industry reference at slaughter; not a household flock forecast.
afrikaans_draft: Kommersiële bedryfsverwysing by slag; nie 'n voorspelling vir 'n huishoudelike trop nie.

key: Non-South African study reference; live weight, not meat weight.
english: Non-South African study reference; live weight, not meat weight.
afrikaans_draft: Nie-Suid-Afrikaanse studieverwysing; lewende gewig, nie vleisgewig nie.

key: Milk-recorded Saanen herds, per lactation; not an annual total.
english: Milk-recorded Saanen herds, per lactation; not an annual total.
afrikaans_draft: Melkaangetekende Saanen-kuddes, per laktasie; nie 'n jaartotaal nie.

key: Extensive Boer-goat reference for kids weaned; not meat weight.
english: Extensive Boer-goat reference for kids weaned; not meat weight.
afrikaans_draft: Ekstensiewe Boer-goat-verwysing vir lammers gespeen; nie vleisgewig nie.

key: Farmer-reported lambs born; not lambs weaned or meat weight.
english: Farmer-reported lambs born; not lambs weaned or meat weight.
afrikaans_draft: Lammers gebore soos deur boere aangemeld; nie lammers gespeen of vleisgewig nie.

key: Commercial dairy processors require an even year-round milk supply. This is a herd supply reference, not year-round milk from each cow. Confirm your farm's calving and milking months.
english: Commercial dairy processors require an even year-round milk supply. This is a herd supply reference, not year-round milk from each cow. Confirm your farm's calving and milking months.
afrikaans_draft: Kommersiële suiwelverwerkers vereis 'n eweredige melkvoorraad deur die jaar. Dit is 'n kuddevoorraad-verwysing, nie melk van elke koei deur die jaar nie. Bevestig jou plaas se kalwings- en melkmaande.

key: In this South African Saanen milk-recording study, does kidding in spring had the highest average lactation milk yield. Table 1 defines spring as August–October for this study. These are kidding-season categories, not confirmed milk collection months.
english: In this South African Saanen milk-recording study, does kidding in spring had the highest average lactation milk yield. Table 1 defines spring as August–October for this study. These are kidding-season categories, not confirmed milk collection months.
afrikaans_draft: In hierdie Suid-Afrikaanse Saanen-melkaantekeningstudie het ooie wat in die lente gelam het die hoogste gemiddelde laktasie-melkopbrengs gehad. Tabel 1 definieer lente as Augustus–Oktober vir hierdie studie. Dit is lamseisoen-kategorieë, nie bevestigde melkinsamelingsmaande nie.

key: Planned crops to check for frost
english: Planned crops to check for frost
afrikaans_draft: Beplande gewasse om vir ryp te kontroleer

key: Frost has been observed here in {months}. Check frost-tender crops against these observations.
english: Frost has been observed here in {months}. Check frost-tender crops against these observations.
afrikaans_draft: Ryp is hier waargeneem in {months}. Kontroleer rypgevoelige gewasse teen hierdie waarnemings.

key: Frost has been observed here; months not recorded. Check frost-tender crops against these observations.
english: Frost has been observed here; months not recorded. Check frost-tender crops against these observations.
afrikaans_draft: Ryp is hier waargeneem; maande nie aangeteken nie. Kontroleer rypgevoelige gewasse teen hierdie waarnemings.

key: Farmer reports no observed frost. This observation does not establish that future winters will be frost-free.
english: Farmer reports no observed frost. This observation does not establish that future winters will be frost-free.
afrikaans_draft: Boer meld aan dat geen ryp waargeneem is nie. Hierdie waarneming bewys nie dat toekomstige winters rypvry sal wees nie.

key: Local frost observations are not recorded. Satellite monthly averages cannot establish first and last frost dates.
english: Local frost observations are not recorded. Satellite monthly averages cannot establish first and last frost dates.
afrikaans_draft: Plaaslike rypwaarnemings is nie aangeteken nie. Satelliet se maandelikse gemiddeldes kan nie eerste en laaste rypdatums bepaal nie.

key: These planned crops will hold ground in months when frost has been observed here. Confirm local protection or change the planting before relying on these dates.
english: These planned crops will hold ground in months when frost has been observed here. Confirm local protection or change the planting before relying on these dates.
afrikaans_draft: Hierdie beplande gewasse sal grond beset in maande wanneer ryp hier waargeneem is. Bevestig plaaslike beskerming of verander die plantwerk voordat jy op hierdie datums staatmaak.

key: Check that the variety, local climate, pollination, water and care match your yield assumptions. Ages alone do not establish site suitability or survival.
english: Check that the variety, local climate, pollination, water and care match your yield assumptions. Ages alone do not establish site suitability or survival.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer dat die variëteit, plaaslike klimaat, bestuiwing, water en versorging by jou opbrengsaannames pas. Ouderdomme alleen bewys nie terreingeskiktheid of oorlewing nie.

key: Known subtotals leave out missing yields. Eggs, meat, milk, fish and honey are not included in these crop kg totals. Picking months and food-gap checks still need local confirmation.
english: Known subtotals leave out missing yields. Eggs, meat, milk, fish and honey are not included in these crop kg totals. Picking months and food-gap checks still need local confirmation.
afrikaans_draft: Bekende subtotale laat ontbrekende opbrengste uit. Eiers, vleis, melk, vis en heuning is nie by hierdie gewas-kg-totale ingesluit nie. Plukmaande en voedselgaping-kontroles moet steeds plaaslik bevestig word.

key: Invented stock months from January to March 2027, not a safe shelf life. Freezer conditions, a safe processing method and the amount held are not supplied.
english: Invented stock months from January to March 2027, not a safe shelf life. Freezer conditions, a safe processing method and the amount held are not supplied.
afrikaans_draft: Uitgedinkte voorraadmaande van Januarie tot Maart 2027, nie 'n veilige raklewe nie. Vrieskastoestande, 'n veilige verwerkingsmetode en die hoeveelheid in voorraad word nie verskaf nie.

key: Invented stock months from June to August 2027, not a safe shelf life. The example banana picking record is also invented; a safe drying method and the amount held are not supplied.
english: Invented stock months from June to August 2027, not a safe shelf life. The example banana picking record is also invented; a safe drying method and the amount held are not supplied.
afrikaans_draft: Uitgedinkte voorraadmaande van Junie tot Augustus 2027, nie 'n veilige raklewe nie. Die voorbeeld-piesangplukrekord is ook uitgedink; 'n veilige droogmetode en die hoeveelheid in voorraad word nie verskaf nie.

key: Invented stock months from August to October 2027, not a safe shelf life. Fermentation controls, a tested processing recipe and the amount held are not supplied.
english: Invented stock months from August to October 2027, not a safe shelf life. Fermentation controls, a tested processing recipe and the amount held are not supplied.
afrikaans_draft: Uitgedinkte voorraadmaande van Augustus tot Oktober 2027, nie 'n veilige raklewe nie. Fermentasiebeheer, 'n getoetste verwerkingsresep en die hoeveelheid in voorraad word nie verskaf nie.

key: Invented stock months from May to August 2027, not a safe shelf life. The processing method, a tested preservation recipe and the amount held are not supplied.
english: Invented stock months from May to August 2027, not a safe shelf life. The processing method, a tested preservation recipe and the amount held are not supplied.
afrikaans_draft: Uitgedinkte voorraadmaande van Mei tot Augustus 2027, nie 'n veilige raklewe nie. Die verwerkingsmetode, 'n getoetste preserveringsresep en die hoeveelheid in voorraad word nie verskaf nie.

key: Invented stock months from March to May 2027, not a safe shelf life. Made-up bought or carried stock; no harvest from this example mango tree is claimed. A safe drying method and the amount held are not supplied.
english: Invented stock months from March to May 2027, not a safe shelf life. Made-up bought or carried stock; no harvest from this example mango tree is claimed. A safe drying method and the amount held are not supplied.
afrikaans_draft: Uitgedinkte voorraadmaande van Maart tot Mei 2027, nie 'n veilige raklewe nie. Opgemaakte gekoopte of oorgedraagde voorraad; geen oes van hierdie voorbeeld-mangoboom word beweer nie. 'n Veilige droogmetode en die hoeveelheid in voorraad word nie verskaf nie.

key: Invented stock months from August to October 2027, not a safe shelf life. Made-up bought or carried nuts in shell; no harvest from these example trees is claimed. Storage conditions, kernel weight and the amount held are not supplied.
english: Invented stock months from August to October 2027, not a safe shelf life. Made-up bought or carried nuts in shell; no harvest from these example trees is claimed. Storage conditions, kernel weight and the amount held are not supplied.
afrikaans_draft: Uitgedinkte voorraadmaande van Augustus tot Oktober 2027, nie 'n veilige raklewe nie. Opgemaakte gekoopte of oorgedraagde neute in die dop; geen oes van hierdie voorbeeldbome word beweer nie. Bergingstoestande, pitgewig en die hoeveelheid in voorraad word nie verskaf nie.

key: Keep hives away from playgrounds, provide fresh water and use a dry site. Ask a registered beekeeper to check safe local placement before adding a hive.
english: Keep hives away from playgrounds, provide fresh water and use a dry site. Ask a registered beekeeper to check safe local placement before adding a hive.
afrikaans_draft: Hou korwe weg van speelterreine, voorsien vars water en gebruik 'n droë terrein. Vra 'n geregistreerde byeboer om veilige plaaslike plasing te kontroleer voordat jy 'n korf byvoeg.

key: Inspect every colony regularly for signs of notifiable bee disease and Cape-bee (Capensis) infection.
english: Inspect every colony regularly for signs of notifiable bee disease and Cape-bee (Capensis) infection.
afrikaans_draft: Inspekteer elke kolonie gereeld vir tekens van aanmeldbare byesiektes en infeksie deur Cape-bee (Capensis).

key: Keep written records of colonies, apiary locations, diseases, disease-control measures and colony losses with their reasons.
english: Keep written records of colonies, apiary locations, diseases, disease-control measures and colony losses with their reasons.
afrikaans_draft: Hou geskrewe rekords van kolonies, byeplaas-liggings, siektes, siektebeheermaatreëls en kolonieverliese met hul redes.

key: Do not move honeybees across the Cape bee line, or keep Cape bees north of it, without written approval.
english: Do not move honeybees across the Cape bee line, or keep Cape bees north of it, without written approval.
afrikaans_draft: Moenie heuningbye oor die Cape bee-lyn skuif, of Cape bees noord daarvan aanhou, sonder skriftelike goedkeuring nie.

key: Report any suspected notifiable disease (American foulbrood is listed); officials can order an infected colony destroyed.
english: Report any suspected notifiable disease (American foulbrood is listed); officials can order an infected colony destroyed.
afrikaans_draft: Meld enige vermoedelike aanmeldbare siekte aan (Amerikaanse vuilbroed is gelys); amptenare kan beveel dat 'n besmette kolonie vernietig word.

key: Cattle pens must not be overcrowded: there must be enough floor space for every animal to lie down at the same time.
english: Cattle pens must not be overcrowded: there must be enough floor space for every animal to lie down at the same time.
afrikaans_draft: Beeshokke mag nie oorbevolk wees nie: daar moet genoeg vloerruimte wees sodat elke dier terselfdertyd kan lê.

key: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: state Veterinary Services enforce isolation and movement restrictions.
english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: state Veterinary Services enforce isolation and movement restrictions.
afrikaans_draft: Bek-en-klouseer (FMD) is 'n beheerde dieresiekte ingevolge die Wet op Dieresiektes: die staat se Veeartsenydienste dwing isolasie en bewegingsbeperkings af.

key: Any suspected or confirmed brucellosis-related abortion in cattle must be reported to the State Veterinary office, as part of the national bovine brucellosis control scheme under the Animal Diseases Act.
english: Any suspected or confirmed brucellosis-related abortion in cattle must be reported to the State Veterinary office, as part of the national bovine brucellosis control scheme under the Animal Diseases Act.
afrikaans_draft: Enige vermoedelike of bevestigde brucellose-verwante misgeboorte by beeste moet by die Staatsveeartskantoor aangemeld word, as deel van die nasionale beesbrucellose-beheerskema ingevolge die Wet op Dieresiektes.

key: No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but a registered abattoir, with the exception below.
english: No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but a registered abattoir, with the exception below.
afrikaans_draft: Geen dier mag op enige ander plek as 'n geregistreerde abattoir geslag word nie, met die uitsondering hieronder.

key: Slaughter for the farmer's own household consumption, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.
english: Slaughter for the farmer's own household consumption, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.
afrikaans_draft: Slagting vir die boer se eie huishoudelike verbruik, of vir kulturele of godsdienstige doeleindes, is vrygestel van die abattoirreël.

key: In hotter, humid KZN, KZN DARD describes Nguni × Jersey dairy trials at Makhathini to combine milk potential with local adaptation. Hand milking with the calf present highlights competition between household milk and calf growth. Discuss adapted stock and feeding locally; commercial milk-recording totals do not forecast this system. Record calving, lactation stage and milk available after calf needs.
english: In hotter, humid KZN, KZN DARD describes Nguni × Jersey dairy trials at Makhathini to combine milk potential with local adaptation. Hand milking with the calf present highlights competition between household milk and calf growth. Discuss adapted stock and feeding locally; commercial milk-recording totals do not forecast this system. Record calving, lactation stage and milk available after calf needs.
afrikaans_draft: In die warmer, vogtige KZN beskryf KZN DARD Nguni × Jersey-suiwelproewe by Makhathini om melkpotensiaal met plaaslike aanpassing te kombineer. Handmelk met die kalf teenwoordig beklemtoon die kompetisie tussen huishoudelike melk en kalfgroei. Bespreek aangepaste vee en voeding plaaslik; kommersiële melkaantekeningtotale voorspel nie hierdie stelsel nie. Teken kalwing, laktasiestadium en melk wat beskikbaar is ná die kalf se behoeftes aan.

key: Cows must not be loaded for transport if their udders are distended with milk.
english: Cows must not be loaded for transport if their udders are distended with milk.
afrikaans_draft: Koeie mag nie vir vervoer gelaai word as hul uiers met melk opgeswel is nie.

key: A cull cow may be slaughtered only at an abattoir, except for the farmer's own consumption or for cultural or religious purposes.
english: A cull cow may be slaughtered only at an abattoir, except for the farmer's own consumption or for cultural or religious purposes.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Uitskotkoei mag slegs by 'n abattoir geslag word, behalwe vir die boer se eie verbruik of vir kulturele of godsdienstige doeleindes.

key: Newer South African commercial reference: SAPA 2024 reports average slaughter at 30–31 days with bird weight 1.8–1.85 kg. The primary range above remains the earlier 2022 reference at 32–33 days. These are commercial bird weights, not dressed meat kg or a village flock target. Record hatch or purchase age, feeding system, actual harvest date and weighed product basis.
english: Newer South African commercial reference: SAPA 2024 reports average slaughter at 30–31 days with bird weight 1.8–1.85 kg. The primary range above remains the earlier 2022 reference at 32–33 days. These are commercial bird weights, not dressed meat kg or a village flock target. Record hatch or purchase age, feeding system, actual harvest date and weighed product basis.
afrikaans_draft: Nuwer Suid-Afrikaanse kommersiële verwysing: SAPA 2024 meld gemiddelde slagting op 30–31 dae met 'n voëlgewig van 1.8–1.85 kg. Die primêre reeks hierbo bly die vroeëre 2022-verwysing op 32–33 dae. Dit is kommersiële voëlgewigte, nie kg skoongemaakte vleis of 'n teiken vir 'n dorpstrop nie. Teken uitbroei- of aankoopouderdom, voerstelsel, werklike oesdatum en die basis van die geweegde produk aan.

key: In free-range broiler production, indoor stocking must not exceed 15 birds per square metre of floor space.
english: In free-range broiler production, indoor stocking must not exceed 15 birds per square metre of floor space.
afrikaans_draft: In vrylopende braaikuikenproduksie mag die binnenshuise beladingsdigtheid nie 15 voëls per vierkante meter vloerruimte oorskry nie.

key: An owner or manager whose animals are, or may be, infected with a controlled animal disease must report it to the state veterinary director immediately.
english: An owner or manager whose animals are, or may be, infected with a controlled animal disease must report it to the state veterinary director immediately.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Eienaar of bestuurder wie se diere met 'n beheerde dieresiekte besmet is, of moontlik besmet is, moet dit onmiddellik by die staat se veeartsenydirekteur aanmeld.

key: Newcastle disease and notifiable avian influenza are on the state list of controlled and notifiable animal diseases.
english: Newcastle disease and notifiable avian influenza are on the state list of controlled and notifiable animal diseases.
afrikaans_draft: Newcastle-siekte en aanmeldbare voëlgriep is op die staat se lys van beheerde en aanmeldbare dieresiektes.

key: No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but an abattoir, with the exceptions below.
english: No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but an abattoir, with the exceptions below.
afrikaans_draft: Geen dier mag op enige ander plek as 'n abattoir geslag word nie, met die uitsonderings hieronder.

key: Slaughter for your own household, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.
english: Slaughter for your own household, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.
afrikaans_draft: Slagting vir jou eie huishouding, of vir kulturele of godsdienstige doeleindes, is vrygestel van die abattoirreël.

key: Scavenging village chickens grow more slowly than commercially-farmed birds and are more vulnerable to disease, parasites and predators.
english: Scavenging village chickens grow more slowly than commercially-farmed birds and are more vulnerable to disease, parasites and predators.
afrikaans_draft: Skarrelende dorpshoenders groei stadiger as kommersieel geteelde voëls en is meer kwesbaar vir siektes, parasiete en roofdiere.

key: The outdoor free-range area must not be overstocked: no more than 5 birds per square metre of range.
english: The outdoor free-range area must not be overstocked: no more than 5 birds per square metre of range.
afrikaans_draft: Die vrylopende buitearea mag nie oorbelaai word nie: nie meer as 5 voëls per vierkante meter buiteloop nie.

key: Ducks are one of the domesticated animal species listed in the Meat Safety Act, so its rules on registered abattoirs and hygiene apply to them.
english: Ducks are one of the domesticated animal species listed in the Meat Safety Act, so its rules on registered abattoirs and hygiene apply to them.
afrikaans_draft: Eende is een van die mak dierspesies wat in die Wet op Vleisveiligheid gelys word, daarom is sy reëls oor geregistreerde abattoirs en higiëne op hulle van toepassing.

key: Ducks slaughtered to be sold must be slaughtered at a registered abattoir; slaughter for the farmer's own consumption is exempt but that meat may not be sold.
english: Ducks slaughtered to be sold must be slaughtered at a registered abattoir; slaughter for the farmer's own consumption is exempt but that meat may not be sold.
afrikaans_draft: Eende wat geslag word om verkoop te word, moet by 'n geregistreerde abattoir geslag word; slagting vir die boer se eie verbruik is vrygestel, maar daardie vleis mag nie verkoop word nie.

key: Ducks are birds/poultry, so an outbreak of avian influenza in a duck flock is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act and must be reported to the state vet immediately.
english: Ducks are birds/poultry, so an outbreak of avian influenza in a duck flock is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act and must be reported to the state vet immediately.
afrikaans_draft: Eende is voëls/pluimvee, daarom is 'n uitbreking van voëlgriep in 'n eendtrop 'n beheerde dieresiekte ingevolge die Wet op Dieresiektes en moet dit onmiddellik by die staatsveearts aangemeld word.

key: South African Saanen reference by lactation number, not age in years: mean milk mass per standardised 305-day lactation was 947.3 kg at first parity, 1043.2 at second, 1073.4 at third, 1020.3 at fourth, 972.8 at fifth, 901.6 at sixth and 775.4 at ≥7th. These ARC milk-recorded groups were mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Record actual kidding date, lactation number and collected milk; do not divide these totals evenly into months.
english: South African Saanen reference by lactation number, not age in years: mean milk mass per standardised 305-day lactation was 947.3 kg at first parity, 1043.2 at second, 1073.4 at third, 1020.3 at fourth, 972.8 at fifth, 901.6 at sixth and 775.4 at ≥7th. These ARC milk-recorded groups were mostly intensive/semi-intensive stud herds. Record actual kidding date, lactation number and collected milk; do not divide these totals evenly into months.
afrikaans_draft: Suid-Afrikaanse Saanen-verwysing volgens laktasienommer, nie ouderdom in jare nie: gemiddelde melkmassa per gestandaardiseerde 305-dag-laktasie was 947.3 kg by eerste pariteit, 1043.2 by tweede, 1073.4 by derde, 1020.3 by vierde, 972.8 by vyfde, 901.6 by sesde en 775.4 by ≥7de. key: At Putukwane near Polokwane, 179 lactating does under extensive feeding with irregular supplementation were observed for 210 days after kidding. Mean milk mass was 1.45 kg/day for Saanen, 0.75 for British Alpine and 0.56 for Toggenburg during observed lactation. Early lactation exceeded mid and late lactation; March–April kidding outperformed October–November in this cohort. These conditions differ from stud-herd records. Discuss adapted stock and feed locally; these are not litres/day or year-round promises.
english: At Putukwane near Polokwane, 179 lactating does under extensive feeding with irregular supplementation were observed for 210 days after kidding. Mean milk mass was 1.45 kg/day for Saanen, 0.75 for British Alpine and 0.56 for Toggenburg during observed lactation. Early lactation exceeded mid and late lactation; March–April kidding outperformed October–November in this cohort. These conditions differ from stud-herd records. Discuss adapted stock and feed locally; these are not litres/day or year-round promises.
afrikaans_draft: By Putukwane naby Polokwane is 179 lakterende ooie onder ekstensiewe voeding met ongereelde aanvulling vir 210 dae ná lamming waargeneem. Gemiddelde melkmassa was 1.45 kg/dag vir Saanen, 0.75 vir British Alpine en 0.56 vir Toggenburg tydens die waargenome laktasie. Vroeë laktasie het middel- en laat laktasie oorskry; lamming in Maart–April het beter gevaar as Oktober–November in hierdie groep. Hierdie toestande verskil van stoetkudde-rekords. Bespreek aangepaste vee en voer plaaslik; dit is nie liter/dag of beloftes vir die hele jaar nie.

key: An owner must not let a goat stay in a dirty or parasite-infested condition, and must get veterinary or other treatment for a sick, injured or diseased animal when able to.
english: An owner must not let a goat stay in a dirty or parasite-infested condition, and must get veterinary or other treatment for a sick, injured or diseased animal when able to.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Eienaar mag nie toelaat dat 'n bok in 'n vuil of parasietbesmette toestand bly nie, en moet veeartsenykundige of ander behandeling vir 'n siek, beseerde of sieklike dier kry wanneer hy of sy kan.

key: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: veterinary services enforce isolation and movement restrictions, and a suspected case must be reported.
english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a controlled animal disease under the Animal Diseases Act: veterinary services enforce isolation and movement restrictions, and a suspected case must be reported.

key: Inside a declared FMD-affected zone, goats and their products (including milk) cannot be moved into, out of, or within the zone without a state veterinary movement permit and compliance with its conditions.
english: Inside a declared FMD-affected zone, goats and their products (including milk) cannot be moved into, out of, or within the zone without a state veterinary movement permit and compliance with its conditions.

key: A goat may only be slaughtered for sale at a registered abattoir under the Meat Safety Act (relevant when culled dairy does or male kids are sold for meat); slaughtering for the farmer's own consumption, or for cultural/religious purposes, is exempt but that meat may not then be sold.
english: A goat may only be slaughtered for sale at a registered abattoir under the Meat Safety Act (relevant when culled dairy does or male kids are sold for meat); slaughtering for the farmer's own consumption, or for cultural/religious purposes, is exempt but that meat may not then be sold.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Bok mag slegs vir verkoop by 'n geregistreerde abattoir geslag word ingevolge die Wet op Vleisveiligheid (van belang wanneer uitgeskote melkooie of bokramlammers vir vleis verkoop word); slagting vir die boer se eie verbruik, of vir kulturele/godsdienstige doeleindes, is vrygestel, maar daardie vleis mag dan nie verkoop word nie.

key: The 2016 government goat manual distinguishes indigenous, Boer, Savanna and Kalahari Red meat-purpose stock from milk/fibre breeds, with breeding objectives and individual birth, weaning, weight and sale records. Uncontrolled communal mating can produce births at any time; that does not establish meat or weaned-kid availability all year. Choose stock for the local system and record survival and product stage before forecasting quantities.
english: The 2016 government goat manual distinguishes indigenous, Boer, Savanna and Kalahari Red meat-purpose stock from milk/fibre breeds, with breeding objectives and individual birth, weaning, weight and sale records. Uncontrolled communal mating can produce births at any time; that does not establish meat or weaned-kid availability all year. Choose stock for the local system and record survival and product stage before forecasting quantities.
afrikaans_draft: Die regering se bokhandleiding van 2016 onderskei inheemse, Boer-, Savanna- en Kalahari Red-vee vir vleisdoeleindes van melk-/veselrasse, met teeldoelwitte en individuele geboorte-, speen-, gewig- en verkooprekords. Onbeheerde gemeenskaplike dekking kan op enige tyd geboortes lewer; dit bewys nie dat vleis of gespeende lammers die hele jaar beskikbaar is nie. Kies vee vir die plaaslike stelsel en teken oorlewing en produkstadium aan voordat jy hoeveelhede voorspel.

The manual supplies no verified edible kg per breeding sow for this plan.

key: African swine fever (ASF) is listed as a controlled animal disease pertaining to pigs under the Animal Diseases Act; warthogs and Ornithodorus ticks are carriers/vectors.
english: African swine fever (ASF) is listed as a controlled animal disease pertaining to pigs under the Animal Diseases Act; warthogs and Ornithodorus ticks are carriers/vectors.

key: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is also listed as a controlled animal disease pertaining to pigs under the Animal Diseases Act.
english: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is also listed as a controlled animal disease pertaining to pigs under the Animal Diseases Act.
afrikaans_draft: Bek-en-klouseer (FMD) is ook ingevolge die Wet op Dieresiektes gelys as 'n beheerde dieresiekte wat op varke betrekking het.

key: A pig may not be slaughtered anywhere but a registered abattoir, except for own household consumption or cultural/religious purposes.
english: A pig may not be slaughtered anywhere but a registered abattoir, except for own household consumption or cultural/religious purposes.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Vark mag nêrens anders as by 'n geregistreerde abattoir geslag word nie, behalwe vir eie huishoudelike verbruik of kulturele/godsdienstige doeleindes.

key: South African grower reference: New Zealand White and Phendula rabbits in the 2017 Stellenbosch trial were slaughtered at about 11 weeks from birth. Overall means were 2.62 kg live slaughter weight, 1.55 kg hot carcass, 1.48 kg chilled carcass and 1.26 kg reference carcass with head and red offal removed, still including bones. Balanced pellets and water were freely available in a grower house. These weights are not boneless meat or annual doe output; do not multiply them by the unrelated FAO backyard target.
english: South African grower reference: New Zealand White and Phendula rabbits in the 2017 Stellenbosch trial were slaughtered at about 11 weeks from birth. Overall means were 2.62 kg live slaughter weight, 1.55 kg hot carcass, 1.48 kg chilled carcass and 1.26 kg reference carcass with head and red offal removed, still including bones. Balanced pellets and water were freely available in a grower house. These weights are not boneless meat or annual doe output; do not multiply them by the unrelated FAO backyard target.
afrikaans_draft: Suid-Afrikaanse groeier-verwysing: New Zealand White- en Phendula-konyne in die Stellenbosch-proef van 2017 is op ongeveer 11 weke ná geboorte geslag. Algehele gemiddeldes was 2.62 kg lewende slaggewig, 1.55 kg warm karkas, 1.48 kg verkoelde karkas en 1.26 kg verwysingskarkas met kop en rooi afval verwyder, steeds met bene. Gebalanseerde korrels en water was vrylik beskikbaar in 'n groeihok. Hierdie gewigte is nie beenlose vleis of jaarlikse opbrengs per ooi nie; moenie hulle met die onverwante FAO-agterplaasteiken vermenigvuldig nie.

key: Rabbits are one of the domesticated animal species listed in the Meat Safety Act, so the Act's rules on abattoirs and hygiene apply to them, as they do to ducks and other listed species.
english: Rabbits are one of the domesticated animal species listed in the Meat Safety Act, so the Act's rules on abattoirs and hygiene apply to them, as they do to ducks and other listed species.
afrikaans_draft: Konyne is een van die mak dierspesies wat in die Wet op Vleisveiligheid gelys word, daarom is die Wet se reëls oor abattoirs en higiëne op hulle van toepassing, soos op eende en ander gelyste spesies.

key: Rabbits slaughtered to be sold must be slaughtered at a registered abattoir; slaughter for the farmer's own consumption is exempt from this rule but the meat from it may not be sold.
english: Rabbits slaughtered to be sold must be slaughtered at a registered abattoir; slaughter for the farmer's own consumption is exempt from this rule but the meat from it may not be sold.
afrikaans_draft: Konyne wat geslag word om verkoop te word, moet by 'n geregistreerde abattoir geslag word; slagting vir die boer se eie verbruik is van hierdie reël vrygestel, maar die vleis daarvan mag nie verkoop word nie.

key: The government sheep manual describes controlled breeding at Mara Research Station, Limpopo: June–July mating and November–December lambing to match rain and grass. This is one station breeding calendar, not mutton harvest months. Match adapted meat-purpose stock and feed locally, then record birth, survival, weaning and actual slaughter or sale; lambs born per ewe are not edible kg.
english: The government sheep manual describes controlled breeding at Mara Research Station, Limpopo: June–July mating and November–December lambing to match rain and grass. This is one station breeding calendar, not mutton harvest months. Match adapted meat-purpose stock and feed locally, then record birth, survival, weaning and actual slaughter or sale; lambs born per ewe are not edible kg.
afrikaans_draft: Die regering se skaaphandleiding beskryf beheerde teling by die Mara-navorsingstasie, Limpopo: dekking in Junie–Julie en lamming in November–Desember om by reën en gras te pas. Dit is een stasie se teelkalender, nie maande vir skaapvleisoes nie. Laat aangepaste vee vir vleisdoeleindes en voer plaaslik ooreenstem, en teken dan geboorte, oorlewing, speen en werklike slagting of verkoop aan; lammers gebore per ooi is nie eetbare kg nie.

key: Sheep must not be penned overcrowded: at least 0.56 square metres of floor space per sheep so every animal can lie down.
english: Sheep must not be penned overcrowded: at least 0.56 square metres of floor space per sheep so every animal can lie down.
afrikaans_draft: Skape mag nie oorbevolk in hokke aangehou word nie: ten minste 0.56 vierkante meter vloerruimte per skaap sodat elke dier kan lê.

key: Electric prodders, sticks or goads may not be used on sheep.
english: Electric prodders, sticks or goads may not be used on sheep.
afrikaans_draft: Elektriese porstokke, stokke of dryfstokke mag nie op skape gebruik word nie.

key: Livestock must be given water and fed as soon as they reach their night camp or final destination.
english: Livestock must be given water and fed as soon as they reach their night camp or final destination.
afrikaans_draft: Vee moet water en voer kry sodra hulle hul nagkamp of eindbestemming bereik.

key: Injured, disabled or blind sheep must be given priority slaughter, or emergency slaughter, to prevent further pain or distress.
english: Injured, disabled or blind sheep must be given priority slaughter, or emergency slaughter, to prevent further pain or distress.
afrikaans_draft: Beseerde, gestremde of blinde skape moet voorrang by slagting, of noodslagting, kry om verdere pyn of nood te voorkom.

english: Despite foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in South Africa, wool exports continue under the inactivation clause of the OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health) rules.

key: The reported weaning rate is 149%, or 1.49 kids weaned per doe mated. The source describes observations over twenty years for extensive Boer does at 295 mm rainfall; it does not state kids weaned per doe per calendar year. This is a reproductive outcome, not kg of live animals or dressed meat. A separate mean litter size of 1.93 kids born per parturition has a different denominator and stage and is not merged into this figure.
english: The reported weaning rate is 149%, or 1.49 kids weaned per doe mated. The source describes observations over twenty years for extensive Boer does at 295 mm rainfall; it does not state kids weaned per doe per calendar year. This is a reproductive outcome, not kg of live animals or dressed meat. A separate mean litter size of 1.93 kids born per parturition has a different denominator and stage and is not merged into this figure.
afrikaans_draft: Die aangemelde speenkoers is 149%, of 1.49 lammers gespeen per gedekte ooi. Die bron beskryf waarnemings oor twintig jaar vir ekstensiewe Boer-ooie by 295 mm reënval; dit noem nie lammers gespeen per ooi per kalenderjaar nie. Dit is 'n voortplantingsuitkoms, nie kg lewende diere of skoongemaakte vleis nie. 'n Aparte gemiddelde werpselgrootte van 1.93 lammers gebore per geboorte het 'n ander noemer en stadium en word nie by hierdie syfer saamgevoeg nie.

key: FAO general backyard target, not a South African observed rate. The 30–35 young per doe annually have reached slaughter or reproduction age after allowance for post-weaning loss; they are not merely weaned and are not kg of meat. The source models six litters and 5.5 surviving young per litter, describing a 30-rabbit objective; an extra litter raises its stated objective to 35. Do not combine this backyard target with grower-house carcass weight from a different trial.
english: FAO general backyard target, not a South African observed rate. The 30–35 young per doe annually have reached slaughter or reproduction age after allowance for post-weaning loss; they are not merely weaned and are not kg of meat. The source models six litters and 5.5 surviving young per litter, describing a 30-rabbit objective; an extra litter raises its stated objective to 35. Do not combine this backyard target with grower-house carcass weight from a different trial.
afrikaans_draft: FAO se algemene agterplaasteiken, nie 'n Suid-Afrikaanse waargenome tempo nie. Die 30–35 kleintjies per ooi per jaar het slag- of teelouderdom bereik ná voorsiening vir verliese ná speen; hulle is nie bloot gespeen nie en is nie kg vleis nie. Die bron modelleer ses werpsels en 5.5 oorlewende kleintjies per werpsel, en beskryf 'n doelwit van 30 konyne; 'n ekstra werpsel verhoog sy gestelde doelwit tot 35. Moenie hierdie agterplaasteiken kombineer met groeihok-karkasgewig uit 'n ander proef nie.

key: outputUnit is 'lambs born/ewe/year' rather than the suggested 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' or 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': the source explains 'Measuring accurate lambing percentages for smallholder sheep farmers is challenging as these farmers mostly farm extensively and do not keep records', and instead calculates 'Lambs born per ewe (as recorded from the surveys based on interviews with individual respondents)' - a lambing (born), not weaning, figure, self-reported by smallholder farmers rather than measured/weighed. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 lambs born/ewe/year; the range [0.61, 1.39] spans the three Western Cape smallholder districts surveyed (Eden, Central Karoo, West Coast), all from this one study/quote - not merged with any other document. The same paper separately states a COMMERCIAL extensive benchmark of 110-156% lambing and 94-132% weaning (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), explicitly 'expressed over ewes joined' (a different denominator/system) - not merged into this smallholder range.
