The same paper separately states a COMMERCIAL extensive benchmark of 110-156% lambing and 94-132% weaning (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), explicitly 'expressed over ewes joined' (a different denominator/system) - not merged into this smallholder range.
afrikaans_draft: outputUnit is 'lambs born/ewe/year' eerder as die voorgestelde 'kg live weight/lamb at weaning or slaughter' of 'lambs weaned/ewe/year': die bron verduidelik 'Measuring accurate lambing percentages for smallholder sheep farmers is challenging as these farmers mostly farm extensively and do not keep records', en bereken eerder 'Lambs born per ewe (as recorded from the surveys based on interviews with individual respondents)' - 'n lamsyfer (gebore), nie 'n speensyfer nie, selfgerapporteer deur kleinboere eerder as gemeet/geweeg. 139%=1.39, 83%=0.83, 61%=0.61 lammers gebore/ooi/jaar; die reeks [0.61, 1.39] strek oor die drie Wes-Kaapse kleinboerdistrikte wat ondervra is (Eden, Sentraal-Karoo, Weskus), alles uit hierdie een studie/aanhaling - nie by enige ander dokument saamgevoeg nie. Dieselfde artikel noem afsonderlik 'n KOMMERSIËLE ekstensiewe maatstaf van 110-156% lamming en 94-132% speen (Snyman & Herselman, 2005), uitdruklik 'expressed over ewes joined' ('n ander noemer/stelsel) - nie by hierdie kleinboerreeks saamgevoeg nie.

key: 1994/95 total kg/tree at age 14: HLH Mauritius 87.87, Red McLean 30.58, Fay Zee Siu 27.92. Marketable weights are respectively 77.87, 28.42 and 23.38 kg/tree. One season and varying management, canopy and cultivar prevent a universal annual curve or copying total into saleable kg. The authors explicitly caution yield comparisons. english: 1994/95 total kg/tree at age 14: HLH Mauritius 87.87, Red McLean 30.58, Fay Zee Siu 27.92. Marketable weights are respectively 77.87, 28.42 and 23.38 kg/tree. Een seisoen en wisselende bestuur, kroon en kultivar verhoed 'n universele jaarkurwe of die oordrag van die totaal na verkoopbare kg. Die outeurs waarsku uitdruklik teen opbrengsvergelykings. Die aparte KZN-gids gee konserwatief 2,000, gemiddeld 3,000–5,000 en goed 6,000+ kg/ha, nie kg/boom per ouderdom nie.

The source calls these comparative, not absolute. Different cultivars and orchard groups do not establish a universal age-yield ramp.
afrikaans_draft: ARC Infruitec Citrusdal, 1990. 10de blad: Kadota 23.5, White Genoa 22.6, Calimyrna 16.5 kg/boom/jaar. 7de blad: Tena 12.1, Black Mission 6.8, Conadria 3.5, Ephesus 20.6, Excell 15.2, Deanna 59.0, Kadota 24.3 kg/boom/jaar. key: About years 4–5 in the KZN horticultural guide. Context is frost-free warm, humid subtropical production areas; cultivar, propagation age and field establishment are not specified. This is a first-crop reference, not a guaranteed local quantity or full-bearing age.
english: About years 4–5 in the KZN horticultural guide. Context is frost-free warm, humid subtropical production areas; cultivar, propagation age and field establishment are not specified. This is a first-crop reference, not a guaranteed local quantity or full-bearing age.
afrikaans_draft: Ongeveer jaar 4–5 in die KZN-tuinbougids. Die konteks is rypvrye warm, vogtige subtropiese produksiegebiede; kultivar, voortplantingsouderdom en vestiging in die veld word nie gespesifiseer nie. Dit is 'n eerste-oes-verwysing, nie 'n gewaarborgde plaaslike hoeveelheid of ouderdom van volle draag nie.

key: African Delight: age 3, 12,000–20,000 kg/ha; age 4, 20,000–35,000 kg/ha; mature orchards, 35,000–50,000 kg/ha. Full-bearing age and matched planting density are not stated; do not convert using Ruby Crisp spacing or interpolate a per-tree curve.
english: African Delight: age 3, 12,000–20,000 kg/ha; age 4, 20,000–35,000 kg/ha; mature orchards, 35,000–50,000 kg/ha. Full-bearing age and matched planting density are not stated; do not convert using Ruby Crisp spacing or interpolate a per-tree curve.
afrikaans_draft: African Delight: ouderdom 3, 12,000–20,000 kg/ha; ouderdom 4, 20,000–35,000 kg/ha; volwasse boorde, 35,000–50,000 kg/ha. Ouderdom van volle draag en ooreenstemmende plantdigtheid word nie gestel nie; moenie met Ruby Crisp-spasiëring omskakel of 'n kurwe per boom interpoleer nie.

key: Allow for slow growth, frost sensitivity and roots that exploit rock crevices.
english: Allow for slow growth, frost sensitivity and roots that exploit rock crevices.
afrikaans_draft: Maak voorsiening vir stadige groei, rypgevoeligheid en wortels wat rotsskeure benut.

key: Ask a local botanical nursery to confirm the plant's identity and suitable provenance; no primary named cultivar or exact frost threshold was verified.
english: Ask a local botanical nursery to confirm the plant's identity and suitable provenance; no primary named cultivar or exact frost threshold was verified.
afrikaans_draft: Vra 'n plaaslike botaniese kwekery om die plant se identiteit en geskikte herkoms te bevestig; geen primêre benoemde kultivar of presiese rypdrempel is geverifieer nie.

key: Ask a specialist local nursery for identified C. genistoides and a locally proven selection; different ecotypes do not perform equally.
english: Ask a specialist local nursery for identified C. genistoides and a locally proven selection; different ecotypes do not perform equally.
afrikaans_draft: Vra 'n gespesialiseerde plaaslike kwekery vir geïdentifiseerde C. genistoides en 'n plaaslik beproefde seleksie; verskillende ekotipes presteer nie ewe goed nie.

key: Ask for Rhoicissus tridentata and record local ripe-fruit months. Do not use medicinal or animal root use as food evidence.
english: Ask for Rhoicissus tridentata and record local ripe-fruit months. Do not use medicinal or animal root use as food evidence.
afrikaans_draft: Vra vir Rhoicissus tridentata en teken plaaslike maande vir ryp vrugte aan. Moenie medisinale gebruik of gebruik van die wortel vir diere as bewys van voedsel gebruik nie.

key: Ask for identified Morus nigra fruiting material with a locally observed season. Do not use a generic black-fruited mulberry or fruitless ornamental as proof of this product.
english: Ask for identified Morus nigra fruiting material with a locally observed season. Do not use a generic black-fruited mulberry or fruitless ornamental as proof of this product.
afrikaans_draft: Vra vir geïdentifiseerde Morus nigra-vrugdraende materiaal met 'n plaaslik waargenome seisoen. Moenie 'n generiese moerbei met swart vrugte of 'n vrugtelose sierplant as bewys van hierdie produk gebruik nie.

key: Assumed planting variety: Sunrise Solo, subject to a frost-free, drained growing position. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
english: Assumed planting variety: Sunrise Solo, subject to a frost-free, drained growing position. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
afrikaans_draft: Aangenome plantvariëteit: Sunrise Solo, onderhewig aan 'n rypvrye, gedreineerde groeiplek. Bevestig sy plaaslike plukmaande; die kalender gebruik 'n gemerkte streeksverwysing waar daar 'n bron is.

key: Assumed planting variety: Tommy Atkins, subject to local flowering and frost checks. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
english: Assumed planting variety: Tommy Atkins, subject to local flowering and frost checks. Confirm its local picking months; the calendar uses a labelled regional reference where sourced.
afrikaans_draft: Aangenome plantvariëteit: Tommy Atkins, onderhewig aan plaaslike blom- en rypkontroles. Bevestig sy plaaslike plukmaande; die kalender gebruik 'n gemerkte streeksverwysing waar daar 'n bron is.

key: Assumes light frost; check severity locally.
english: Assumes light frost; check severity locally.
afrikaans_draft: Gaan uit van ligte ryp; kontroleer die felheid plaaslik.

english: Avoid frost and waterlogging. Honey Gold needs male and female plants; Sunrise Solo is hermaphrodite.
afrikaans_draft: Vermy ryp en versuiping. Honey Gold het manlike en vroulike plante nodig; Sunrise Solo is hermafrodities.

english: Best in summer-rain areas with little frost; protect young trees in colder sites.

english: Buy exact-species stock for the verified intended use. Do not treat medicinal or wildlife-fruit evidence as a fresh household-food forecast.

english: Buying advice: choose a meat strain and supplier batch plan; confirm brooding, feed, water and slaughter arrangements.
afrikaans_draft: Koopadvies: kies 'n vleisstam en 'n verskaffer se plan vir groepe; bevestig reëlings vir broei, voer, water en slag.

english: Buying advice: for egg production, request vaccinated point-of-lay pullets from a layer supplier, with age, feeding and vaccination records.
afrikaans_draft: Koopadvies: vir eierproduksie, vra 'n lêhenverskaffer vir ingeënte lêgereed jong henne, met rekords van ouderdom, voeding en inenting.

key: Buying advice: match breed/stock to the product, local feed, climate and care capacity; confirm with a local livestock or beekeeping adviser.
english: Buying advice: match breed/stock to the product, local feed, climate and care capacity; confirm with a local livestock or beekeeping adviser.
afrikaans_draft: Koopadvies: laat ras/voorraad by die produk, plaaslike voer, klimaat en versorgingsvermoë pas; bevestig met 'n plaaslike vee- of byeboerdery-adviseur.

english: Check chilling, support and pruning system before planting. Autumn-bearing varieties must not inherit a spring-bearing calendar.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer kouebehoefte, ondersteuning en snoeistelsel voordat jy plant. Herfsdraende variëteite mag nie 'n lentedraende kalender oorneem nie.

english: Check frost, drainage and flowering-season disease pressure. Heat and sunburn sensitivity differ between cultivars.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer ryp, dreinering en siektedruk in die blomseisoen. Gevoeligheid vir hitte en sonbrand verskil tussen kultivars.

english: Check local frost and water. Food processing needs a suitable method and explicit kept-stock records.

key: Coastal plant; allow for thorns near children and paths.
english: Coastal plant; allow for thorns near children and paths.
afrikaans_draft: Kusplant; hou rekening met dorings naby kinders en paadjies.

english: Cold-area check: these subtropical references do not establish suitability here. Confirm a frost-protected position before buying.
afrikaans_draft: Kontrole vir koue gebiede: hierdie subtropiese verwysings bewys nie geskiktheid hier nie. Bevestig 'n plek wat teen ryp beskerm is voordat jy koop.

english: Confirm Carpobrotus deliciosus; do not substitute another sour-fig species merely because the common name matches.
afrikaans_draft: Bevestig Carpobrotus deliciosus; moenie 'n ander sour-fig-spesie in die plek daarvan gebruik bloot omdat die algemene naam ooreenstem nie.

english: Confirm Rhoicissus digitata; other wild-grape species have different descriptions and cannot supply its dates.

english: Confirm botanical identity before using this catalogue entry as a separate fruit enterprise. Do not count it twice merely because the same plant is also labelled C. bispinosa.

english: Confirm cultivar-specific chilling and spring frost risk. Mean winter temperature is not a chill-hour measurement.

key: Confirm exact species with a qualified indigenous nursery. Do not substitute genus-level berry claims for identification.
english: Confirm exact species with a qualified indigenous nursery. Do not substitute genus-level berry claims for identification.
afrikaans_draft: Bevestig die presiese spesie met 'n gekwalifiseerde inheemse kwekery. Moenie bewerings oor bessies op genusvlak in die plek van identifikasie gebruik nie.

english: Discuss the named SA trial cultivars with a local seed supplier or extension adviser. Current purchase availability and suitability for this site are unverified; do not substitute a cultivar silently.

english: Dried-fruit flour is a documented traditional end use, not a supplied safe storage duration. October–March is flowering.
afrikaans_draft: Meel van gedroogde vrugte is 'n gedokumenteerde tradisionele eindgebruik, nie 'n verskafte veilige bergingstydperk nie. Oktober–Maart is die blomtyd.

english: Edibility is recorded for this exact variety; do not apply the common name boer-bean to every species as food evidence.

english: Frost- and drought-hardy; establishment care still matters.

english: Full production around years 12–13 in the general KZN guide. Cultivar, propagation, density and management affect actual output; mature ages do not automatically create an annual kg/tree curve.
afrikaans_draft: Volle produksie rondom jaar 12–13 in die algemene KZN-gids. Kultivar, voortplanting, digtheid en bestuur beïnvloed werklike opbrengs; volwasse ouderdomme skep nie outomaties 'n jaarlikse kg/boom-kurwe nie.

key: Government guidance identifies pods, severe-frost exclusion, irrigation in arid areas and variation between seedling trees. It recommends grafted material and pollen provision; not every tree has the same crop.
english: Government guidance identifies pods, severe-frost exclusion, irrigation in arid areas and variation between seedling trees. It recommends grafted material and pollen provision; not every tree has the same crop.
afrikaans_draft: Regeringsriglyne identifiseer peule, uitsluiting van strawwe ryp, besproeiing in droë gebiede en variasie tussen saailingbome. Dit beveel geënte materiaal en voorsiening vir stuifmeel aan; nie elke boom het dieselfde oes nie.

key: Grafted mango stock in the KZN guide generally begins bearing after 3–4 years. Context is frost-free tropical/warm subtropical production with low humidity at flowering, including dry Zululand, Valley Bushveld and Lowveld. The text distinguishes grafted stock from seed-raised Peach/Sabre; do not apply this age to an unrecorded seedling or infer yearly kg.
english: Grafted mango stock in the KZN guide generally begins bearing after 3–4 years. Context is frost-free tropical/warm subtropical production with low humidity at flowering, including dry Zululand, Valley Bushveld and Lowveld. The text distinguishes grafted stock from seed-raised Peach/Sabre; do not apply this age to an unrecorded seedling or infer yearly kg.
afrikaans_draft: Geënte mangovoorraad in die KZN-gids begin gewoonlik ná 3–4 jaar dra. Die konteks is rypvrye tropiese/warm subtropiese produksie met lae humiditeit tydens blom, insluitend droë Zoeloeland, Valley Bushveld en die Laeveld. Die teks onderskei geënte voorraad van Peach/Sabre wat uit saad gekweek is; moenie hierdie ouderdom op 'n onaangetekende saailing toepas of jaarlikse kg aflei nie.

key: Grafted stock generally first bears around 3–4 years and may remain productive 20 years or longer under the guide conditions. Seed-raised trees are a separate planting-material case. Frost, wet spring flowering conditions, cultivar and field establishment must be checked; longevity is not an age-yield curve.
english: Grafted stock generally first bears around 3–4 years and may remain productive 20 years or longer under the guide conditions. Seed-raised trees are a separate planting-material case. Frost, wet spring flowering conditions, cultivar and field establishment must be checked; longevity is not an age-yield curve.
afrikaans_draft: Geënte voorraad dra gewoonlik eers rondom 3–4 jaar en kan onder die gids se toestande 20 jaar of langer produktief bly. Bome wat uit saad gekweek is, is 'n aparte geval van plantmateriaal. Ryp, nat blomtoestande in die lente, kultivar en vestiging in die veld moet gekontroleer word; lewensduur is nie 'n ouderdom-opbrengs-kurwe nie.

key: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal Midlands bioclimatic group 2), with intensive irrigation and nutrition. Age 3: 10,000 kg/ha; age 6: 20,000 kg/ha; sustainable average about 22,500 kg/ha. Same-study density permits equivalents of 50 kg/tree at age 3 and 100 kg/tree at age 6; there is no reference for every intermediate age. These orchard benchmarks are conditional on good resources, comparable climate and timely orchard management, including Phytophthora control and thinning; do not auto-fill farm quantities.
english: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal Midlands bioclimatic group 2), with intensive irrigation and nutrition. Age 3: 10,000 kg/ha; age 6: 20,000 kg/ha; sustainable average about 22,500 kg/ha. Same-study density permits equivalents of 50 kg/tree at age 3 and 100 kg/tree at age 6; there is no reference for every intermediate age. These orchard benchmarks are conditional on good resources, comparable climate and timely orchard management, including Phytophthora control and thinning; do not auto-fill farm quantities.
afrikaans_draft: Hass op Duke 7, aanvanklik 200 bome/ha by Bruyns Hill (Natalse Middelland bioklimatiese groep 2), met intensiewe besproeiing en voeding. Ouderdom 3: 10,000 kg/ha; ouderdom 6: 20,000 kg/ha; volhoubare gemiddelde ongeveer 22,500 kg/ha. Die digtheid in dieselfde studie laat ekwivalente van 50 kg/boom op ouderdom 3 en 100 kg/boom op ouderdom 6 toe; daar is nie 'n verwysing vir elke tussenliggende ouderdom nie. Hierdie boordmaatstawwe is afhanklik van goeie hulpbronne, 'n vergelykbare klimaat en tydige boordbestuur, insluitend Phytophthora-beheer en uitdunning; moenie plaashoeveelhede outomaties invul nie.

key: Imperial has a December reference at Robertson. This is a local trial candidate, not advice for frost-free coastal KZN.
english: Imperial has a December reference at Robertson. This is a local trial candidate, not advice for frost-free coastal KZN.
afrikaans_draft: Imperial het 'n Desember-verwysing by Robertson. Dit is 'n plaaslike proefkandidaat, nie advies vir rypvrye kus-KZN nie.

key: KZN advice describes Vaccinium species and lists rabbiteye cultivars Tifblue, Beckyblue and Climax. This reference is not specific to southern highbush blueberries.
english: KZN advice describes Vaccinium species and lists rabbiteye cultivars Tifblue, Beckyblue and Climax. This reference is not specific to southern highbush blueberries.
afrikaans_draft: KZN-advies beskryf Vaccinium-spesies en lys die rabbiteye-kultivars Tifblue, Beckyblue en Climax. Hierdie verwysing is nie spesifiek vir southern highbush-bloubessies nie.

key: Keep preserved-stock dates separate from fruit picking; a canning end use does not establish safe shelf life.
english: Keep preserved-stock dates separate from fruit picking; a canning end use does not establish safe shelf life.
afrikaans_draft: Hou datums vir gepreserveerde voorraad apart van vrugpluk; 'n eindgebruik vir inmaak bepaal nie 'n veilige raklewe nie.

key: Keep this tree in mapped inventory and do not count it as household food until identity and a safe edible-leaf preparation are reviewed.
english: Keep this tree in mapped inventory and do not count it as household food until identity and a safe edible-leaf preparation are reviewed.
afrikaans_draft: Hou hierdie boom in die gekarteerde inventaris en moenie dit as huishoudelike voedsel tel nie totdat identiteit en 'n veilige voorbereiding van eetbare blare hersien is.

english: Large amounts of its leaves can taint dairy milk, according to SANBI; this is not a ration recommendation.
afrikaans_draft: Groot hoeveelhede van sy blare kan volgens SANBI melk van melkkoeie 'n bysmaak gee; dit is nie 'n rantsoenaanbeveling nie.

key: Match the cultivar to table olives or oil. Check drainage, irrigation and winter conditions; humid summer rainfall can bring disease problems.
english: Match the cultivar to table olives or oil. Check drainage, irrigation and winter conditions; humid summer rainfall can bring disease problems.
afrikaans_draft: Laat die kultivar by tafelolywe of olie pas. Kontroleer dreinering, besproeiing en wintertoestande; vogtige somerreën kan siekteprobleme meebring.

key: Match the cultivar to the microclimate; avoid hard frost and poorly drained ground.
english: Match the cultivar to the microclimate; avoid hard frost and poorly drained ground.
afrikaans_draft: Laat die kultivar by die mikroklimaat pas; vermy strawwe ryp en swak gedreineerde grond.

key: Match the selected duration type and sowing date to local frost, rainfall and water availability; the trials retain their own conditions.
english: Match the selected duration type and sowing date to local frost, rainfall and water availability; the trials retain their own conditions.
afrikaans_draft: Laat die gekose duurtipe en saaidatum by plaaslike ryp, reënval en beskikbaarheid van water pas; die proewe behou hul eie toestande.

key: Match this frost-sensitive plant to dry saline/coastal conditions. Its accumulated salts can return to the soil as plants die.
english: Match this frost-sensitive plant to dry saline/coastal conditions. Its accumulated salts can return to the soil as plants die.
afrikaans_draft: Laat hierdie rypgevoelige plant by droë soutagtige/kustoestande pas. Sy opgehoopte soute kan na die grond terugkeer wanneer plante doodgaan.

key: Match warm summers with cool, frost-free winter conditions for flowering; protect from wind and keep young plants watered.
english: Match warm summers with cool, frost-free winter conditions for flowering; protect from wind and keep young plants watered.
afrikaans_draft: Laat warm somers by koel, rypvrye wintertoestande vir blom pas; beskerm teen wind en hou jong plante natgelei.

key: Observed frost conflicts with this proposed reference; confirm a protected growing position before buying.
english: Observed frost conflicts with this proposed reference; confirm a protected growing position before buying.
afrikaans_draft: Waargenome ryp bots met hierdie voorgestelde verwysing; bevestig 'n beskermde groeiplek voordat jy koop.

key: Pick at the intended green, black or oil stage. Processing and safe kept-stock conditions must be recorded separately.
english: Pick at the intended green, black or oil stage. Processing and safe kept-stock conditions must be recorded separately.
afrikaans_draft: Pluk op die beoogde groen, swart of oliestadium. Verwerking en veilige toestande vir gehoue voorraad moet apart aangeteken word.

key: Plan around actual calving/kidding and lactation. Dry animals do not supply milk.
english: Plan around actual calving/kidding and lactation. Dry animals do not supply milk.
afrikaans_draft: Beplan rondom werklike kalwing/lamming en laktasie. Droë diere verskaf nie melk nie.

key: Protect young plants from cold; use well-drained soil in sun or semi-shade. SANBI describes frost tenderness and tolerance of sea breezes.
english: Protect young plants from cold; use well-drained soil in sun or semi-shade. SANBI describes frost tenderness and tolerance of sea breezes.
afrikaans_draft: Beskerm jong plante teen koue; gebruik goed gedreineerde grond in son of halfskaduwee. SANBI beskryf rypgevoeligheid en verdraagsaamheid vir seebries.

key: Provide climbing support. Tuberous roots are poisonous; children should not forage unsupervised.
english: Provide climbing support. Tuberous roots are poisonous; children should not forage unsupervised.
afrikaans_draft: Voorsien klimondersteuning. Die knolwortels is giftig; kinders moet nie sonder toesig kos soek nie.

key: Record coffee-cherry picking separately from drying, hulling and roasting. Do not use roasted packet stock months as the fresh harvest calendar.
english: Record coffee-cherry picking separately from drying, hulling and roasting. Do not use roasted packet stock months as the fresh harvest calendar.
afrikaans_draft: Teken die pluk van koffiebessies apart van droog, dop en brand aan. Moenie die maande van gebrande verpakte voorraad as die kalender vir vars oes gebruik nie.

key: Record edible unopened heads by planting batch; do not use open-flower months as picking months.
english: Record edible unopened heads by planting batch; do not use open-flower months as picking months.
afrikaans_draft: Teken eetbare ongeopende koppe volgens aanplanting aan; moenie maande van oop blomme as plukmaande gebruik nie.

key: Record fresh cuttings and dried tea output separately; no automatic drying conversion or safe storage duration is assigned.
english: Record fresh cuttings and dried tea output separately; no automatic drying conversion or safe storage duration is assigned.
afrikaans_draft: Teken vars snysels en gedroogde tee-opbrengs apart aan; geen outomatiese droogomskakeling of veilige bergingstydperk word toegeken nie.

key: Record local ripe picking dates and output. Foreign cultivar seasons do not establish a South African season.
english: Record local ripe picking dates and output. Foreign cultivar seasons do not establish a South African season.
afrikaans_draft: Teken plaaslike plukdatums vir ryp vrugte en opbrengs aan. Buitelandse kultivarseisoene bepaal nie 'n Suid-Afrikaanse seisoen nie.

key: Request correctly identified, locally suitable nursery material. Do not purchase on an assumed common-fig crop forecast.
english: Request correctly identified, locally suitable nursery material. Do not purchase on an assumed common-fig crop forecast.
afrikaans_draft: Vra vir korrek geïdentifiseerde, plaaslik geskikte kwekerymateriaal. Moenie koop op grond van 'n aanvaarde oesvoorspelling vir common-fig nie.

key: Retain this climber in mapped inventory, but do not count it as normal household food until a qualified local specialist confirms identity, edible part and safe preparation.
english: Retain this climber in mapped inventory, but do not count it as normal household food until a qualified local specialist confirms identity, edible part and safe preparation.
afrikaans_draft: Hou hierdie klimplant in die gekarteerde inventaris, maar moenie dit as gewone huishoudelike voedsel tel nie totdat 'n gekwalifiseerde plaaslike spesialis identiteit, eetbare deel en veilige voorbereiding bevestig.

key: Ripe fruit only; tuberous roots are poisonous.
english: Ripe fruit only; tuberous roots are poisonous.
afrikaans_draft: Slegs ryp vrugte; die knolwortels is giftig.

key: SANBI describes humid coastal/estuarine conditions and no tolerance of even mild frost.
english: SANBI describes humid coastal/estuarine conditions and no tolerance of even mild frost.
afrikaans_draft: SANBI beskryf vogtige kus-/riviermondtoestande en geen verdraagsaamheid vir selfs ligte ryp nie.

key: SANBI records a wide range from frost-free coast to winter-frost regions. Its hooked and straight thorns matter when choosing access routes.
english: SANBI records a wide range from frost-free coast to winter-frost regions. Its hooked and straight thorns matter when choosing access routes.
afrikaans_draft: SANBI teken 'n wye reeks aan van die rypvrye kus tot streke met winterryp. Sy hoekige en reguit dorings is belangrik wanneer jy toegangsroetes kies.

key: SANBI records it in arid Karoo and Eastern Cape scrub, with frost and drought tolerance. It can grow in sun or semi-shade.
english: SANBI records it in arid Karoo and Eastern Cape scrub, with frost and drought tolerance. It can grow in sun or semi-shade.
afrikaans_draft: SANBI teken dit in die ariede Karoo en Oos-Kaapse struikveld aan, met verdraagsaamheid vir ryp en droogte. Dit kan in son of halfskaduwee groei.

key: SANBI records this frost- and drought-resistant shade tree in Karoo and Kalahari conditions.
english: SANBI records this frost- and drought-resistant shade tree in Karoo and Kalahari conditions.
afrikaans_draft: SANBI teken hierdie ryp- en droogtebestande skaduboom in Karoo- en Kalahari-toestande aan.

key: SANBI records this slow-growing tree in summer and winter rainfall areas, with frost, drought and wind resistance.
english: SANBI records this slow-growing tree in summer and winter rainfall areas, with frost, drought and wind resistance.
afrikaans_draft: SANBI teken hierdie stadig groeiende boom in somer- en winterreëngebiede aan, met bestandheid teen ryp, droogte en wind.

key: SANBI records this tree in east-coast dune forest from Eastern Cape through KwaZulu-Natal, with tolerance of salty sea spray.
english: SANBI records this tree in east-coast dune forest from Eastern Cape through KwaZulu-Natal, with tolerance of salty sea spray.
afrikaans_draft: SANBI teken hierdie boom in duinwoud aan die ooskus van die Oos-Kaap tot in KwaZulu-Natal aan, met verdraagsaamheid vir sout seesproei.

key: SANBI reports culinary uses but also toxic constituents and poisoning concerns. A preparation report is not a complete safe household recipe.
english: SANBI reports culinary uses but also toxic constituents and poisoning concerns. A preparation report is not a complete safe household recipe.
afrikaans_draft: SANBI meld kulinêre gebruike, maar ook giftige bestanddele en kommer oor vergiftiging. 'n Verslag oor voorbereiding is nie 'n volledige veilige huishoudelike resep nie.

key: SANBI reports that leaf browsing can taint cattle milk. No feed ration is recommended.
english: SANBI reports that leaf browsing can taint cattle milk. No feed ration is recommended.
afrikaans_draft: SANBI meld dat afvreet van die blare beesmelk 'n bysmaak kan gee. Geen voerrantsoen word aanbeveel nie.

key: Seeds and unripe fruit are toxic. Keep children away from unsupervised harvesting and preparation.
english: Seeds and unripe fruit are toxic. Keep children away from unsupervised harvesting and preparation.
afrikaans_draft: Sade en onryp vrugte is giftig. Hou kinders weg van oes en voorbereiding sonder toesig.

key: September–January describes fruit production; exact ripe-picking dates are not stated. Do not count leaves used as livestock fodder as household food.
english: September–January describes fruit production; exact ripe-picking dates are not stated. Do not count leaves used as livestock fodder as household food.
afrikaans_draft: September–Januarie beskryf vrugproduksie; presiese datums vir die pluk van ryp vrugte word nie gestel nie. Moenie blare wat as veevoer gebruik word as huishoudelike voedsel tel nie.

key: Shelter this coastal tree from direct salt-laden sea wind; SANBI reports salt burn despite its coastal habitat.
english: Shelter this coastal tree from direct salt-laden sea wind; SANBI reports salt burn despite its coastal habitat.
afrikaans_draft: Beskut hierdie kusboom teen direkte soutbelaaide seewind; SANBI meld soutbrand ten spyte van sy kushabitat.

key: Spring-bearing system only; do not use this for autumn-bearing Heritage or Autumn Bliss.
english: Spring-bearing system only; do not use this for autumn-bearing Heritage or Autumn Bliss.
afrikaans_draft: Slegs lentedraende stelsel; moenie dit vir herfsdraende Heritage of Autumn Bliss gebruik nie.

key: Summer-rain reference; check frost protection of young plants.
english: Summer-rain reference; check frost protection of young plants.
afrikaans_draft: Somerreën-verwysing; kontroleer rypbeskerming van jong plante.

key: The South African account describes stream-bank/forest-slope growth and frost resistance; its berries are described as bird food.
english: The South African account describes stream-bank/forest-slope growth and frost resistance; its berries are described as bird food.
afrikaans_draft: Die Suid-Afrikaanse beskrywing beskryf groei op stroomoewers/woudhange en rypbestandheid; sy bessies word as voëlkos beskryf.

key: The edible berry must be distinguished from bark, which the source describes as containing a poisonous glucoside.
english: The edible berry must be distinguished from bark, which the source describes as containing a poisonous glucoside.
afrikaans_draft: Die eetbare bessie moet onderskei word van die bas, wat volgens die bron 'n giftige glukosied bevat.

key: The food is the tart leaf; flowers do not define leaf picking months.
english: The food is the tart leaf; flowers do not define leaf picking months.
afrikaans_draft: Die voedsel is die suur blaar; blomme bepaal nie blaarplukmaande nie.

key: The food product is a tuber, not a potato-family fruit. Warm summer-rainfall cultivation with little frost is described; winter/spring flowering after leaf loss is not a dated tuber-digging calendar.
english: The food product is a tuber, not a potato-family fruit. Warm summer-rainfall cultivation with little frost is described; winter/spring flowering after leaf loss is not a dated tuber-digging calendar.
afrikaans_draft: Die voedselproduk is 'n knol, nie 'n vrug van die aartappelfamilie nie. Warm verbouing in somerreëngebiede met min ryp word beskryf; blom in die winter/lente ná blaarverlies is nie 'n gedateerde kalender vir die uitgrawe van knolle nie.

key: The guide reports 4–6 kg/tree in year 6 and warns that yields are difficult to predict because of pollination and fruit set. The separate good result at year 8–9 is 9 t/ha. Do not connect them into a made-up growth curve or convert the later hectare result to arbitrary tree spacing.
english: The guide reports 4–6 kg/tree in year 6 and warns that yields are difficult to predict because of pollination and fruit set. The separate good result at year 8–9 is 9 t/ha. Do not connect them into a made-up growth curve or convert the later hectare result to arbitrary tree spacing.
afrikaans_draft: Die gids meld 4–6 kg/boom in jaar 6 en waarsku dat opbrengste moeilik is om te voorspel weens bestuiwing en vrugset. Die aparte goeie resultaat in jaar 8–9 is 9 t/ha. Moenie hulle in 'n uitgedinkte groeikurwe verbind of die latere hektaarresultaat na 'n arbitrêre boomspasiëring omskakel nie.

key: The institutional species reference distinguishes fruiting forms and variable breeding systems. Ripe fruits are used as food; a black-fruited tree must not silently inherit this identity or the legal status of another Morus species.
english: The institutional species reference distinguishes fruiting forms and variable breeding systems. Ripe fruits are used as food; a black-fruited tree must not silently inherit this identity or the legal status of another Morus species.
afrikaans_draft: Die institusionele spesieverwysing onderskei vrugdraende vorme en wisselende teelstelsels. Ryp vrugte word as voedsel gebruik; 'n boom met swart vrugte mag nie stilweg hierdie identiteit of die regstatus van 'n ander Morus-spesie oorneem nie.

key: The primary study records confusion with Bridelia micrantha. It does not supply a safe harvest calendar or kg/tree.

english: Use species-suitable, well-drained acidic fynbos conditions and confirm local frost exposure.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik spesie-geskikte, goed gedreineerde suur fynbostoestande en bevestig plaaslike blootstelling aan ryp.

english: Use sun and well-drained soil. SANBI records dry bushveld, sandy-soil preference and frost hardiness; avoid over-watering established plants.

english: Warm, frost-free conditions and dependable water are needed. Keep a replacement follower after the fruiting stem is removed.

key: Yield points use the conservative end of published commercial KZN benchmarks where that crop is listed. They compare plans; they do not predict this household's harvest. The warm/light-frost windows, spacing and duration use the official tables where those tables cover the crop; catalog fallbacks and other regional patterns still need local confirmation. Bed occupancy uses the upper published maturity/picking endpoint so two crops are not booked onto the same ground, but the source says these times are approximate and assume optimum conditions; actual crops may mature later. Every later sowing or transplant is conditional on observing that the previous crop is finished and the bed is clear. The app does not split a crop-cycle total into invented monthly kilograms. Auto-suggest only ranks crops with verified yield, duration and field-spacing support. A family plan starts from a supported diverse mix; an exact crop list becomes a strict whitelist. It requires irrigation because intensive succession without a farm water plan is not defensible. Its packing is a transparent heuristic, not proof of a global maximum or of a physical row layout. Commercial ranking is fresh weight per crop cycle; it is not profit, nutrition or evidence of buyer demand.
english: Yield points use the conservative end of published commercial KZN benchmarks where that crop is listed. They compare plans; they do not predict this household's harvest. The warm/light-frost windows, spacing and duration use the official tables where those tables cover the crop; catalog fallbacks and other regional patterns still need local confirmation. Bed occupancy uses the upper published maturity/picking endpoint so two crops are not booked onto the same ground, but the source says these times are approximate and assume optimum conditions; actual crops may mature later. Every later sowing or transplant is conditional on observing that the previous crop is finished and the bed is clear. The app does not split a crop-cycle total into invented monthly kilograms. Auto-suggest only ranks crops with verified yield, duration and field-spacing support. A family plan starts from a supported diverse mix; an exact crop list becomes a strict whitelist. It requires irrigation because intensive succession without a farm water plan is not defensible. Its packing is a transparent heuristic, not proof of a global maximum or of a physical row layout. Commercial ranking is fresh weight per crop cycle; it is not profit, nutrition or evidence of buyer demand.

Die vensters vir warm gebiede/ligte ryp, spasiëring en tydsduur gebruik die amptelike tabelle waar daardie tabelle die gewas dek; katalogus-terugvalle en ander streekspatrone het steeds plaaslike bevestiging nodig. Beddingbesetting gebruik die boonste gepubliseerde volwassenheids-/plukeindpunt sodat twee gewasse nie op dieselfde grond bespreek word nie, maar die bron sê hierdie tye is benaderd en aanvaar optimale toestande; werklike gewasse kan later volwasse word. Die app verdeel nie 'n gewassiklustotaal in uitgedinkte maandelikse kilogram nie. Outo-voorstel rangskik slegs gewasse met geverifieerde ondersteuning vir opbrengs, tydsduur en veldspasiëring. 'n Gesinsplan begin vanaf 'n gestaafde diverse mengsel; 'n presiese gewaslys word 'n streng witlys. afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer vir jou eie werk die gestoorde resultaat en enige verbindingsboodskappe. Moenie 'n duplikaat teken omdat jy onseker is of die eerste stoor gewerk het nie. Hou jou bronskets en metings.

key: This is a planning map. Traced lines, satellite imagery and device GPS do not by themselves establish a surveyed or legal boundary. Check uncertain edges and permissions before acting on them.
english: This is a planning map. Traced lines, satellite imagery and device GPS do not by themselves establish a surveyed or legal boundary. Check uncertain edges and permissions before acting on them.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is 'n beplanningskaart. Nagetrekte lyne, satellietbeelde en toestel-GPS bewys nie op hul eie 'n opgemete of wettige grens nie. Kontroleer onseker rande en toestemmings voordat jy daarop optree.

key: Look at the displayed sun, wind, fire and water information. Read the source and missing-data notes. Some information is modelled or regional context, rather than a measurement on your land.
english: Look at the displayed sun, wind, fire and water information. Read the source and missing-data notes. Some information is modelled or regional context, rather than a measurement on your land.
afrikaans_draft: Kyk na die son-, wind-, vuur- en waterinligting wat gewys word. Lees die bron- en ontbrekende-data-notas. Sommige inligting is gemodelleer of streekskonteks, eerder as 'n meting op jou grond.

key: Use Learn and the linked course explanations for the farming ideas. These app instructions teach the controls; they do not replace a site assessment.
english: Use Learn and the linked course explanations for the farming ideas. These app instructions teach the controls; they do not replace a site assessment.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik Leer en die gekoppelde kursusverduidelikings vir die boerdery-idees. Hierdie app-instruksies leer die kontroles; dit vervang nie 'n terreinbeoordeling nie.

key: Use each step for the part of the plan you are considering. Read the step guide, choose the appropriate tool and place or draw the proposed item. You do not need every item in the palette.
english: Use each step for the part of the plan you are considering. Read the step guide, choose the appropriate tool and place or draw the proposed item. You do not need every item in the palette.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik elke stap vir die deel van die plan wat jy oorweeg. Lees die stapgids, kies die gepaste gereedskap en plaas of teken die voorgestelde item. Jy het nie elke item in die palet nodig nie.

key: A tank or bed icon comes with starting dimensions. Check the real design requirements before keeping those values. A drawn earthwork is not a surveyed or approved construction instruction.
english: A tank or bed icon comes with starting dimensions. Check the real design requirements before keeping those values. A drawn earthwork is not a surveyed or approved construction instruction.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Tenk- of beddingikoon kom met beginafmetings. Kontroleer die werklike ontwerpvereistes voordat jy daardie waardes behou. 'n Getekende grondwerk is nie 'n opgemete of goedgekeurde konstruksie-opdrag nie.

key: Review → Inspect the map → Read Saved or any warning
english: Review → Inspect the map → Read Saved or any warning
afrikaans_draft: Hersien → Ondersoek die kaart → Lees Gestoor of enige waarskuwing

key: The app saves edits as you work. Read the header. If it says NOT saved or reports full storage, retain a copy and resolve the warning before leaving. Saved confirms the device save; it does not by itself prove the same version has reached another device.
english: The app saves edits as you work. Read the header. If it says NOT saved or reports full storage, retain a copy and resolve the warning before leaving. Saved confirms the device save; it does not by itself prove the same version has reached another device.
afrikaans_draft: Die app stoor wysigings terwyl jy werk. Lees die opskrif. As dit “NIE gestoor nie” sê of aandui dat die berging vol is, hou 'n kopie en los die waarskuwing op voordat jy weggaan. Gestoor bevestig die stoor op die toestel; dit bewys nie op sy eie dat dieselfde weergawe 'n ander toestel bereik het nie.

key: Return to the same saved site and check the design again. Keep your field sketch and source measurements separately. Do not clear the browser’s data as a way to repair a save problem.
english: Return to the same saved site and check the design again. Keep your field sketch and source measurements separately. Do not clear the browser’s data as a way to repair a save problem.
afrikaans_draft: Gaan terug na dieselfde gestoorde terrein en kontroleer die ontwerp weer. Hou jou veldskets en bronmetings afsonderlik. Moenie die blaaier se data uitvee as 'n manier om 'n stoorprobleem reg te maak nie.

key: Keep the measured evidence unchanged. Correct the drawing to reflect the intended design; do not rewrite measurements to conceal an accidental edit.
english: Keep the measured evidence unchanged. Correct the drawing to reflect the intended design; do not rewrite measurements to conceal an accidental edit.
afrikaans_draft: Hou die gemete bewyse onveranderd. Maak die tekening reg sodat dit die bedoelde ontwerp weerspieël; moenie metings herskryf om 'n toevallige wysiging te verberg nie.

key: Use Back to design to correct mapped growing areas. Do not change a crop quantity merely to hide an incorrect bed size. Keep practice or unmapped areas separate from a measured farm plan.
english: Use Back to design to correct mapped growing areas. Do not change a crop quantity merely to hide an incorrect bed size. Keep practice or unmapped areas separate from a measured farm plan.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik Terug na ontwerp om gekarteerde groeiareas reg te stel. Moenie 'n gewashoeveelheid verander net om 'n verkeerde beddinggrootte te verberg nie. Hou oefen- of ongekarteerde areas afsonderlik van 'n gemete plaasplan.

key: Enter the variety from your seed packet if you know it. Leave it blank if you do not. An entered variety name does not turn general crop guidance into a verified variety-specific schedule.
english: Enter the variety from your seed packet if you know it. Leave it blank if you do not. An entered variety name does not turn general crop guidance into a verified variety-specific schedule.
afrikaans_draft: Voer die kultivar van jou saadpakkie in as jy dit ken. Laat dit leeg as jy nie weet nie. 'n Kultivarnaam wat ingevoer is, verander nie algemene gewasriglyne in 'n geverifieerde kultivarspesifieke skedule nie.

key: Read overlap and unverified-timing messages. A warning is a reason to review the plan, even when the screen still lets you save. Do not assume two crop bars mean both fit.
english: Read overlap and unverified-timing messages. A warning is a reason to review the plan, even when the screen still lets you save. Do not assume two crop bars mean both fit.
afrikaans_draft: Lees boodskappe oor oorvleueling en ongeverifieerde tydsberekening. 'n Waarskuwing is 'n rede om die plan te hersien, selfs wanneer die skerm jou steeds laat stoor. Moenie aanneem dat twee gewasbalke beteken albei pas nie.

key: The plan saves on this device as you work. Read any Not saving warning and keep a copy while resolving it. A closed editor does not prove a cloud backup exists.
english: The plan saves on this device as you work. Read any Not saving warning and keep a copy while resolving it. A closed editor does not prove a cloud backup exists.
afrikaans_draft: Die plan stoor op hierdie toestel terwyl jy werk. Lees enige Stoor nie-waarskuwing en hou 'n kopie terwyl jy dit oplos. 'n Toe redigeerder bewys nie dat 'n wolkrugsteun bestaan nie.

key: Suggest a plan prepares a proposal. Review its crops, timing, area shares and unresolved notes before choosing Add plantings to my plan. It adds around existing plantings; it does not erase them. Do not use Clear all simply to try a suggestion.
english: Suggest a plan prepares a proposal. Review its crops, timing, area shares and unresolved notes before choosing Add plantings to my plan. It adds around existing plantings; it does not erase them. Do not use Clear all simply to try a suggestion.
afrikaans_draft: Stel 'n plan voor berei 'n voorstel voor. Hersien sy gewasse, tydsberekening, oppervlaktedele en onopgeloste notas voordat jy Voeg aanplantings by my plan kies. Dit voeg by rondom bestaande aanplantings; dit vee hulle nie uit nie. Moenie Vee alles uit gebruik net om 'n voorstel te probeer nie.

key: Explain one limitation of the forecast and find one task in a downloaded copy. Do not turn the sample values into real farm records. For your own farm, confirm timing, water and growing conditions locally and keep the plan updated as conditions change.
english: Explain one limitation of the forecast and find one task in a downloaded copy. Do not turn the sample values into real farm records. For your own farm, confirm timing, water and growing conditions locally and keep the plan updated as conditions change.
afrikaans_draft: Verduidelik een beperking van die vooruitskatting en vind een taak in 'n afgelaaide kopie. Moenie die voorbeeldwaardes in werklike plaasrekords verander nie. Bevestig vir jou eie plaas tydsberekening, water en groeitoestande plaaslik en hou die plan bygewerk soos toestande verander.

key: Weigh produce sold in bunches or crates before entering kilograms. Do not invent a conversion or enter the number of bunches as its weight.
english: Weigh produce sold in bunches or crates before entering kilograms. Do not invent a conversion or enter the number of bunches as its weight.
afrikaans_draft: Weeg produkte wat in bossies of kratte verkoop word voordat jy kilogram invoer. Moenie 'n omskakeling versin of die aantal bossies as sy gewig invoer nie.

key: Switch to another tab and return to Picked to check the entry again. If the app reports a queued or offline save, follow that message; do not add the same picking again as a retry.
english: Switch to another tab and return to Picked to check the entry again. If the app reports a queued or offline save, follow that message; do not add the same picking again as a retry.
afrikaans_draft: Skakel oor na 'n ander oortjie en gaan terug na Gepluk om die inskrywing weer na te gaan. As die app 'n stoor in die tou of vanlyn aandui, volg daardie boodskap; moenie dieselfde pluk weer byvoeg as 'n herprobeer nie.

key: More sold than picked can mean a missing harvest record or a sale from an earlier harvest. Investigate the dates and records; do not change a weight just to make the chart look tidy.
english: More sold than picked can mean a missing harvest record or a sale from an earlier harvest. Investigate the dates and records; do not change a weight just to make the chart look tidy.
afrikaans_draft: Meer verkoop as gepluk kan 'n ontbrekende oesrekord of 'n verkoping uit 'n vroeër oes beteken. Ondersoek die datums en rekords; moenie 'n gewig verander net om die grafiek netjies te laat lyk nie.

key: Zero would say there was no weight. An unknown weight must not be turned into zero.
english: Zero would say there was no weight. An unknown weight must not be turned into zero.
afrikaans_draft: Nul sou sê daar was geen gewig nie. 'n Onbekende gewig moet nie in nul verander word nie.

key: If a recorded sale has no invoice, use Create invoice on that sale when available. Keep its recorded crop, kilograms, amount and payment date. Do not start another sale to create its paperwork.
english: If a recorded sale has no invoice, use Create invoice on that sale when available. Keep its recorded crop, kilograms, amount and payment date. Do not start another sale to create its paperwork.
afrikaans_draft: As 'n aangetekende verkoping geen faktuur het nie, gebruik Skep faktuur op daardie verkoping wanneer beskikbaar. Hou sy aangetekende gewas, kilogram, bedrag en betaaldatum. Moenie nog 'n verkoping begin om sy papierwerk te skep nie.

key: A deposit or instalment is not payment in full. This app does not keep a partial-payment balance schedule. Keep a separate checked record of amounts received and still owed; do not mark the invoice fully paid for a deposit.
english: A deposit or instalment is not payment in full. This app does not keep a partial-payment balance schedule. Keep a separate checked record of amounts received and still owed; do not mark the invoice fully paid for a deposit.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Deposito of paaiement is nie volle betaling nie. Hierdie app hou nie 'n saldoskedule vir gedeeltelike betalings nie. Hou 'n afsonderlike nagegaande rekord van bedrae ontvang en nog verskuldig; moenie die faktuur as ten volle betaal merk vir 'n deposito nie.

key: If the document is saved on this device but the crop sale book still needs updating, reconnect and follow the message on that same invoice. Creating another document is not a safe retry.
english: If the document is saved on this device but the crop sale book still needs updating, reconnect and follow the message on that same invoice. Creating another document is not a safe retry.
afrikaans_draft: As die dokument op hierdie toestel gestoor is maar die gewasverkopeboek nog bygewerk moet word, verbind weer en volg die boodskap op daardie selfde faktuur. Om nog 'n dokument te skep, is nie 'n veilige herprobeer nie.

key: For a paid invoice, check the amount in Sold and reopen its invoice link. Do not manually add its income again because a linked crop record also exists.
english: For a paid invoice, check the amount in Sold and reopen its invoice link. Do not manually add its income again because a linked crop record also exists.
afrikaans_draft: Vir 'n betaalde faktuur, kontroleer die bedrag in Verkoop en maak sy faktuurskakel weer oop. Moenie sy inkomste weer handmatig byvoeg omdat 'n gekoppelde gewasrekord ook bestaan nie.

key: Yes. Link the R40.00 evidence to the invoice and keep R80.00 outstanding in a checked supporting record. Do not create a second produce sale.
english: Yes. Link the R40.00 evidence to the invoice and keep R80.00 outstanding in a checked supporting record. Do not create a second produce sale.
afrikaans_draft: Ja. Koppel die R40.00-bewyse aan die faktuur en hou R80.00 uitstaande in 'n nagegaande ondersteunende rekord. Moenie 'n tweede produkverkoping skep nie.

key: Look for the cost in Spent first. If it already exists, use Edit on that row to correct it. Do not add another copy of the same payment.
english: Look for the cost in Spent first. If it already exists, use Edit on that row to correct it. Do not add another copy of the same payment.
afrikaans_draft: Soek eers na die koste in Bestee. As dit reeds bestaan, gebruik Wysig op daardie ry om dit reg te stel. Moenie nog 'n kopie van dieselfde betaling byvoeg nie.

key: Supplier and Category are optional. Choose them when you know them. If the amount is unknown, find the evidence before saving; do not enter zero as a substitute.
english: Supplier and Category are optional. Choose them when you know them. If the amount is unknown, find the evidence before saving; do not enter zero as a substitute.
afrikaans_draft: Verskaffer en Kategorie is opsioneel. Kies hulle wanneer jy dit weet. As die bedrag onbekend is, vind die bewyse voordat jy stoor; moenie nul as plaasvervanger invoer nie.

key: Only fill Crop this cost was for when the payment was just for that crop. Leave it blank for a whole-garden cost. Do not invent a split to make a crop appear more profitable.
english: Only fill Crop this cost was for when the payment was just for that crop. Leave it blank for a whole-garden cost. Do not invent a split to make a crop appear more profitable.
afrikaans_draft: Vul Gewas waarvoor hierdie koste was slegs in wanneer die betaling net vir daardie gewas was. Laat dit leeg vir 'n koste vir die hele tuin. Moenie 'n verdeling versin om 'n gewas winsgewender te laat lyk nie.

key: If a receipt is unavailable, keep the original and check the device where you saved it. Do not create another cost simply to retry a photo or a queued save.
english: If a receipt is unavailable, keep the original and check the device where you saved it. Do not create another cost simply to retry a photo or a queued save.
afrikaans_draft: As 'n kwitansie nie beskikbaar is nie, hou die oorspronklike en kontroleer die toestel waarop jy dit gestoor het. Moenie nog 'n koste skep net om 'n foto of 'n stoor in die tou weer te probeer nie.

key: Use the price you agreed with the buyer. A suggested guide price is not an agreement. Kilograms, bags and bunches are different units; do not change the unit without checking the quantity and price.
english: Use the price you agreed with the buyer. A suggested guide price is not an agreement. Kilograms, bags and bunches are different units; do not change the unit without checking the quantity and price.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik die prys wat jy met die koper ooreengekom het. 'n Voorgestelde riglynprys is nie 'n ooreenkoms nie. Kilogram, sakke en bossies is verskillende eenhede; moenie die eenheid verander sonder om die hoeveelheid en prys na te gaan nie.

key: A deposit is not payment in full. This screen does not track partial balances. Keep a checked supporting record of deposits and amounts still owed; do not mark the whole invoice paid to represent a deposit.
english: A deposit is not payment in full. This screen does not track partial balances. Keep a checked supporting record of deposits and amounts still owed; do not mark the whole invoice paid to represent a deposit.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Deposito is nie volle betaling nie. Hierdie skerm hou nie gedeeltelike saldo's by nie. Hou 'n nagegaande ondersteunende rekord van deposito's en bedrae wat nog verskuldig is; moenie die hele faktuur as betaal merk om 'n deposito voor te stel nie.

key: If the app says the document is saved on this device but the crop sale book still needs an update, reconnect and follow that message. Do not create another invoice as a retry.
english: If the app says the document is saved on this device but the crop sale book still needs an update, reconnect and follow that message. Do not create another invoice as a retry.
afrikaans_draft: As die app sê die dokument is op hierdie toestel gestoor maar die gewasverkopeboek moet nog bygewerk word, verbind weer en volg daardie boodskap. Moenie nog 'n faktuur as 'n herprobeer skep nie.

key: Invoices are saved on this device. Do not assume the complete document is available on another device because a linked sale has synchronised. Keep the source record and a checked copy.
english: Invoices are saved on this device. Do not assume the complete document is available on another device because a linked sale has synchronised. Keep the source record and a checked copy.
afrikaans_draft: Fakture word op hierdie toestel gestoor. Moenie aanneem dat die volledige dokument op 'n ander toestel beskikbaar is omdat 'n gekoppelde verkoping gesinkroniseer het nie. Hou die bronrekord en 'n nagegaande kopie.

key: Bring the original reference, issue date, buyer, goods, quantities, units and agreed prices. Check whether payment arrived and on which date. Do not guess missing details.
english: Bring the original reference, issue date, buyer, goods, quantities, units and agreed prices. Check whether payment arrived and on which date. Do not guess missing details.
afrikaans_draft: Bring die oorspronklike verwysing, uitreikdatum, koper, goedere, hoeveelhede, eenhede en ooreengekome pryse. Kontroleer of betaling opgedaag het en op watter datum. Moenie ontbrekende besonderhede raai nie.

key: If an invoice already exists, reopen it from Saved or its View link. Do not create a new sale because the buyer wants another copy.
english: If an invoice already exists, reopen it from Saved or its View link. Do not create a new sale because the buyer wants another copy.
afrikaans_draft: As 'n faktuur reeds bestaan, maak dit weer oop vanuit Gestoor of sy Bekyk-skakel. Moenie 'n nuwe verkoping skep omdat die koper nog 'n afskrif wil hê nie.

key: An empty list is not proof that the sale never happened. It may already have an invoice or may not be an eligible kilogram record. Check Saved and your original evidence. Never pick a similar sale as a substitute.
english: An empty list is not proof that the sale never happened. It may already have an invoice or may not be an eligible kilogram record. Check Saved and your original evidence. Never pick a similar sale as a substitute.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Leë lys is nie bewys dat die verkoping nooit gebeur het nie. Dit het dalk reeds 'n faktuur of is dalk nie 'n geskikte kilogramrekord nie. Kontroleer Gestoor en jou oorspronklike bewyse. Kies nooit 'n soortgelyke verkoping as plaasvervanger nie.

key: Bunches, bags and kilograms are different units. Keep the unit on the source. Do not invent a weight to make an old record fit.
english: Bunches, bags and kilograms are different units. Keep the unit on the source. Do not invent a weight to make an old record fit.
afrikaans_draft: Bossies, sakke en kilogram is verskillende eenhede. Hou die eenheid op die bron. Moenie 'n gewig versin om 'n ou rekord te laat pas nie.

key: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding when payment remains due. This app does not keep an instalment ledger. Keep deposits and the remaining balance separately; do not mark a deposit as full payment.
english: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding when payment remains due. This app does not keep an instalment ledger. Keep deposits and the remaining balance separately; do not mark a deposit as full payment.
afrikaans_draft: Kies Nog nie — betaling uitstaande wanneer betaling steeds verskuldig is. Hierdie app hou nie 'n paaiementgrootboek nie. Hou deposito's en die oorblywende saldo afsonderlik; moenie 'n deposito as volle betaling merk nie.

key: A saved invoice’s issue date is locked. Check it before saving; keep the original evidence and seek help with that record if it is wrong. Do not add another sale as a correction.
english: A saved invoice’s issue date is locked. Check it before saving; keep the original evidence and seek help with that record if it is wrong. Do not add another sale as a correction.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Gestoorde faktuur se uitreikdatum is gesluit. Kontroleer dit voordat jy stoor; hou die oorspronklike bewyse en soek hulp met daardie rekord as dit verkeerd is. Moenie nog 'n verkoping as regstelling byvoeg nie.

key: Practise in the sample tour. Keep real banking and customer details private. A practice export ends with checking the copy; do not send it to a real customer.
english: Practise in the sample tour. Keep real banking and customer details private. A practice export ends with checking the copy; do not send it to a real customer.
afrikaans_draft: Oefen in die voorbeeldtoer. Hou werklike bank- en kliëntbesonderhede privaat. 'n Oefenuitvoer eindig met die nagaan van die afskrif; moenie dit na 'n werklike kliënt stuur nie.

key: Check that you are editing that invoice. Do not start New invoice to record payment for goods already invoiced.
english: Check that you are editing that invoice. Do not start New invoice to record payment for goods already invoiced.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer dat jy daardie faktuur wysig. Moenie Nuwe faktuur begin om betaling aan te teken vir goedere wat reeds gefaktureer is nie.

key: This screen supports paid in full or unpaid. For a deposit or instalment, keep the amounts, dates and balance in a separate supporting record. Do not mark the whole invoice paid.
english: This screen supports paid in full or unpaid. For a deposit or instalment, keep the amounts, dates and balance in a separate supporting record. Do not mark the whole invoice paid.
afrikaans_draft: Hierdie skerm ondersteun ten volle betaal of onbetaal. Vir 'n deposito of paaiement, hou die bedrae, datums en saldo in 'n afsonderlike ondersteunende rekord. Moenie die hele faktuur as betaal merk nie.

key: Check the related invoice and amount in Sold. Paid invoice income is included in the money book. Do not enter another quick sale for the same payment.
english: Check the related invoice and amount in Sold. Paid invoice income is included in the money book. Do not enter another quick sale for the same payment.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer die verwante faktuur en bedrag in Verkoop. Inkomste van betaalde fakture is by die geldboek ingesluit. Moenie nog 'n vinnige verkoping vir dieselfde betaling invoer nie.

key: Correct. The app has no instalment ledger. Keep the evidence separately and do not mark full payment until it is supported.
english: Correct. The app has no instalment ledger. Keep the evidence separately and do not mark full payment until it is supported.
afrikaans_draft: Korrek. Die app het geen paaiementgrootboek nie. Hou die bewyse afsonderlik en moenie volle betaling merk totdat dit ondersteun word nie.

key: Independent practice: reopen one paid and one unpaid sample invoice. Explain the date and status on each, then identify the document and recipient you would check before sharing. Do not send the examples.
english: Independent practice: reopen one paid and one unpaid sample invoice. Explain the date and status on each, then identify the document and recipient you would check before sharing. Do not send the examples.
afrikaans_draft: Onafhanklike oefening: maak een betaalde en een onbetaalde voorbeeldfaktuur weer oop. Verduidelik die datum en status op elkeen, en identifiseer dan die dokument en ontvanger wat jy sou nagaan voordat jy deel. Moenie die voorbeelde stuur nie.

key: Cash surplus and Recorded cash margin describe the included records. Missing expenses, stock, equipment treatment, debt and other accounts can change the complete business result. Do not call one chart a full profit-and-loss statement.
english: Cash surplus and Recorded cash margin describe the included records. Missing expenses, stock, equipment treatment, debt and other accounts can change the complete business result. Do not call one chart a full profit-and-loss statement.
afrikaans_draft: Kontantoorskot en Aangetekende kontantmarge beskryf die ingesluite rekords. Ontbrekende uitgawes, voorraad, hantering van toerusting, skuld en ander rekeninge kan die volledige besigheidsresultaat verander. Moenie een grafiek 'n volledige wins-en-verliesstaat noem nie.

key: A dashed outline can mark a month with more sold than logged as picked. Read the explanation and check missing harvests or sales from earlier stock. Do not enter an invented harvest to make the bars agree.
english: A dashed outline can mark a month with more sold than logged as picked. Read the explanation and check missing harvests or sales from earlier stock. Do not enter an invented harvest to make the bars agree.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Stippelbuitelyn kan 'n maand merk met meer verkoop as wat as gepluk aangeteken is. Lees die verduideliking en kontroleer vir ontbrekende oeste of verkope uit vroeër voorraad. Moenie 'n versinde oes invoer om die stawe te laat ooreenstem nie.

key: Harvest and cost logging forms stamp the entry date. Paid invoices use their recorded payment date. Check the actual source dates and keep late-entry evidence; do not assume every chart month is the date work happened.
english: Harvest and cost logging forms stamp the entry date. Paid invoices use their recorded payment date. Check the actual source dates and keep late-entry evidence; do not assume every chart month is the date work happened.
afrikaans_draft: Vorms vir die aanteken van oeste en koste stempel die inskrywingsdatum. Betaalde fakture gebruik hul aangetekende betaaldatum. Kontroleer die werklike brondatums en hou bewyse van laat inskrywings; moenie aanneem dat elke grafiekmaand die datum is waarop werk gebeur het nie.

key: A paid invoice has one payment date for its whole amount. The app cannot show a full instalment history from that field. Keep separate evidence for part payments and do not mark a deposit as full payment.
english: A paid invoice has one payment date for its whole amount. The app cannot show a full instalment history from that field. Keep separate evidence for part payments and do not mark a deposit as full payment.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Betaalde faktuur het een betaaldatum vir sy hele bedrag. Die app kan nie 'n volledige paaiementgeskiedenis uit daardie veld wys nie. Hou afsonderlike bewyse vir gedeeltelike betalings en moenie 'n deposito as volle betaling merk nie.

key: Do not invent a sale to change a chart. Investigate the period, missing records and original evidence.
english: Do not invent a sale to change a chart. Investigate the period, missing records and original evidence.
afrikaans_draft: Moenie 'n verkoping versin om 'n grafiek te verander nie. Ondersoek die tydperk, ontbrekende rekords en oorspronklike bewyse.

key: Practise with the sample tour. Its figures belong to an example farm. Keep practice files separate from your own records and do not send them to a lender or customer.
english: Practise with the sample tour. Its figures belong to an example farm. Keep practice files separate from your own records and do not send them to a lender or customer.
afrikaans_draft: Oefen met die voorbeeldtoer. Sy syfers behoort aan 'n voorbeeldplaas. Hou oefenlêers afsonderlik van jou eie rekords en moenie dit na 'n lener of kliënt stuur nie.

key: On a phone or compact screen, Export this month (CSV) exports the current calendar month. The chart’s 6m, 12m and 24m buttons do not change that export. Use the wide Financial sheet when you need its other periods.
english: On a phone or compact screen, Export this month (CSV) exports the current calendar month. The chart’s 6m, 12m and 24m buttons do not change that export. Use the wide Financial sheet when you need its other periods.
afrikaans_draft: Op 'n foon of kompakte skerm voer Voer hierdie maand uit (CSV) die huidige kalendermaand uit. Die grafiek se 6m-, 12m- en 24m-knoppies verander nie daardie uitvoer nie. Gebruik die breë Finansiële staat wanneer jy sy ander tydperke nodig het.

key: Read any Check warning before adding totals. A possible duplicate needs investigation against its source. If there are no rows, check the period and saved records before concluding that nothing happened.
english: Read any Check warning before adding totals. A possible duplicate needs investigation against its source. If there are no rows, check the period and saved records before concluding that nothing happened.
afrikaans_draft: Lees enige Check-waarskuwing voordat jy totale optel. 'n Moontlike duplikaat moet teen sy bron ondersoek word. As daar geen rye is nie, kontroleer die tydperk en gestoorde rekords voordat jy besluit dat niks gebeur het nie.

key: You can trace a row, explain its date and units, and identify any warning.
english: You can trace a row, explain its date and units, and identify any warning.
afrikaans_draft: Jy kan 'n ry naspeur, sy datum en eenhede verduidelik en enige waarskuwing identifiseer.

key: For this practice, stop with your checked sample copy. Explain its limits; do not submit example records as your own.
english: For this practice, stop with your checked sample copy. Explain its limits; do not submit example records as your own.
afrikaans_draft: Stop vir hierdie oefening by jou nagegaande voorbeeldkopie. Verduidelik sy beperkings; moenie voorbeeldrekords as jou eie indien nie.

key: The exports summarise entered records. They do not verify payment, certify complete accounts or establish eligibility for finance. Keep the evidence and unresolved questions available for the person helping you.
english: The exports summarise entered records. They do not verify payment, certify complete accounts or establish eligibility for finance. Keep the evidence and unresolved questions available for the person helping you.

key: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Turn site evidence into a report. Its pictures, household interview and soil values are examples. Do not use them as evidence about your own land.
english: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Turn site evidence into a report. Its pictures, household interview and soil values are examples. Do not use them as evidence about your own land.
afrikaans_draft: Om te oefen, maak die voorbeeldtoer oop en kies Verander terreinbewyse in 'n verslag. Sy foto's, huishoudingsonderhoud en grondwaardes is voorbeelde. Moenie dit as bewyse oor jou eie grond gebruik nie.

key: Review the site and household survey. Write what was observed or reported, and identify what you still need to check. Do not invent an answer to fill a gap.
english: Review the site and household survey. Write what was observed or reported, and identify what you still need to check. Do not invent an answer to fill a gap.
afrikaans_draft: Hersien die terrein- en huishoudingsopname. Skryf neer wat waargeneem of gerapporteer is, en identifiseer wat jy nog moet nagaan. Moenie 'n antwoord versin om 'n gaping te vul nie.

key: Use the sample tour for practice. Its progress is disposable. Do not keep your real course evidence in the sample workspace. Ask your facilitator which module and practical task to work on.
english: Use the sample tour for practice. Its progress is disposable. Do not keep your real course evidence in the sample workspace. Ask your facilitator which module and practical task to work on.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik die voorbeeldtoer om te oefen. Sy vordering is weggooibaar. Moenie jou werklike kursusbewyse in die voorbeeldwerkruimte hou nie. Vra jou fasiliteerder aan watter module en praktiese taak jy moet werk.

key:
A brief says what the design should help people do. Begin by listening. Ask who uses the place, what is already working and what is difficult. Ask about food, movement, care work and what people want to protect. People may value privacy, a familiar gathering place or a clear route as much as another growing area.

Include the people who do the work. Do not ask only the person who speaks first. A proposal that relies on another person's daily labour needs their agreement. Ask what happens when the usual carer is away. Keep private household information out of a public course example.

Separate a need from an idea. “We need a reliable way to water the existing garden” states a need. “We need a new tank” suggests one possible response. The response still needs information about supply, demand, location, cost and care. Drawing it does not answer those questions.

Write the priorities in plain language, or record them with consent as an oral explanation. Say what is outside this first phase. Record available resources as known, reported or still unknown. Read the brief back to the household and invite corrections. Disagreement is useful information; do not hide it to finish the sheet.

'n Opdrag sê waarmee die ontwerp mense moet help. Begin deur te luister. Vra wie die plek gebruik, wat reeds werk en wat moeilik is. Vra oor kos, beweging, versorgingswerk en wat mense wil beskerm. Mense kan privaatheid, 'n bekende byeenkomsplek of 'n duidelike roete net soveel waardeer as nog 'n groeiarea.

Sluit die mense in wat die werk doen. Moenie net die persoon vra wat eerste praat nie. 'n Voorstel wat op 'n ander persoon se daaglikse arbeid staatmaak, het hul instemming nodig. Vra wat gebeur wanneer die gewone versorger weg is. Hou private huishoudingsinligting uit 'n openbare kursusvoorbeeld.

Skei 'n behoefte van 'n idee. “Ons het 'n betroubare manier nodig om die bestaande tuin nat te lei” stel 'n behoefte. “Ons het 'n nuwe tenk nodig” stel een moontlike reaksie voor. Die reaksie het steeds inligting nodig oor aanbod, vraag, ligging, koste en versorging. Om dit te teken, beantwoord nie daardie vrae nie.

Skryf die prioriteite in eenvoudige taal, of teken dit met toestemming as 'n mondelinge verduideliking op. Sê wat buite hierdie eerste fase val. Teken beskikbare hulpbronne aan as bekend, gerapporteer of nog onbekend. Lees die opdrag terug aan die huishouding en nooi regstellings uit. Onenigheid is nuttige inligting; moenie dit verberg om die blad klaar te maak nie.

key: Getting started and evidence guides. A paper brief is valid; do not put private household details into a public sample.
english: Getting started and evidence guides. A paper brief is valid; do not put private household details into a public sample.
afrikaans_draft: Gidse om te begin en oor bewyse. 'n Papieropdrag is geldig; moenie private huishoudingsbesonderhede in 'n openbare voorbeeld sit nie.

key:
Observation starts with what is there. Walk safely with someone who knows the place. Look at routes, water points, ground cover, shade, buildings, growing areas and signs of past use. Listen to the people who use the site. A short visit and a long memory offer different evidence.

Keep those differences visible. “I saw this” is an observation. “The resident described this” is a report. “I measured this” needs the method and unit. “I think this may happen” is an interpretation. “I want to put this here” is a proposal. All can be useful, but they are not interchangeable.

Record when and under what conditions you observed. A shaded patch during one visit is not a full seasonal sunlight record. A dry water point on one day does not by itself explain the cause or the whole year's supply. Look again when it is safe and useful. Do not wait for perfect knowledge before keeping a record, and do not pretend a short visit supplies it.

Use a notebook, labelled drawing or consented photograph. Give each piece of evidence a short reference you can put on the map. If a plant, pipe or boundary is uncertain, label the uncertainty. Do not identify a plant or underground service from an attractive illustration.

Waarneming begin met wat daar is. Loop veilig saam met iemand wat die plek ken. Kyk na roetes, waterpunte, grondbedekking, skadu, geboue, groeiareas en tekens van vorige gebruik. Luister na die mense wat die terrein gebruik. 'n Kort besoek en 'n lang geheue bied verskillende bewyse.

Hou daardie verskille sigbaar. “Ek het dit gesien” is 'n waarneming. “Die inwoner het dit beskryf” is 'n verslag. “Ek het dit gemeet” het die metode en eenheid nodig. “Ek dink dit kan gebeur” is 'n interpretasie. “Ek wil dit hier sit” is 'n voorstel. Almal kan nuttig wees, maar hulle is nie uitruilbaar nie.

Teken aan wanneer en onder watter toestande jy waargeneem het. 'n Skaduryke kol tydens een besoek is nie 'n volledige seisoenale sonligrekord nie. 'n Droë waterpunt op een dag verklaar nie op sy eie die oorsaak of die hele jaar se voorsiening nie. Kyk weer wanneer dit veilig en nuttig is. Moenie vir volmaakte kennis wag voordat jy 'n rekord hou nie, en moenie voorgee dat 'n kort besoek dit verskaf nie.

Gebruik 'n notaboek, 'n gemerkte tekening of 'n foto met toestemming. Gee elke stuk bewyse 'n kort verwysing wat jy op die kaart kan sit. As 'n plant, pyp of grens onseker is, merk die onsekerheid. Moenie 'n plant of ondergrondse diens uit 'n aantreklike illustrasie identifiseer nie.

key: WALK-A records the route and carried containers as seen. TALK-A records the resident's rain account as reported. The learner does not turn that account into a measured contour or flood depth. Further investigation becomes an action in the evidence register.
english: WALK-A records the route and carried containers as seen. TALK-A records the resident's rain account as reported. The learner does not turn that account into a measured contour or flood depth. Further investigation becomes an action in the evidence register.
afrikaans_draft: WALK-A teken die roete en die houers wat gedra word aan soos gesien. TALK-A teken die inwoner se verhaal oor die reën aan soos gerapporteer. Die leerder verander nie daardie verhaal in 'n gemete kontoer of vloeddiepte nie. Verdere ondersoek word 'n aksie in die bewysregister.

key: The learner distinguishes observed, reported, measured, inferred and proposed information, and names a useful next check. More photographs do not automatically mean better evidence.
english: The learner distinguishes observed, reported, measured, inferred and proposed information, and names a useful next check. More photographs do not automatically mean better evidence.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder onderskei waargeneemde, gerapporteerde, gemete, afgeleide en voorgestelde inligting, en noem 'n nuttige volgende kontrole. Meer foto's beteken nie outomaties beter bewyse nie.

key:
A base map shows the place before the proposed changes. It helps everyone discuss the same site. Show the existing buildings, access routes, water points, growing areas and other features that matter to the brief. Mark north when you have checked it, and keep the source of the boundary visible.

A first sketch may help you understand relationships. Label it “not to scale” if that is what it is. Before using a plan to judge fit, check the measurements and use a consistent scale. Keep units with dimensions. Measure relevant widths and distances safely, and record whether a value was measured, taken from a source or estimated. A precise-looking line is not proof of a precise measurement.

Keep the existing map and the proposal separate. A transparent sheet over paper, a saved copy or a clearly labelled proposal layer lets you try ideas while preserving what is actually there. Do not silently shift the house, path or boundary to make an idea fit. A traced satellite picture can be a starting reference; it does not by itself establish legal ownership or a surveyed boundary.

Give the map a title, date or revision, legend and source notes. Use words as well as colour so a printed or colour-blind reader can distinguish existing features, proposed changes and uncertain information. Leave enough space for labels to be read.
