'n Basiskaart wys die plek voor die voorgestelde veranderinge. Dit help almal om dieselfde terrein te bespreek. Wys die bestaande geboue, toegangsroetes, waterpunte, groeiareas en ander kenmerke wat vir die opdrag saak maak. Merk noord wanneer jy dit nagegaan het, en hou die bron van die grens sigbaar.

'n Eerste skets kan jou help om verhoudings te verstaan. Merk dit “nie volgens skaal nie” as dit is wat dit is. Voordat jy 'n plan gebruik om te beoordeel of iets pas, kontroleer die metings en gebruik 'n konsekwente skaal. Hou eenhede by afmetings. Meet tersaaklike breedtes en afstande veilig, en teken aan of 'n waarde gemeet, uit 'n bron geneem of geskat is. 'n Lyn wat presies lyk, is nie bewys van 'n presiese meting nie.

Hou die bestaande kaart en die voorstel afsonderlik. 'n Deursigtige vel oor papier, 'n gestoorde kopie of 'n duidelik gemerkte voorstellaag laat jou idees probeer terwyl jy bewaar wat werklik daar is. Moenie die huis, paadjie of grens stilweg skuif om 'n idee te laat pas nie. 'n Nagetrekte satellietfoto kan 'n beginverwysing wees; dit bewys nie op sy eie wettige eienaarskap of 'n opgemete grens nie.

Gee die kaart 'n titel, datum of hersiening, sleutel en bronnotas. Gebruik woorde sowel as kleur sodat 'n gedrukte of kleurblinde leser bestaande kenmerke, voorgestelde veranderinge en onseker inligting kan onderskei. Laat genoeg spasie sodat etikette gelees kan word.

key:
Zone planning considers how people use and care for things. Something needing frequent attention should be considered in relation to the routes people already take. Look at the actual work: visiting, watering, harvesting, feeding, carrying and checking. A short distance on paper may still be awkward if there is a steep step, a locked gate or an obstructed path.

Zones are a thinking tool, not compulsory rings. A small site does not need to contain every zone. Do not assign a fixed zone to every animal or crop without considering its care and the household. The placement must also suit the element's other needs.

Sector analysis considers influences such as sun, wind, incoming water and neighbouring activities. Use the evidence for this site. Label a direction as observed, reported or still needing confirmation. A regional description is not proof that the wind at this particular home always comes from one direction.

Put the layers beside each other. Convenience may suggest a place near the home; shade, access or other constraints may make that place unsuitable. This is a question to resolve, not a reason to ignore one of the layers. Explain both the benefit and the limitation of a proposed position.

Sonebeplanning oorweeg hoe mense dinge gebruik en versorg. Iets wat gereelde aandag nodig het, moet oorweeg word in verhouding tot die roetes wat mense reeds loop. Kyk na die werklike werk: besoek, natlei, oes, voer, dra en nagaan. 'n Kort afstand op papier kan steeds lastig wees as daar 'n steil trap, 'n geslote hek of 'n versperde paadjie is.

Sones is 'n denkhulpmiddel, nie verpligte ringe nie. 'n Klein terrein hoef nie elke sone te bevat nie. Moenie 'n vaste sone aan elke dier of gewas toeken sonder om sy versorging en die huishouding te oorweeg nie. Die plasing moet ook by die element se ander behoeftes pas.

Sektorontleding oorweeg invloede soos son, wind, inkomende water en bure se aktiwiteite. Gebruik die bewyse vir hierdie terrein. Merk 'n rigting as waargeneem, gerapporteer of nog te bevestig. 'n Streeksbeskrywing is nie bewys dat die wind by hierdie spesifieke huis altyd uit een rigting kom nie.

Sit die lae langs mekaar. Gerief kan 'n plek naby die huis voorstel; skadu, toegang of ander beperkings kan daardie plek ongeskik maak. Dit is 'n vraag om op te los, nie 'n rede om een van die lae te ignoreer nie. Verduidelik sowel die voordeel as die beperking van 'n voorgestelde posisie.

key:
A design brings different observations together. Trace how people reach the places they use, where water is observed or reported, and where shade changes. Consider how the same arrangement might work in different conditions. Keep a useful access route in view while thinking about a new growing area.

The position of a water point does not tell you how much suitable water is reliably available. A tank drawn higher on a map is not necessarily higher on the ground. A flow arrow does not supply levels, soil information, a safe outlet or permission to redirect water. Those questions need appropriate evidence and, where relevant, qualified help. Keep drainage and construction proposals separate from what is already known.

A photograph of a green site does not prove year-round supply. Ask what changes during dry periods, rain, cold or household absence. Use local records and the existing seasonal-planning lessons to decide what else to observe. Do not copy a calendar or a fixed compass rule from another place without checking its relevance.

Some constraints change the scope of a proposal. If water, access or care is unresolved, improving a smaller existing area may be worth comparing with expansion. Deferring a feature can be a sound design decision. Explain the missing evidence and the next action so “later” does not mean forgotten.

'n Ontwerp bring verskillende waarnemings saam. Volg hoe mense die plekke bereik wat hulle gebruik, waar water waargeneem of gerapporteer word, en waar skadu verander. Oorweeg hoe dieselfde rangskikking in verskillende toestande kan werk. Hou 'n nuttige toegangsroete in gedagte terwyl jy aan 'n nuwe groeiarea dink.

Die posisie van 'n waterpunt sê nie vir jou hoeveel geskikte water betroubaar beskikbaar is nie. 'n Tenk wat hoër op 'n kaart geteken is, is nie noodwendig hoër op die grond nie. 'n Vloeipyl verskaf nie vlakke, grondinligting, 'n veilige uitlaat of toestemming om water om te lei nie. Daardie vrae het gepaste bewyse nodig en, waar tersaaklik, gekwalifiseerde hulp. Hou dreinerings- en konstruksievoorstelle afsonderlik van wat reeds bekend is.

'n Foto van 'n groen terrein bewys nie voorsiening die hele jaar deur nie. Vra wat verander tydens droë tydperke, reën, koue of wanneer die huishouding afwesig is. Gebruik plaaslike rekords en die bestaande lesse oor seisoenale beplanning om te besluit wat nog waargeneem moet word. Moenie 'n kalender of 'n vaste kompasreël van 'n ander plek kopieer sonder om die toepaslikheid daarvan na te gaan nie.

Sommige beperkings verander die omvang van 'n voorstel. As water, toegang of versorging onopgelos is, kan dit die moeite werd wees om die verbetering van 'n kleiner bestaande area met uitbreiding te vergelyk. Om 'n kenmerk uit te stel, kan 'n gesonde ontwerpbesluit wees. Verduidelik die ontbrekende bewyse en die volgende aksie sodat “later” nie vergete beteken nie.

key: The busy-yard learner keeps the used route clear on every concept. They mark the eastern water report for further investigation rather than drawing a trench. They ask about the reliability and suitability of the existing supply before promising a larger garden.
english: The busy-yard learner keeps the used route clear on every concept. They mark the eastern water report for further investigation rather than drawing a trench. They ask about the reliability and suitability of the existing supply before promising a larger garden.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder in die besige-werf-geval hou die gebruikte roete oop in elke konsep. Hulle merk die waterverslag in die ooste vir verdere ondersoek eerder as om 'n sloot te teken. Hulle vra oor die betroubaarheid en geskiktheid van die bestaande voorsiening voordat hulle 'n groter tuin belowe.

key: Does drawing a swale settle whether it is suitable or safe to build?
english: Does drawing a swale settle whether it is suitable or safe to build?
afrikaans_draft: Bepaal die teken van 'n kontoersloot of dit geskik of veilig is om te bou?

key: Mapping, design and crop-planning guides. Keep a proposed water feature labelled as proposed; do not mistake software availability for site suitability.
english: Mapping, design and crop-planning guides. Keep a proposed water feature labelled as proposed; do not mistake software availability for site suitability.
afrikaans_draft: Karterings-, ontwerp- en gewasbeplanningsgidse. Hou 'n voorgestelde waterkenmerk as voorgestel gemerk; moenie die beskikbaarheid daarvan in sagteware met terreingeskiktheid verwar nie.

key:
Analysis turns the brief and evidence into questions that can guide a design. For each important observation, explain why it matters to the household. Then identify a possible response and what would need to be true for that response to work.

Keep the chain visible: need, evidence, implication, possible response, missing check. If a step is missing, return to it. A learner may notice that a route is used frequently, but still need to ask who uses it and what they carry before changing its shape.

Use the ethics in a practical way. Who gains from a proposal? Who takes on more work? What existing life, soil, water or shared resource could be harmed? A benefit for one element may create a problem elsewhere. Do not call a system sustainable simply because it has many features or recycles something.

Write criteria before choosing your favourite drawing. Criteria come from the brief and site evidence: access remains usable, care is agreed, water needs can be met, and important unknowns are resolved or the affected work is deferred. A criterion needs evidence. “Looks natural” alone does not demonstrate that the household can maintain it.

Ontleding verander die opdrag en bewyse in vrae wat 'n ontwerp kan rig. Verduidelik vir elke belangrike waarneming waarom dit vir die huishouding saak maak. Identifiseer dan 'n moontlike reaksie en wat waar sou moet wees vir daardie reaksie om te werk.

Hou die ketting sigbaar: behoefte, bewyse, implikasie, moontlike reaksie, ontbrekende kontrole. As 'n stap ontbreek, gaan terug daarna. 'n Leerder kan opmerk dat 'n roete gereeld gebruik word, maar moet steeds vra wie dit gebruik en wat hulle dra voordat die vorm daarvan verander word.

Gebruik die etiek op 'n praktiese manier. Wie trek voordeel uit 'n voorstel? Wie neem meer werk op hom? Watter bestaande lewe, grond, water of gedeelde hulpbron kan skade ly? 'n Voordeel vir een element kan elders 'n probleem skep. Moenie 'n stelsel volhoubaar noem net omdat dit baie kenmerke het of iets herwin nie.

Skryf kriteria neer voordat jy jou gunstelingtekening kies. Kriteria kom uit die opdrag en terreinbewyse: toegang bly bruikbaar, versorging is ooreengekom, waterbehoeftes kan nagekom word, en belangrike onbekendes is opgelos of die betrokke werk is uitgestel. 'n Kriterium het bewyse nodig. “Lyk natuurlik” alleen toon nie dat die huishouding dit kan onderhou nie.

key:
A useful connection is more than a line between two objects. Ask what each part needs, what it produces, who cares for it and how things move between the parts. A compost area may receive suitable material and supply finished compost, but someone must sort, carry and manage it. Its position must allow that work and suit local hygiene and site conditions.

Write needs and outputs beside the elements you are considering. Include water, suitable materials, space, access, time and skills. Do not count an output before it is available and suitable for its intended use. A proposed animal system does not provide free fertility: animals also require care, feed, water, welfare and management of wastes.

Look for useful connections, but also conflicts. A convenient position might obstruct a route. One person's useful output might create another person's handling burden. A connection that needs daily attention can fail if nobody agrees to provide it. Keep bought inputs and materials leaving the site in the picture; a neat cycle diagram does not prove that everything is supplied on site.

'n Nuttige verbinding is meer as 'n lyn tussen twee voorwerpe. Vra wat elke deel nodig het, wat dit lewer, wie dit versorg en hoe dinge tussen die dele beweeg. 'n Komposarea kan geskikte materiaal ontvang en klaar kompos verskaf, maar iemand moet dit sorteer, dra en bestuur. Sy posisie moet daardie werk moontlik maak en by plaaslike higiëne en terreintoestande pas.

Skryf behoeftes en uitsette langs die elemente wat jy oorweeg. Sluit water, geskikte materiale, ruimte, toegang, tyd en vaardighede in. Moenie 'n uitset tel voordat dit beskikbaar en geskik is vir die bedoelde gebruik nie. 'n Voorgestelde dierestelsel verskaf nie gratis vrugbaarheid nie: diere vereis ook versorging, voer, water, welsyn en bestuur van afval.

Soek na nuttige verbindings, maar ook na botsings. 'n Gerieflike posisie kan 'n roete versper. Een persoon se nuttige uitset kan vir 'n ander persoon 'n hanteringslas skep. 'n Verbinding wat daaglikse aandag nodig het, kan misluk as niemand instem om dit te gee nie. Hou aangekoopte insette en materiale wat die terrein verlaat in die prentjie; 'n netjiese siklusdiagram bewys nie dat alles op die terrein voorsien word nie.

key: The busy yard already connects the home, water point and growing patch through a carrying route. Before adding another system, the learner asks whether the current care journey can be improved. BRIEF-A excludes animals from this phase, so livestock are not added to complete a decorative cycle.
english: The busy yard already connects the home, water point and growing patch through a carrying route. Before adding another system, the learner asks whether the current care journey can be improved. BRIEF-A excludes animals from this phase, so livestock are not added to complete a decorative cycle.
afrikaans_draft: Die besige werf verbind reeds die huis, waterpunt en groeikol deur 'n draroete. Voordat 'n ander stelsel bygevoeg word, vra die leerder of die huidige versorgingsroete verbeter kan word. BRIEF-A sluit diere uit hierdie fase uit, so vee word nie bygevoeg om 'n dekoratiewe siklus te voltooi nie.

key:
A first idea is a starting point. Make different concept arrangements while changes are still easy. Keep the same brief, base map and evidence for each. A comparison is unfair if one option receives an imaginary water supply or unpaid labour while the other must use the recorded resources.

A concept shows the main relationships and intended uses. It does not yet settle every dimension or technical detail. Use a proposal overlay so existing features remain visible. Label what is retained, changed, added or deferred. Keep unresolved matters beside the affected part of each option.

Make the alternatives genuinely useful. They might compare improving an existing growing area with relocating it, or a modest first phase with later expansion. Do not make one option deliberately foolish so your favourite wins. Keeping the present arrangement while gathering evidence can also be a reasonable option.

'n Eerste idee is 'n beginpunt. Maak verskillende konseprangskikkings terwyl veranderinge nog maklik is. Hou dieselfde opdrag, basiskaart en bewyse vir elkeen. 'n Vergelyking is onregverdig as een opsie 'n denkbeeldige watervoorsiening of onbetaalde arbeid kry terwyl die ander die aangetekende hulpbronne moet gebruik.

'n Konsep wys die hoofverhoudings en bedoelde gebruike. Dit bepaal nog nie elke afmeting of tegniese besonderheid nie. Gebruik 'n voorsteloorleg sodat bestaande kenmerke sigbaar bly. Merk wat behou, verander, bygevoeg of uitgestel word. Hou onopgeloste sake langs die betrokke deel van elke opsie.

Maak die alternatiewe werklik nuttig. Hulle kan die verbetering van 'n bestaande groeiarea met die verskuiwing daarvan vergelyk, of 'n beskeie eerste fase met latere uitbreiding. Moenie een opsie doelbewus dwaas maak sodat jou gunsteling wen nie. Om die huidige rangskikking te behou terwyl bewyse ingesamel word, kan ook 'n redelike opsie wees.

key:
Compare the options against the criteria you wrote from the brief. Start with needs that cannot be traded away: usable access, agreed care, required permissions and a proposal's basic suitability. Then consider benefits, burdens, costs and what may change over time.

Use words and evidence references. “Possible, but water evidence is missing” is more honest than a precise-looking score with no basis. If you use a scoring exercise, agree what each score means and who chooses the priorities. Adding scores must not cancel an unresolved safety or permission requirement.

Ask the household to explain the choice in its own words. A designer's preference should not quietly replace the household's priorities. Record why an option was chosen, why another was set aside and what new information could change the decision. A conditional choice is valid when its condition is clear and the affected work waits.

afrikaans_draft:
Vergelyk die opsies met die kriteria wat jy uit die opdrag geskryf het. Begin met behoeftes wat nie verruil kan word nie: bruikbare toegang, ooreengekome versorging, vereiste toestemmings en 'n voorstel se basiese geskiktheid. Oorweeg dan voordele, laste, koste en wat oor tyd kan verander.

Gebruik woorde en bewysverwysings. “Moontlik, maar waterbewyse ontbreek” is eerliker as 'n telling wat presies lyk maar geen grondslag het nie. As jy 'n puntetoekenningsoefening gebruik, kom ooreen wat elke telling beteken en wie die prioriteite kies. Om tellings op te tel, mag nie 'n onopgeloste veiligheids- of toestemmingsvereiste kanselleer nie.

Vra die huishouding om die keuse in hul eie woorde te verduidelik. 'n Ontwerper se voorkeur moet nie stilweg die huishouding se prioriteite vervang nie. Teken aan waarom 'n opsie gekies is, waarom 'n ander opsy gesit is en watter nuwe inligting die besluit kan verander. 'n Voorwaardelike keuse is geldig wanneer die voorwaarde duidelik is en die betrokke werk wag.

key: Design and evidence guides. Keep versions of alternative concepts; do not overwrite the existing base or silently change measured features when comparing layouts.
english: Design and evidence guides. Keep versions of alternative concepts; do not overwrite the existing base or silently change measured features when comparing layouts.
afrikaans_draft: Ontwerp- en bewysgidse. Hou weergawes van alternatiewe konsepte; moenie die bestaande basis oorskryf of gemete kenmerke stilweg verander wanneer jy uitlegte vergelyk nie.

key:
A concept explains an arrangement. A developed layout must also show whether its parts fit the available space. Return to the base-map measurements. Check the boundaries relevant to the work, the existing features, access and the distances needed to place the proposal. Keep the measurement method and units with the record.

Use a consistent scale for the plan. Check a known distance against that scale rather than trusting how large the picture looks on a screen. Resizing an image can change its printed scale. A dimension label and the drawn geometry should agree; if they disagree, find the source of the error before using either.

Allow for working access and the needs of the selected system. Do not borrow a universal spacing from a decorative drawing. Use the approved technical source for the actual crop, structure or system, including growth and maintenance needs. If the required dimension is unknown, mark that part incomplete.

'n Konsep verduidelik 'n rangskikking. 'n Ontwikkelde uitleg moet ook wys of sy dele in die beskikbare ruimte pas. Gaan terug na die basiskaart se metings. Kontroleer die grense wat vir die werk tersaaklik is, die bestaande kenmerke, toegang en die afstande wat nodig is om die voorstel te plaas. Hou die meetmetode en eenhede by die rekord.

Gebruik 'n konsekwente skaal vir die plan. Kontroleer 'n bekende afstand teen daardie skaal eerder as om te vertrou op hoe groot die prent op 'n skerm lyk. Om 'n beeld se grootte te verander, kan sy gedrukte skaal verander. 'n Afmetingsetiket en die getekende meetkunde moet ooreenstem; as hulle verskil, vind die bron van die fout voordat jy enigeen gebruik.

Maak voorsiening vir werktoegang en die behoeftes van die gekose stelsel. Moenie 'n universele spasiëring uit 'n dekoratiewe tekening leen nie. Gebruik die goedgekeurde tegniese bron vir die werklike gewas, struktuur of stelsel, insluitend groei- en onderhoudsbehoeftes. As die vereiste afmeting onbekend is, merk daardie deel as onvolledig.

key: On a measured practice site supplied by the facilitator, reconcile the written dimensions, units and scaled drawing. Point to the information that establishes fit. On your own design, mark any proposal still awaiting measurement or technical dimensions. Do not conduct unsafe or specialist surveying as an unsupervised course task.
english: On a measured practice site supplied by the facilitator, reconcile the written dimensions, units and scaled drawing. Point to the information that establishes fit. On your own design, mark any proposal still awaiting measurement or technical dimensions. Do not conduct unsafe or specialist surveying as an unsupervised course task.
afrikaans_draft: Versoen die geskrewe afmetings, eenhede en skaaltekening op 'n gemete oefenterrein wat die fasiliteerder verskaf. Wys na die inligting wat bewys dat iets pas. Merk op jou eie ontwerp enige voorstel wat nog op meting of tegniese afmetings wag. Moenie onveilige of gespesialiseerde opmeting as 'n kursustaak sonder toesig doen nie.

key:
Fitting the objects is only one check. Follow the people, water, materials and maintenance journeys between them. Check that a route remains usable when people carry tools or produce. Ask whether a mature planting or a stored material could obstruct access that is clear in today's drawing.

Look beyond the selected area. A water change can affect places downstream; a fence can affect shared access. Record the people and resources affected. The design folder should identify relevant permissions and technical advice, not assume them from a boundary line or software tool.

Ask how the system behaves when something goes wrong. If supply is interrupted, who responds? If a component blocks or overflows, where could the problem go? Technical designs need appropriate assessment; do not invent a safe outlet or drainage capacity. When evidence is incomplete, hold the affected work and explain the dependency.

afrikaans_draft:
Om die voorwerpe te laat pas, is net een kontrole. Volg die roetes van mense, water, materiale en onderhoud tussen hulle. Kontroleer dat 'n roete bruikbaar bly wanneer mense gereedskap of produkte dra. Vra of 'n volwasse aanplanting of 'n gebergde materiaal toegang kan versper wat in vandag se tekening oop is.

Kyk verder as die gekose area. 'n Waterverandering kan plekke stroomaf raak; 'n heining kan gedeelde toegang raak. Teken die mense en hulpbronne aan wat geraak word. Die ontwerplêer moet tersaaklike toestemmings en tegniese advies identifiseer, nie dit uit 'n grenslyn of sagtewarehulpmiddel aanneem nie.

Vra hoe die stelsel optree wanneer iets verkeerd loop. As voorsiening onderbreek word, wie reageer? As 'n komponent verstop of oorloop, waarheen kan die probleem gaan? Tegniese ontwerpe het gepaste beoordeling nodig; moenie 'n veilige uitlaat of dreineringskapasiteit versin nie. Wanneer bewyse onvolledig is, hou die betrokke werk terug en verduidelik die afhanklikheid.

key: Does the presence of a Water or Earthworks tool mean any placement it accepts is suitable?
english: Does the presence of a Water or Earthworks tool mean any placement it accepts is suitable?
afrikaans_draft: Beteken die teenwoordigheid van 'n Water- of Grondwerke-hulpmiddel dat enige plasing wat dit aanvaar, geskik is?

key:
A plan communicates decisions. Give it a clear title, revision and purpose. Show orientation, scale status, units, legend and sources. Distinguish existing features from proposed changes and unresolved information using labels or patterns as well as colour. Keep labels near the correct features without covering essential details.

Separate information when a single sheet becomes crowded. A base map, analysis overlay, proposal and phase sheet can tell different parts of the same story. Keep feature names and references consistent between them. The cost record and care plan should refer to the same items shown on the map.

Inspect the actual export at the size it will be used. Can someone read it on a phone or printed sheet? Are labels clipped? Does the legend describe things that are really present? Does decorative artwork hide a path or imply features that were never recorded? Correct the output and check again.

'n Plan kommunikeer besluite. Gee dit 'n duidelike titel, hersiening en doel. Wys oriëntasie, skaalstatus, eenhede, sleutel en bronne. Onderskei bestaande kenmerke van voorgestelde veranderinge en onopgeloste inligting met etikette of patrone sowel as kleur. Hou etikette naby die regte kenmerke sonder om noodsaaklike besonderhede te bedek.

Skei inligting wanneer een blad te vol word. 'n Basiskaart, ontledingsoorleg, voorstel en faseblad kan verskillende dele van dieselfde storie vertel. Hou kenmerkname en verwysings tussen hulle konsekwent. Die kosterekord en versorgingsplan moet na dieselfde items verwys wat op die kaart gewys word.

Ondersoek die werklike uitvoer op die grootte waarop dit gebruik sal word. Kan iemand dit op 'n foon of gedrukte blad lees? Is etikette afgesny? Beskryf die sleutel dinge wat werklik teenwoordig is? Verberg dekoratiewe kunswerk 'n paadjie of suggereer dit kenmerke wat nooit aangeteken is nie? Stel die uitset reg en kontroleer weer.

key: MAP-A keeps its “not to scale” status in every export. A proposal view must not lose that limitation merely because it receives a polished background. The learner uses separate labels for the retained patch and any future idea.
english: MAP-A keeps its “not to scale” status in every export. A proposal view must not lose that limitation merely because it receives a polished background. The learner uses separate labels for the retained patch and any future idea.
afrikaans_draft: MAP-A hou sy “nie volgens skaal nie”-status in elke uitvoer. 'n Voorstelaansig mag nie daardie beperking verloor net omdat dit 'n gepoleerde agtergrond kry nie. Die leerder gebruik afsonderlike etikette vir die behoue kol en enige toekomstige idee.

key:
A phase is a manageable part of the work. Its place in the sequence depends on what must be ready first. Start with the design decision, then list its prerequisites: permission, measurements, advice, suitable materials, resources, access and the people who will care for it.

Distinguish investigating from implementing. Obtaining a quotation does not commit you to buying. Marking a proposed area for discussion does not authorise digging. A design may have useful information-gathering steps even while construction is on hold.

Choose a first phase that answers the household brief and fits the resources actually agreed. Keep access and existing useful systems working during the change. Describe what would make the phase ready to begin, what would stop it and how you will check its result. Do not begin every component simply because all of them appear in the final vision.

'n Fase is 'n hanteerbare deel van die werk. Sy plek in die volgorde hang af van wat eerste gereed moet wees. Begin met die ontwerpbesluit en lys dan sy voorvereistes: toestemming, metings, advies, geskikte materiale, hulpbronne, toegang en die mense wat dit sal versorg.

Onderskei ondersoek van implementering. Om 'n kwotasie te kry, verbind jou nie om te koop nie. Om 'n voorgestelde area vir bespreking te merk, magtig nie grawe nie. 'n Ontwerp kan nuttige stappe hê om inligting in te samel, selfs terwyl konstruksie teruggehou word.

Kies 'n eerste fase wat die huishouding se opdrag beantwoord en pas by die hulpbronne wat werklik ooreengekom is. Hou toegang en bestaande nuttige stelsels werkend tydens die verandering. Beskryf wat die fase gereed sou maak om te begin, wat dit sou stop en hoe jy die resultaat sal nagaan. Moenie elke komponent begin net omdat almal in die finale visie verskyn nie.

key:
Give proposed items consistent references across the plan and cost record. Derive quantities from a checked design or record their source. Keep unknown quantities unknown. Ask for suitable quotations when a purchase is being considered; do not turn a remembered price into a current supplier offer.

Include the work and supporting materials needed for the proposal, not only its most visible object. Separate one-time purchases from ongoing care costs. Record household contributions honestly. A donated material can still require transport, preparation or maintenance; a volunteer's time still needs agreement.

The date money is needed matters. A future sale does not pay today's bill unless funding is actually available. Use the finance lessons to keep budgets, dated cash forecasts, actual payments and amounts owed distinct. Do not count a hoped-for harvest as confirmed cash or a device-generated plan as proof of profitability.

Gee voorgestelde items konsekwente verwysings oor die plan en kosterekord heen. Lei hoeveelhede af van 'n nagegaande ontwerp of teken hul bron aan. Hou onbekende hoeveelhede onbekend. Vra vir geskikte kwotasies wanneer 'n aankoop oorweeg word; moenie 'n onthoude prys in 'n huidige aanbod van 'n verskaffer verander nie.

Sluit die werk en ondersteunende materiale in wat vir die voorstel nodig is, nie net sy mees sigbare voorwerp nie. Skei eenmalige aankope van deurlopende versorgingskoste. Teken huishoudelike bydraes eerlik aan. 'n Geskenkte materiaal kan steeds vervoer, voorbereiding of onderhoud vereis; 'n vrywilliger se tyd het steeds 'n ooreenkoms nodig.

Die datum waarop geld nodig is, maak saak. 'n Toekomstige verkoping betaal nie vandag se rekening nie, tensy befondsing werklik beskikbaar is. Gebruik die finansieslesse om begrotings, gedateerde kontantvooruitskattings, werklike betalings en bedrae verskuldig afsonderlik te hou. Moenie 'n gehoopte oes as bevestigde kontant tel of 'n plan wat deur 'n toestel gegenereer is as bewys van winsgewendheid nie.

key:
A design continues after installation. Ask what must be checked, maintained, cleaned, repaired, harvested or recorded. Use the relevant technical lesson and local advice to establish the actual task. Do not assign a generic weekly schedule to living systems with different care needs.

Agree who will do each task and what they need. Ask about normal commitments and absences. A task is not allocated just because a name appears beside it; the person must understand and accept the responsibility. Plan how they will ask for help and what can be reduced if the workload is too much.

Identify relevant disruptions. Water interruptions, damaged access, a missing carer or unavailable materials may change what is feasible. Define a response that preserves welfare and safety. Where the answer depends on specialist advice, record that dependency instead of inventing an emergency procedure.

'n Ontwerp gaan voort ná installering. Vra wat nagegaan, onderhou, skoongemaak, herstel, geoes of aangeteken moet word. Gebruik die tersaaklike tegniese les en plaaslike advies om die werklike taak vas te stel. Moenie 'n algemene weeklikse skedule toeken aan lewende stelsels met verskillende versorgingsbehoeftes nie.

Kom ooreen wie elke taak sal doen en wat hulle nodig het. Vra oor normale verpligtinge en afwesighede. 'n Taak is nie toegewys net omdat 'n naam langsaan verskyn nie; die persoon moet die verantwoordelikheid verstaan en aanvaar. Beplan hoe hulle om hulp sal vra en wat verminder kan word as die werklading te veel is.

Identifiseer tersaaklike ontwrigtings. Wateronderbrekings, beskadigde toegang, 'n afwesige versorger of materiale wat nie beskikbaar is nie, kan verander wat uitvoerbaar is. Decide what to observe from the goals in the brief. If access was a priority, ask its users whether the route works and observe it under relevant conditions. If care was a concern, record the tasks and difficulties. A harvest record can inform food production, but it does not alone prove improved household nutrition or income.

Keep a starting record so later observations have context. Record what was actually implemented, when, and any changes from the plan. Note the conditions and other events that may influence the result. Do not attribute every improvement or setback to the design without considering other explanations.

A short course cannot show a whole seasonal outcome. Agree a follow-up appropriate to the decision and the situation, with actual dates set during delivery. If no implementation has occurred, assess the plan and reasoning as such. Do not substitute a generated picture or imagined harvest for observed results.

Make the information available in a format they can use without your presence.

**BRIEF-A — household discussion.** The household wants vegetables for meals, a route that stays usable between the home and gate, and care work that can fit existing commitments. It does not want animals added in this first phase. The person who usually carries water asks to be included in siting decisions. Another household member needs a route without obstructions. The household agrees to explore options in its existing yard, but that agreement is not a verified boundary survey or permission for work beyond the yard.

**WALK-A — initial visit.** A used route crosses the yard between the home and gate. The existing growing patch lies beside that route. A water point is beside the home. Containers are carried from it to the patch. The eastern part of the yard is shaded during this visit. These observations say nothing yet about the full seasonal shade pattern, water pressure, available volume, water quality or production potential.

**TALK-A — reported history.** A resident says water has crossed the eastern part during heavy rain. No rain is falling on the first visit. Record the resident's experience as reported information, with consent; do not replace it with an invented slope arrow or present it as a measured flood level.

**MAP-A — first sketch.** It locates the home, gate, used route, water point, existing patch and the area mentioned in TALK-A relative to each other. It is labelled “not to scale; boundary, north and dimensions need checking”. No compass direction is derived from an unverified photograph. The supplied statement that part of the yard is eastern is a case description, not a direction the learner has measured.

**RESOURCES-A — current limits.** Available care time, reliable water supply, soil conditions, material quantities and costs are not yet recorded. No other person's labour or money is promised. No neighbour's land, water route or access is available merely because it appears on a picture.

key:
### D1 — what is the task?

The brief prioritises food, usable access and manageable care. Adding a pond or animals is not a stated need. The facilitator asks the people doing the work what they can maintain and what must remain clear. The learner records missing resource information instead of assigning an imaginary budget.

On the first map the growing patch is an existing feature. An idea for a new patch belongs on a proposal overlay. The learner does not erase the used route because it interrupts the picture. The family report about rain is kept beside its source; it is not changed into an observed event.

### D2 — what do the facts mean?

The daily watering journey makes convenient access worth investigating. It does not prove that the closest possible location is suitable. The shade snapshot needs further seasonal evidence, and the reported water route needs examination before considering an intervention.

The learner writes: “Can we improve care of the existing patch while keeping the route usable?” This is a design question. “Build a swale through the eastern yard” would jump past the missing terrain, water, suitability and permission evidence.

For the next safe visit, the learner asks the household to show how people move through the space. They arrange further shade observations and ask who can help assess the reported water problem. They do not enter dangerous runoff to obtain a photograph. They keep all three options open: improve the existing patch, consider another suitable location, or defer expansion until resources are known.

### D1 — wat is die taak?

Die opdrag gee voorrang aan kos, bruikbare toegang en hanteerbare versorging. Om 'n dam of diere by te voeg, is nie 'n gestelde behoefte nie. Die fasiliteerder vra die mense wat die werk doen wat hulle kan onderhou en wat oop moet bly. Die leerder teken ontbrekende inligting oor hulpbronne aan in plaas daarvan om 'n denkbeeldige begroting toe te ken.

Op die eerste kaart is die groeikol 'n bestaande kenmerk. 'n Idee vir 'n nuwe kol hoort op 'n voorsteloorleg. Die leerder vee nie die gebruikte roete uit omdat dit die prent onderbreek nie. Die gesin se verslag oor reën word by sy bron gehou; dit word nie in 'n waargenome gebeurtenis verander nie.

### D2 — wat beteken die feite?

Die daaglikse natleiroete maak gerieflike toegang die moeite werd om te ondersoek. Dit bewys nie dat die naaste moontlike ligging geskik is nie. Die skadu-momentopname het verdere seisoenale bewyse nodig, en die gerapporteerde waterroete moet ondersoek word voordat 'n ingryping oorweeg word.

Die leerder skryf: “Kan ons die versorging van die bestaande kol verbeter terwyl die roete bruikbaar bly?” Dit is 'n ontwerpvraag. “Bou 'n kontoersloot deur die oostelike werf” sou verby die ontbrekende bewyse oor terrein, water, geskiktheid en toestemming spring.

Vir die volgende veilige besoek vra die leerder die huishouding om te wys hoe mense deur die ruimte beweeg. Hulle reël verdere skadu-waarnemings en vra wie kan help om die gerapporteerde waterprobleem te beoordeel. Hulle gaan nie in gevaarlike afloop in om 'n foto te kry nie. Hulle hou al drie opsies oop: verbeter die bestaande kol, oorweeg 'n ander geskikte ligging, of stel uitbreiding uit totdat hulpbronne bekend is.

The carrot exercise has R220.00 of assigned paid costs and 40 kg of marketable produce. That is R5.50 per marketable kg for those included costs. With the separate R100.00 family-time comparison, the total becomes R320.00, or R8.00 per marketable kg. These are two labelled views of one budget, not two bills to add.

If only 32 kg is expected to sell, recovering that same R320.00 entirely through those sales requires R10.00 per kg sold. This is a **sales-recovery planning target**, not the accounting cost of each item sold or a promise that a buyer will pay it. The other 8 kg is not automatically lost or household food; investigate its destination and value. Do not write off closing stock simply because it has not sold. Missing land, equipment, administration, finance and tax information means full profit is still unknown.

key:
At 30 packs, calculate revenue and both kinds of included cost. Repeat for 18 packs prepared and sold. Then keep the original prices but reduce capacity to 20. The numerical break-even point does not change, but it is outside that capacity. Never recommend “sell more” without testing production capacity and evidence of demand. Expected sales are assumptions, not confirmed orders.

If price equals or is below variable cost while fixed costs remain positive, more units do not cover those fixed costs under this model. Report no feasible break-even quantity under these assumptions, not zero units. If a cost is missing, the result is unknown; an empty value is not a free input.

key:
Decision C offers the same 20 kg of accepted produce to either Buyer A or Buyer B. A offers R10.00/kg, collects it, requires no extra packaging and pays on Day 0. A leaves R200.00 after the specified offer-specific cash costs. B leaves R195.00. A's lower headline price leaves R5.00 more at that stage. Both options also relate to R140.00 of already-incurred common costs; subtracting those gives R60.00 and R55.00, respectively. Those are partial results, not full profit. Do not charge the common cost twice or add the two offers together.

The cards separately record additional unpaid selling work: half an hour for A, one and a half for B. At the same hypothetical comparison value, that adds R12.50 or R37.50 to the management view, leaving R47.50 or R17.50 after the specified common costs and additional family-time value. The farm has not paid those wages. Other omitted work or costs could still change the full result.

Discuss four cards:

1. “The app printed a VAT number, so this is a valid tax invoice.” **Not established.** A field or title alone does not establish registration, supply treatment or all required particulars. Inspect the document with the applicable current guidance.
2. “I did not need to submit a return, so no records are needed.” **Not established.** Do not infer all record duties from that fact. Ask about the applicable requirements and any continuing audit, dispute or other obligation.
3. “My export is a complete set of accounts and guarantees a loan.” **Not established.** Check it against the other evidence. An export does not establish completeness, creditworthiness or approval.
4. “A missing stock value should be zero.” **Incorrect.** Request the count, valuation and reconciliation. Do not disguise missing information as a measured result.

key:
For January, Plan A forecasts sales of R480 and operating payments of R280. Plan B forecasts R600 and operating payments of R480. Their included cash surpluses are R200 and R120 respectively, assuming all forecast sales are paid within the period. These are not full profits: closing stock, equipment use, overheads and unpaid work are not completely supplied. Do not treat the omitted costs as zero. Do not compare R12 per kg with R30 per item as though the larger number identifies the better enterprise.

Each alternative starts with R300. A's quoted payments leave R120 on 5 January, R80 on 10 January and R20 on 20 January. The assumed R480 payment on 30 January brings its closing projection to R500. B's payments leave R20, then an unfunded -R120, then -R180; its assumed receipt brings the closing projection to R420. A positive closing forecast does not make those earlier B payments fundable. The negative amounts are projected gaps, not an assertion that a physical cash tin held negative notes or that an overdraft was approved.

The supplied work plan allows eight owner hours. A requires six; B requires ten in addition to its paid helper. B has a two-hour owner-time gap. Those are exercise capacities, not recommended work rates. A's apparent fit does not establish that a real farm has sufficient land, water, skills, labour or permissions. Check each real constraint separately using suitable local evidence.

For January, Plan A forecasts sales of R480 and operating payments of R280. Plan B forecasts R600 and operating payments of R480. Their included cash surpluses are R200 and R120 respectively, assuming all forecast sales are paid within the period. These are not full profits: closing stock, equipment use, overheads and unpaid work are not completely supplied. Do not treat the omitted costs as zero. Do not compare R12 per kg with R30 per item as though the larger number identifies the better enterprise.

Each alternative starts with R300. A's quoted payments leave R120 on 5 January, R80 on 10 January and R20 on 20 January. The assumed R480 payment on 30 January brings its closing projection to R500. B's payments leave R20, then an unfunded -R120, then -R180; its assumed receipt brings the closing projection to R420. A positive closing forecast does not make those earlier B payments fundable. The negative amounts are projected gaps, not an assertion that a physical cash tin held negative notes or that an overdraft was approved.

The supplied work plan allows eight owner hours. A requires six; B requires ten in addition to its paid helper. B has a two-hour owner-time gap. Those are exercise capacities, not recommended work rates. A's apparent fit does not establish that a real farm has sufficient land, water, skills, labour or permissions. Check each real constraint separately using suitable local evidence.

key:

key:
Move A's entire assumed R480 receipt to 5 February, retaining January's cost dates. January now has no buyer receipt and ends at R20. The projected sale remains R480; payment timing changed, not the quantity or price. The amount remains expected from the buyer at the window's end under this scenario. This is a January horizon, not a full next-season plan: later bills and obligations still need their own dated rows. A real forecast should cover the relevant operating cycle and commitments, rather than copying this short exercise horizon blindly.

A response must be specific and checked. For example, ask the buyer to confirm terms, then record any actual agreement and recalculate; obtain a genuine alternative transport quote; reconsider the proposed quantity against capacity. Do not assume a deposit, delay a supplier's bill without agreement, cut necessary care or insert hoped-for funding as certain income. Explain the effects on quality, workload, household needs and others before adopting a change.

Verduidelik die gevolge vir gehalte, werklading, huishoudelike behoeftes en ander voordat 'n verandering aanvaar word.

key: A learner submits a polished map, a screenshot of R420 closing projected cash and the R180 application. Explain why these do not prove land rights, earlier liquidity, profitability or funding approval. Ask for the dated B payments and the missing work-hour arrangement. Then give A's delayed receipt case without the answer and ask the learner to build January cash. They must leave the February receipt outside January.

key:
Actual A has 36 kg delivered at R11 per kg on 25 January, an invoice for R396. R300 arrives on 30 January, leaving R96 owed at 31 January. The remaining R96 arrives on 5 February; it is not January cash. Actual payments are purchase R180, packaging R50 and transport R80, totalling R310. An evidenced R20 owner contribution arrives on 15 January from outside this business cash scope. It is not a sale or loan. Starting with R300, the actual cash sequence is R120, R70, R90, R10 and R310. ACT-C1 reconciles the final R310 to the cash count and statement evidence. This complete model has no unfunded actual negative balance.

The closing forecast was R500; checked actual closing cash is R310, a R190 decrease against that forecast. Do not call this R190 a business loss. The sales-value difference is R84, and neither difference establishes full profit. Use the visual bridge in this stated order:

- Quantity effect: (36 - 40) kg at the planned R12 per kg = -R48.
- Price effect: 36 actual kg at (R11 - R12) per kg = -R36.
- Unpaid January balance: -R96 of the invoiced amount is not yet received.
- Purchase payment difference: R180 versus R180, no change.
- Packaging payment difference: R50 versus R40 reduces cash by R10.
- Transport payment difference: R80 versus R60 reduces cash by R20.
- Owner contribution adds R20 cash, not sales.

R500 - R48 - R36 - R96 - R10 - R20 + R20 = R310. The quantity and price effects sum to the R84 sales difference. This decomposition values the quantity change at planned price and the price change at actual quantity; different valid ordering allocates the interaction differently. It is arithmetic attribution, not proof of cause. The records do not say why fewer kilos sold or why the price changed. Do not invent crop failure, poor effort, buyer misconduct or weather as the explanation. Investigate using appropriate evidence.

Die slotvooruitskatting was R500; nagegaande werklike slotkontant is R310, 'n afname van R190 teenoor daardie vooruitskatting. Moenie hierdie R190 'n besigheidsverlies noem nie. Die verskil in verkoopwaarde is R84, en geeneen van die verskille bewys volle wins nie. Gebruik die visuele brug in hierdie gestelde volgorde:

- Hoeveelheidseffek: (36 - 40) kg teen die beplande R12 per kg = -R48.
- Pryseffek: 36 werklike kg teen (R11 - R12) per kg = -R36.
- Onbetaalde Januarie-saldo: -R96 van die gefaktureerde bedrag is nog nie ontvang nie.
- Verskil in aankoopbetaling: R180 teenoor R180, geen verandering nie.
- Verskil in verpakkingsbetaling: R50 teenoor R40 verminder kontant met R10.
- Verskil in vervoerbetaling: R80 teenoor R60 verminder kontant met R20.

Hierdie ontleding waardeer die hoeveelheidsverandering teen beplande prys en die prysverandering teen werklike hoeveelheid; 'n ander geldige volgorde deel die wisselwerking anders toe. Dit is rekenkundige toeskrywing, nie bewys van oorsaak nie. Die rekords sê nie waarom minder kilo's verkoop het of waarom die prys verander het nie. Moenie misoes, swak inspanning, wangedrag van die koper of weer as die verklaring versin nie. Ondersoek met gepaste bewyse.

Die kaart en app-rekords kan die pakket ondersteun, maar kan nie daardie kontroles vervang nie.

Moenie rekeningkundige bevoegdheid, besigheidslewensvatbaarheid, akkreditasie of goedkeuring van befondsing op grond van hierdie klaskamerpakket beweer nie.

key: Extent and levels are unmeasured; this is not a flood boundary.
english: Extent and levels are unmeasured; this is not a flood boundary.
afrikaans_draft: Omvang en vlakke is ongemeet; dit is nie 'n vloedgrens nie.

key: Name the missing evidence, a suitable way to obtain it, who can help and which decision depends on it. Keep unsafe or specialist work for appropriate help.
english: Name the missing evidence, a suitable way to obtain it, who can help and which decision depends on it. Keep unsafe or specialist work for appropriate help.
afrikaans_draft: Noem die ontbrekende bewyse, 'n geskikte manier om dit te kry, wie kan help en watter besluit daarvan afhang. Laat onveilige of gespesialiseerde werk vir gepaste hulp.

key: Ask the learner to explain a genuine trade-off between alternatives. More features or a prettier picture do not establish a better response to the brief.
english: Ask the learner to explain a genuine trade-off between alternatives. More features or a prettier picture do not establish a better response to the brief.
afrikaans_draft: Vra die leerder om 'n werklike afweging tussen alternatiewe te verduidelik. Meer kenmerke of 'n mooier prent bewys nie 'n beter reaksie op die opdrag nie.

english: Follow water, materials, people and care between features. Identify a useful connection and a possible conflict. Do not assume an output meets another part’s needs without checking suitability.
afrikaans_draft: Volg water, materiale, mense en versorging tussen kenmerke. Identifiseer 'n nuttige verbinding en 'n moontlike botsing. Moenie aanneem dat 'n uitset aan 'n ander deel se behoeftes voldoen sonder om die geskiktheid daarvan na te gaan nie.

key: Use the same feature references as the drawings. Record measured quantities, quotation references, dates and when money is needed. Label estimates and missing costs. Refer to your finance worksheet; do not turn an unknown into zero.
english: Use the same feature references as the drawings. Record measured quantities, quotation references, dates and when money is needed. Label estimates and missing costs. Refer to your finance worksheet; do not turn an unknown into zero.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik dieselfde kenmerkverwysings as die tekeninge. Teken gemete hoeveelhede, kwotasieverwysings, datums en wanneer geld nodig is, aan. Merk skattings en ontbrekende koste. Verwys na jou finansiewerkblad; moenie 'n onbekende in nul verander nie.

key: Ask what evidence would change the learner’s choice. Review a real explanation and revision record; filled boxes do not demonstrate competence or certify construction work.
english: Ask what evidence would change the learner’s choice. Review a real explanation and revision record; filled boxes do not demonstrate competence or certify construction work.
afrikaans_draft: Vra watter bewyse die leerder se keuse sou verander. Hersien 'n werklike verduideliking en hersieningsrekord; ingevulde blokkies demonstreer nie bevoegdheid nie en sertifiseer nie konstruksiewerk nie.

key: Choose observations connected to the household’s needs. Record the starting evidence, who agrees to observe, when or after which event, and what would prompt a review. Do not invent results.
english: Choose observations connected to the household’s needs. Record the starting evidence, who agrees to observe, when or after which event, and what would prompt a review. Do not invent results.
afrikaans_draft: Kies waarnemings wat aan die huishouding se behoeftes gekoppel is. Teken die beginbewyse aan, wie instem om waar te neem, wanneer of ná watter gebeurtenis, en wat 'n hersiening sou aanspoor. Moenie resultate versin nie.

key: No flood level was measured. Keep the resident’s account and identify what still needs checking.
english: No flood level was measured. Keep the resident’s account and identify what still needs checking.
afrikaans_draft: Geen vloedvlak is gemeet nie. Hou die inwoner se verhaal en identifiseer wat nog nagegaan moet word.

key: Unrecorded months are not a promise of frost-free conditions.
english: Unrecorded months are not a promise of frost-free conditions.

english: Frost-free sowing months for {names} are not yet from a published local table — check those dates with your extension officer before relying on them.

key: {names} was left out: no sowing window remains after checking your observed frost months ({months}) and the available site climate.
english: {names} was left out: no sowing window remains after checking your observed frost months ({months}) and the available site climate.

english: Check a protected growing area or local timing with your extension officer before adding frost-sensitive crops by hand.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer 'n beskutte groeigebied of plaaslike tydsberekening met jou voorligtingsbeampte voordat jy self rypgevoelige gewasse byvoeg.

english: . The warm, frost-free conditions also carry

english: thrive. Mild winters keep frost-tender crops viable on protected aspects.
afrikaans_draft: gedy. Sagte winters hou rypgevoelige gewasse lewensvatbaar op beskutte hellings.

key: . High humidity — select disease-resistant varieties and maximise airflow.
english: . High humidity — select disease-resistant varieties and maximise airflow.
afrikaans_draft: . Hoë humiditeit — kies siekteweerbare variëteite en sorg vir soveel lugvloei as moontlik.

key: on warm north-facing aspects. Protect all crops from frost and strong wind.
english: on warm north-facing aspects. Protect all crops from frost and strong wind.
afrikaans_draft: op warm noordhellings. Beskerm alle gewasse teen ryp en sterk wind.

key: This reading did not record where its numbers came from. Treat it with the same caution as a model estimate.
english: This reading did not record where its numbers came from. Treat it with the same caution as a model estimate.
afrikaans_draft: Hierdie meting het nie aangeteken waar sy syfers vandaan kom nie. Behandel dit met dieselfde versigtigheid as 'n modelskatting.

key: NOT A READING. No soil data was available for this point, so these are the app's general figures — the same numbers it would show anywhere. Do not spend money on the strength of them. A soil test is the only way to know.
english: NOT A READING. No soil data was available for this point, so these are the app's general figures — the same numbers it would show anywhere. Do not spend money on the strength of them. A soil test is the only way to know.
afrikaans_draft: NIE 'N METING NIE. Geen gronddata was vir hierdie punt beskikbaar nie, so dit is die app se algemene syfers — dieselfde getalle wat dit oral sou wys. Moenie geld op grond daarvan spandeer nie. 'n Grondtoets is die enigste manier om te weet.

key: Farmers who choose to be visible show up here as an approximate area — never their exact homestead.
english: Farmers who choose to be visible show up here as an approximate area — never their exact homestead.
afrikaans_draft: Boere wat kies om sigbaar te wees, verskyn hier as 'n benaderde gebied — nooit hul presiese opstal nie.

key: Repeat attendance counts as another attendance, not another person. Attendance and satisfaction are delivery evidence; they do not alone establish skills gained or impact.
english: Repeat attendance counts as another attendance, not another person. Attendance and satisfaction are delivery evidence; they do not alone establish skills gained or impact.
afrikaans_draft: Herhaalde bywoning tel as nog 'n bywoning, nie nog 'n persoon nie. Bywoning en tevredenheid is bewyse van lewering; hulle bewys nie op hul eie verworwe vaardighede of impak nie.

key: This is a sum of each garden’s latest recorded observation, not necessarily an area planted on one common date. Recheck at each reporting period. Organisation-checked does not mean independently audited. Crop cycles and multiple farmers do not add extra hectares.
english: This is a sum of each garden’s latest recorded observation, not necessarily an area planted on one common date. Recheck at each reporting period. Organisation-checked does not mean independently audited. Crop cycles and multiple farmers do not add extra hectares.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is 'n som van elke tuin se nuutste aangetekende waarneming, nie noodwendig 'n gebied wat op een gemeenskaplike datum geplant is nie. Kontroleer weer by elke verslagtydperk. Deur die organisasie nagegaan beteken nie onafhanklik geouditeer nie. Gewassiklusse en veelvuldige boere voeg nie ekstra hektaar by nie.

key: I checked that these areas do not overlap and this garden is not registered under another code.
english: I checked that these areas do not overlap and this garden is not registered under another code.
afrikaans_draft: Ek het nagegaan dat hierdie gebiede nie oorvleuel nie en dat hierdie tuin nie onder 'n ander kode geregistreer is nie.

key: Grain maize for mielie meal. Direct-sow in a mapped staple plot once frost risk has passed; use several adjacent rows for wind pollination. The 140-day calendar hold is conservative — confirm cultivar maturity before harvest.
english: Grain maize for mielie meal. Direct-sow in a mapped staple plot once frost risk has passed; use several adjacent rows for wind pollination. The 140-day calendar hold is conservative — confirm cultivar maturity before harvest.
afrikaans_draft: Graanmielies vir mieliemeel. Saai direk in 'n gekarteerde stapelvoedselperseel sodra die rypgevaar verby is; gebruik verskeie aangrensende rye vir windbestuiwing. Die 140 dae wat in die kalender gereserveer word, is konserwatief — bevestig die kultivar se rypwordingstyd voor die oes.

key: Plant after frost danger: November to mid-January in frost areas, or March-April in frost-free areas. Leave pods to yellow and dry before shelling and storing.
english: Plant after frost danger: November to mid-January in frost areas, or March-April in frost-free areas. Leave pods to yellow and dry before shelling and storing.
afrikaans_draft: Plant ná die rypgevaar: November tot middel-Januarie in rypgebiede, of Maart-April in rypvrye gebiede. Laat peule geel word en droog voordat jy dit uitdop en bêre.

key: Cut-and-come-again leafy brassica: pick outer leaves and the plant keeps producing, and light frost sweetens the flavour. It does not handle extreme heat — in hot areas prefer late-summer and autumn sowings. No South African kale yield has ever been published, so the kilogram estimate here comes from Kenyan and United States extension figures trimmed for a hand-watered bed — treat it as a planning slot, not a promise.
english: Cut-and-come-again leafy brassica: pick outer leaves and the plant keeps producing, and light frost sweetens the flavour. It does not handle extreme heat — in hot areas prefer late-summer and autumn sowings. No South African kale yield has ever been published, so the kilogram estimate here comes from Kenyan and United States extension figures trimmed for a hand-watered bed — treat it as a planning slot, not a promise.
afrikaans_draft: Sny-en-kom-weer-blaarkoolgewas: pluk die buitenste blare en die plant hou aan met produseer, en ligte ryp maak die smaak soeter. Dit hanteer nie uiterste hitte nie — in warm gebiede is laatsomer- en herfssaaie beter. Geen Suid-Afrikaanse opbrengs vir boerkool is nog ooit gepubliseer nie, so die kilogramskatting hier kom uit Keniaanse en Amerikaanse voorligtingsyfers, verminder vir 'n bedding wat met die hand natgemaak word — beskou dit as 'n plek in die beplanning, nie 'n belofte nie.

key: Direct-sow only — carrots don't transplant well. Keep the bed loose and stone-free.
english: Direct-sow only — carrots don't transplant well. Keep the bed loose and stone-free.
afrikaans_draft: Saai slegs direk — wortels plant nie goed oor nie. Hou die bedding los en klipvry.

key: Grown from rooted slips, not seed — plant into ridged soil for easy digging later.
english: Grown from rooted slips, not seed — plant into ridged soil for easy digging later.
afrikaans_draft: Word uit gewortelde steggies gekweek, nie uit saad nie — plant in grond met ruggies sodat dit later maklik uitgegrawe kan word.

key: Propagate from whole tubers or corm cuttings. Needs consistently moist soil and warm, frost-free conditions.
english: Propagate from whole tubers or corm cuttings. Needs consistently moist soil and warm, frost-free conditions.
afrikaans_draft: Vermeerder uit hele knolle of stukke van knolle. Het deurgaans klam grond en warm, rypvrye toestande nodig.

key: This stand is the audited irrigated geometry. Groundnuts need sandy, well-drained soil and a long frost-free growing season.
english: This stand is the audited irrigated geometry. Groundnuts need sandy, well-drained soil and a long frost-free growing season.
afrikaans_draft: Hierdie plantestand is die geouditeerde besproeide uitleg. Grondboontjies het sanderige, goed gedreineerde grond en 'n lang rypvrye groeiseisoen nodig.

key: The classic 'grows through winter' legume — sow in autumn, it stands through frost and pods in spring.
english: The classic 'grows through winter' legume — sow in autumn, it stands through frost and pods in spring.
afrikaans_draft: Die klassieke peulgewas wat 'deur die winter groei' — saai in die herfs, dit staan deur ryp en maak peule in die lente.

key: Real spinach (Spinacia oleracea) — not the Swiss chard South Africans usually call spinach. Cool-season and fast: it bolts in heat, so keep to the cool sowing windows and pick promptly. Same botanical family (Amaranthaceae) as Swiss chard and beetroot, so the rotation rule treats all three as one family — do not follow one with another in the same bed.
english: Real spinach (Spinacia oleracea) — not the Swiss chard South Africans usually call spinach. Cool-season and fast: it bolts in heat, so keep to the cool sowing windows and pick promptly. Same botanical family (Amaranthaceae) as Swiss chard and beetroot, so the rotation rule treats all three as one family — do not follow one with another in the same bed.
afrikaans_draft: Regte spinasie (Spinacia oleracea) — nie die snybeet wat Suid-Afrikaners gewoonlik spinasie noem nie. Koelseisoen en vinnig: dit skiet in hitte, so hou by die koel saaitye en pluk betyds. Dieselfde botaniese familie (Amaranthaceae) as snybeet en beet, so die wisselbouréël behandel al drie as een familie — moenie een ná 'n ander in dieselfde bedding plant nie.

key: Cool-weather Brassica root — direct-sow only and thin early so the roots can swell. Same botanical family as cabbage, kale and broccoli, so don't plan turnips straight after (or before) another brassica in the same bed. Young leaves are a traditional edible green — pick sparingly; the yield figure covers roots only.
english: Cool-weather Brassica root — direct-sow only and thin early so the roots can swell. Same botanical family as cabbage, kale and broccoli, so don't plan turnips straight after (or before) another brassica in the same bed. Young leaves are a traditional edible green — pick sparingly; the yield figure covers roots only.
afrikaans_draft: Koelweer-Brassica-wortelgewas — saai slegs direk en dun vroeg uit sodat die wortels kan swel. Dieselfde botaniese familie as kool, boerkool en broccoli, so moenie rape direk ná (of voor) 'n ander koolgewas in dieselfde bedding beplan nie. Jong blare is 'n tradisionele eetbare groente — pluk spaarsamig; die opbrengsyfer dek slegs die wortels.

key: DAFF: leaves picked about every two weeks once harvesting starts, continuing until frost ends the crop.
english: DAFF: leaves picked about every two weeks once harvesting starts, continuing until frost ends the crop.
afrikaans_draft: DAFF: blare word ongeveer elke twee weke gepluk sodra die oes begin, en dit gaan voort totdat ryp die gewas beëindig.

key: A cole crop like cabbage and broccoli — same rotation family, so avoid following one straight after another in the same bed. DAFF states cauliflower survives to about 0°C once established, so it is not flagged frost-tender here, but young transplants still want protection from a hard frost snap.
english: A cole crop like cabbage and broccoli — same rotation family, so avoid following one straight after another in the same bed. DAFF states cauliflower survives to about 0°C once established, so it is not flagged frost-tender here, but young transplants still want protection from a hard frost snap.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Koolgewas soos kool en broccoli — dieselfde wisselboufamilie, so vermy om een direk ná 'n ander in dieselfde bedding te plant. DAFF sê blomkool oorleef tot ongeveer 0°C sodra dit gevestig is, so dit word nie hier as rypgevoelig gemerk nie, maar jong oorplantings moet steeds teen 'n skielike harde ryp beskerm word.

key: A drought-tolerant grain crop, more heat- and dry-tolerant than maize. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting May harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here. No named SA cultivars were found.
english: A drought-tolerant grain crop, more heat- and dry-tolerant than maize. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting May harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here. No named SA cultivars were found.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Droogtebestande graangewas, meer hitte- en droogtebestand as mielies. 'n Desembersaai word uit hierdie katalogus se beplanner gelaat omdat die gevolglike Mei-oes in die ryp sou inloop — steeds werkbaar met plaaslike rypbeskerming, net nie hier outomaties geskeduleer nie. Geen benoemde SA-kultivars is gevind nie.

key: A nitrogen-fixing legume grain crop grown for dry beans, not green pods. DAFF never states a frost sensitivity for soybean, so it is not flagged frost-tender here — but it is a warm-season crop and these sow months are already timed for that.
english: A nitrogen-fixing legume grain crop grown for dry beans, not green pods. DAFF never states a frost sensitivity for soybean, so it is not flagged frost-tender here — but it is a warm-season crop and these sow months are already timed for that.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Stikstofbindende peulgewas wat vir droë bone gekweek word, nie vir groen peule nie. DAFF noem nooit 'n rypgevoeligheid vir sojabone nie, so dit word nie hier as rypgevoelig gemerk nie — maar dit is 'n warmseisoengewas en hierdie saaimaande is reeds daarvoor getyd.

key: Solanaceae family, same as tomatoes, peppers, chilli and potato — keep this rotation family together when planning beds. Frost-tender: raise as transplants and set out only once frost risk has passed.
english: Solanaceae family, same as tomatoes, peppers, chilli and potato — keep this rotation family together when planning beds. Frost-tender: raise as transplants and set out only once frost risk has passed.
afrikaans_draft: Solanaceae-familie, dieselfde as tamaties, soetrissies, brandrissies en aartappel — hou hierdie wisselboufamilie bymekaar wanneer jy beddings beplan. Rypgevoelig: kweek as oorplantings en plant eers uit sodra die rypgevaar verby is.

key: Cucurbitaceae family, same as pumpkin, butternut, cucumber and watermelon — avoid repeating this family in the same bed. Frost-tender vine crop; no Western Cape sowing calendar was found even though it is a known WC crop, so treat that as a local-confirmation item.
english: Cucurbitaceae family, same as pumpkin, butternut, cucumber and watermelon — avoid repeating this family in the same bed. Frost-tender vine crop; no Western Cape sowing calendar was found even though it is a known WC crop, so treat that as a local-confirmation item.
afrikaans_draft: Cucurbitaceae-familie, dieselfde as pampoen, botterskorsie, komkommer en waatlemoen — vermy om hierdie familie in dieselfde bedding te herhaal. Rypgevoelige rankgewas; geen Wes-Kaapse saaikalender is gevind nie, al is dit 'n bekende WK-gewas, so beskou dit as iets om plaaslik te bevestig.

key: A fast-cropping Cucurbitaceae vine picked young and often — same rotation family as pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber and watermelon. Frost-tender; no Western Cape calendar sourced.
english: A fast-cropping Cucurbitaceae vine picked young and often — same rotation family as pumpkin, gem-squash, cucumber and watermelon. Frost-tender; no Western Cape calendar sourced.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Vinnigdraende Cucurbitaceae-rank wat jonk en dikwels gepluk word — dieselfde wisselboufamilie as pampoen, gem-squash, komkommer en waatlemoen. Rypgevoelig; geen Wes-Kaapse kalender is uit bronne verkry nie.

key: Cucurbitaceae melon vine. A January sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here.
english: Cucurbitaceae melon vine. A January sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost — still workable with local frost protection, just not auto-scheduled here.
afrikaans_draft: Cucurbitaceae-spanspekrank. 'n Januariesaai word uit hierdie katalogus se beplanner gelaat omdat die gevolglike oes in die ryp sou inloop — steeds werkbaar met plaaslike rypbeskerming, net nie hier outomaties geskeduleer nie.

key: Grown and eaten as a fresh vegetable, unlike field maize — the dossier's own food-group is fruiting vegetable, not staple grain, so it is kept there rather than lumped with maize despite the shared species. Tender to frost like maize.
english: Grown and eaten as a fresh vegetable, unlike field maize — the dossier's own food-group is fruiting vegetable, not staple grain, so it is kept there rather than lumped with maize despite the shared species. Tender to frost like maize.
afrikaans_draft: Word as 'n vars groente gekweek en geëet, anders as veldmielies — die dossier se eie voedselgroep is vrugtegroente, nie stapelgraan nie, so dit word daar gehou eerder as om saam met mielies gegroepeer te word, al is dit dieselfde spesie. Rypgevoelig soos mielies.

key: An indigenous nitrogen-fixing legume grown for its underground dry seed pods (a groundnut relative, not a true bean). The yield figure is dry seed, the low end of genotype averages across seven South African trial sites. A December sowing is left off this catalog's planner because the resulting harvest would run into frost.
english: An indigenous nitrogen-fixing legume grown for its underground dry seed pods (a groundnut relative, not a true bean). english:
Permaculture rests on three ethics. Earth Care means treating soil, water, plants and animals as living systems to protect, not resources to use up. People Care means your family's needs come first, then your community's. Fair Share means taking only what you need and returning the surplus — seeds, food, water, knowledge — back into the system.

These aren't abstract ideas. A farmer who sells every egg and vegetable but keeps nothing back for the family table is skipping People Care. A community that fences off a shared spring is breaking Fair Share.

Ethics matter because they help you decide when there's no rulebook — a neighbour asking to graze cattle after a drought, a flood damaging your swales. Build these three into how you think before you build anything on the ground.
afrikaans_draft:
Permakultuur berus op drie etiese beginsels. Aardesorg beteken dat jy grond, water, plante en diere behandel as lewende stelsels wat jy moet beskerm, nie as hulpbronne om op te gebruik nie. Mensesorg beteken dat jou gesin se behoeftes eerste kom, dan dié van jou gemeenskap. Billike Deel beteken dat jy net neem wat jy nodig het en die oorskot — saad, kos, water, kennis — aan die stelsel teruggee.

Dit is nie abstrakte idees nie. 'n Boer wat elke eier en elke groente verkoop, maar niks vir die gesin se tafel terughou nie, slaan Mensesorg oor. 'n Gemeenskap wat 'n gedeelde fontein afkamp, verbreek Billike Deel.

Etiek is belangrik omdat dit jou help besluit wanneer daar geen reëlboek is nie — 'n buurman wat ná 'n droogte vra om beeste te laat wei, 'n vloed wat jou kontoerslote beskadig. Bou hierdie drie in die manier waarop jy dink, voordat jy enigiets op die grond bou.

english:
David Holmgren set out twelve design principles in Essence of Permaculture. Bill Mollison and David Holmgren co-originated the permaculture concept. Three useful starting points for this lesson are: observe and interact — watch your land through a full season before major earthworks; catch and store energy — notice rain, sun and biomass before they leave your property; and use edges and value the marginal — a fence line or strip beside a path can be a useful place to observe.

Others worth knowing: produce no waste (scraps become compost, compost becomes soil), use small and slow solutions (a bucket can irrigate a bed without electricity), and use and value diversity. Hail injury to maize depends on the storm and the crop’s growth stage.

Pick two or three principles that speak to your biggest problem and apply them hard. The rest become obvious as you go.
afrikaans_draft:
David Holmgren het twaalf ontwerpbeginsels in Essence of Permaculture uiteengesit. Bill Mollison en David Holmgren het saam die permakultuurkonsep ontwikkel. Drie nuttige beginpunte vir hierdie les is: neem waar en tree in wisselwerking — hou jou grond 'n volle seisoen lank dop voor groot grondwerke; vang en stoor energie — let op reën, son en biomassa voordat dit jou eiendom verlaat; en gebruik rande en waardeer die randgebiede — 'n heininglyn of 'n strook langs 'n paadjie kan 'n nuttige plek wees om waar te neem.

Ander wat die moeite werd is om te ken: produseer geen afval nie (kosreste word kompos, kompos word grond), gebruik klein en stadige oplossings ('n emmer kan 'n bedding sonder elektrisiteit natlei), en gebruik en waardeer diversiteit. Haelskade aan mielies hang af van die storm en die gewas se groeistadium.

Kies twee of drie beginsels wat jou grootste probleem aanspreek en pas hulle deeglik toe. Die res word vanself duidelik soos jy aangaan.

english:
Zones and sectors help you cut wasted labour. Zones run 0 to 5 by how often you visit. Zone 0 is the house. In this example, Zone 1 is near the house and holds what you pick often — herbs, salad greens. Zone 2 is the main garden and chicken run, visited once or twice a day. Zone 3 is the main field, visited weekly. Zone 4 is semi-wild — fruit trees and fodder needing occasional attention. Zone 5 is left wild.

Sectors are the energies arriving from outside — sun, wind, rain, flood, fire. Watch where strong wind comes from on your farm. Nearby weather-station records can help you check wind direction. Watch where rainwater enters and flows across your land. Draw arrows for what you observe.

Sketch zones and sectors on paper and you have the skeleton of your design.
afrikaans_draft:
Sones en sektore help jou om vermorste arbeid te verminder. Sones loop van 0 tot 5, volgens hoe gereeld jy daar kom. Sone 0 is die huis. In hierdie voorbeeld is Sone 1 naby die huis en bevat dit wat jy gereeld pluk — kruie, slaaigroente. Sone 2 is die hooftuin en hoenderloop, wat een of twee keer per dag besoek word. Sone 3 is die hoofland, wat weekliks besoek word. Sone 4 is halfwild — vrugtebome en voer wat af en toe aandag nodig het. Sone 5 word wild gelaat.

Sektore is die energieë wat van buite af aankom — son, wind, reën, vloed, vuur. Kyk waarvandaan sterk wind op jou plaas kom. Rekords van 'n nabygeleë weerstasie kan jou help om die windrigting na te gaan. Kyk waar reënwater jou grond binnekom en daaroor vloei. Teken pyle vir wat jy waarneem.

Skets sones en sektore op papier, en jy het die geraamte van jou ontwerp.

english: Sectors map incoming sun, wind, rainwater, flood and fire

english:
Before you harvest water, learn where it already goes. Watch from a safe place during heavy rain. When it is safe afterward, walk your land. Look for rills, places where water fans out, where it ponds, and where it leaves your property. Some excess water needs a safe route away so it does not cause damage.

An A-frame level can help you mark points at the same height and trace a contour line. Its marks are an observation, not a design or approval for earthworks. Before digging a swale, dam, or other structure, have the site assessed. Soil, slope, drainage, storm flow, and a safe overflow route all matter. Ask a trained local adviser.

There is no one placement rule for every slope. Observe where water moves and gathers. Poorly laid contours can increase erosion, and soil that takes in water slowly can hold too much. Choose any water works for the site and plan a safe route for excess water.

english:
In much of South Africa, especially in winter, the sun is to the north. Its path changes with the season and your location. North-facing slopes often receive more sun and can be warmer and drier. South-facing slopes are often cooler and moister. Frost can collect in low hollows where cold air settles. Watch your own site before choosing where to plant tender crops or place buildings.

Winter sun is lower and farther north than summer sun. A wall or shade cloth can shade a bed longer in winter than in summer. Before placing anything permanent, stand in the spot at 8am, midday, and 4pm on a winter's day and watch where the shade falls.

Pawpaw and young citrus are sensitive to frost. Keep tender plants out of known low frost pockets. Observe local frost before planting.

english:
Wind can damage crops on a smallholding. The direction and strength of damaging wind change with region, season and your site's ridges and gaps. Walk the land on windy days. Record where the wind comes from and what it affects. Check local weather records before deciding where shelter is needed.

On a clear, still night, cold air can flow downhill and collect in low places. These places can be colder than nearby slopes. Frost patterns also depend on the site. Compare candidate places through the local frost season. Check local minimum-temperature records where available. If records are not available, keep observing across cold nights and ask a local agriculture adviser before choosing a permanent home for tender seedlings.

Frost is ice that forms on a cold surface. Mist alone does not show that ice has formed, and frost damage can happen without visible ice. Look for ice and plant damage, compare low ground with slopes, and check minimum temperatures where you can. Mark places where cold or damage lasts longest. Keep sensitive plants away from the cold pockets you observe.

For tomatoes troubled by late blight, airflow and morning sun can help leaves dry. Late blight can still spread during prolonged cool, damp weather. Moving a bed alone will not control it; seek local crop-health guidance too.
