afrikaans_draft: Stel 'n bewyspakket saam en vind die gepaste huidige amptelike riglyne. Onderskei 'n leesbare app-faktuur van 'n geverifieerde belastingfaktuur wat aan die vereistes voldoen. Sê wat onbevestig bly sonder om 'n belastingkoers, sperdatum of registrasie-uitkoms te raai.

key: Compare two options using demand evidence, the same period, available resources and dated cash needs; explain a missing assumption before choosing a next action.
english: Compare two options using demand evidence, the same period, available resources and dated cash needs; explain a missing assumption before choosing a next action.
afrikaans_draft: Vergelyk twee opsies met behulp van bewyse van vraag, dieselfde tydperk, beskikbare hulpbronne en gedateerde kontantbehoeftes; verduidelik 'n ontbrekende aanname voordat jy 'n volgende aksie kies.

key: Present a connected plan whose claims lead back to evidence, show timing and constraints, and distinguish an unapproved funding request from available cash.
english: Present a connected plan whose claims lead back to evidence, show timing and constraints, and distinguish an unapproved funding request from available cash.
afrikaans_draft: Bied 'n samehangende plan aan waarvan die bewerings terugvoer na bewyse, wys tydsberekening en beperkings, en onderskei 'n onbewilligde befondsingsversoek van beskikbare kontant.

key: Reconcile an original forecast with actual records, separate quantity, price, collection and cost differences, preserve a missing value, and set a justified next action.
english: Reconcile an original forecast with actual records, separate quantity, price, collection and cost differences, preserve a missing value, and set a justified next action.
afrikaans_draft: Versoen 'n oorspronklike vooruitskatting met werklike rekords, skei verskille in hoeveelheid, prys, invordering en koste, behou 'n ontbrekende waarde, en stel 'n geregverdigde volgende aksie.

key: A buyer can take produce today and pay later. Record the sale and what the buyer owes. When the payment arrives, match it to that sale. The payment clears the amount owed; it is not a second basket sold. Cash answers how much money is available. Profit needs the income and costs for the period. Some costs or stock information may still be missing. Say what you know and what you still need.
english: A buyer can take produce today and pay later. Record the sale and what the buyer owes. When the payment arrives, match it to that sale. The payment clears the amount owed; it is not a second basket sold. Cash answers how much money is available. Profit needs the income and costs for the period. Some costs or stock information may still be missing. Say what you know and what you still need.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Koper kan vandag produkte neem en later betaal. Teken die verkoping aan en wat die koper skuld. Wanneer die betaling aankom, koppel dit aan daardie verkoping. Die betaling vereffen die bedrag wat geskuld word; dit is nie 'n tweede mandjie wat verkoop is nie. Kontant beantwoord hoeveel geld beskikbaar is. Wins het die inkomste en koste vir die tydperk nodig. Sommige koste of voorraadinligting kan nog ontbreek. Sê wat jy weet en wat jy nog nodig het.

key: Start with what was already here. Add what you picked. Record what left and why. A sale, food for home and a gift are different uses. Keep the same unit. At the end, count or weigh what is still here. Compare that with the book. If they differ, look for the cause. A difference is a question to investigate, not proof that someone stole food.
english: Start with what was already here. Add what you picked. Record what left and why. A sale, food for home and a gift are different uses. Keep the same unit. At the end, count or weigh what is still here. Compare that with the book. If they differ, look for the cause. A difference is a question to investigate, not proof that someone stole food.
afrikaans_draft: Begin met wat reeds hier was. Tel by wat jy gepluk het. Teken aan wat weg is en hoekom. 'n Verkoping, kos vir die huis en 'n geskenk is verskillende gebruike. Hou dieselfde eenheid. Tel of weeg aan die einde wat nog hier is. Vergelyk dit met die boek. As hulle verskil, soek die oorsaak. 'n Verskil is 'n vraag om te ondersoek, nie bewys dat iemand kos gesteel het nie.

key:
Write the sale when the agreed produce is delivered in this exercise. Keep the payment beside that sale, with the date it arrived. If only some money arrives, show what is still owed. Moving your own money from the cash tin to the wallet does not create another sale. It changes where the money is kept. A fee is a separate payment if the evidence shows one. Keep the amount and cents from the source.”

This exercise's agreed delivery is the point used to record its sale. It is not a rule covering every contract, deposit, return or accounting policy. Those need their own terms and bookkeeping review.
english:
Write the sale when the agreed produce is delivered in this exercise. Keep the payment beside that sale, with the date it arrived. If only some money arrives, show what is still owed. Moving your own money from the cash tin to the wallet does not create another sale. It changes where the money is kept. A fee is a separate payment if the evidence shows one. Keep the amount and cents from the source.”

This exercise's agreed delivery is the point used to record its sale. It is not a rule covering every contract, deposit, return or accounting policy. Those need their own terms and bookkeeping review.
afrikaans_draft:
Skryf die verkoping neer wanneer die ooreengekome produkte in hierdie oefening afgelewer word. Hou die betaling langs daardie verkoping, met die datum waarop dit aangekom het. As net 'n deel van die geld aankom, wys wat nog geskuld word. Om jou eie geld van die kontantblik na die beursie te skuif, skep nie nog 'n verkoping nie. Dit verander waar die geld gehou word. 'n Fooi is 'n aparte betaling as die bewyse een toon. Hou die bedrag en sente van die bron.”

Hierdie oefening se ooreengekome aflewering is die punt wat gebruik word om sy verkoping aan te teken. Dit is nie 'n reël wat elke kontrak, deposito, terugsending of rekeningkundige beleid dek nie. Daardie het hul eie bepalings en boekhoudkundige hersiening nodig.

key: A cost per unit needs two things: the costs you included and the quantity you divided by. Say both. Produce available for sale is not always produce sold. A selling price may cover some costs and still leave others unpaid. Contribution is what remains after the included variable costs. It must still cover fixed costs. A break-even answer is useful only when its assumptions fit and the required sales can be achieved.
english: A cost per unit needs two things: the costs you included and the quantity you divided by. Say both. Produce available for sale is not always produce sold. A selling price may cover some costs and still leave others unpaid. Contribution is what remains after the included variable costs. It must still cover fixed costs. A break-even answer is useful only when its assumptions fit and the required sales can be achieved.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Koste per eenheid het twee dinge nodig: die koste wat jy ingesluit het en die hoeveelheid waardeur jy gedeel het. Sê albei. Produkte beskikbaar vir verkoop is nie altyd produkte wat verkoop is nie. 'n Verkoopprys kan sommige koste dek en steeds ander onbetaal laat. Bydrae is wat oorbly ná die ingeslote veranderlike koste. Dit moet steeds vaste koste dek. 'n Gelykbreek-antwoord is slegs nuttig wanneer sy aannames pas en die vereiste verkope bereik kan word.

key: Compare the whole offer. Check the weight, quality, price, packaging, delivery and payment date. Use the same unit for both buyers. A higher price can leave less after delivery. Money promised for next week is not money available today. Write down what is agreed, and check what is still unknown before choosing.
english: Compare the whole offer. Check the weight, quality, price, packaging, delivery and payment date. Use the same unit for both buyers. A higher price can leave less after delivery. Money promised for next week is not money available today. Write down what is agreed, and check what is still unknown before choosing.
afrikaans_draft: Vergelyk die hele aanbod. Kontroleer die gewig, gehalte, prys, verpakking, aflewering en betaaldatum. Gebruik dieselfde eenheid vir albei kopers. 'n Hoër prys kan ná aflewering minder oorlaat. Geld wat vir volgende week belowe is, is nie geld wat vandag beskikbaar is nie. Skryf neer wat ooreengekom is, en kontroleer wat nog onbekend is voordat jy kies.

key: Start with money that is available at the beginning. Add a receipt when you expect the money to arrive. Subtract a payment when it must leave. Carry the balance to the next date. An invoice is not cash received. Check the dates between month ends too. A good total at the end cannot pay a bill that comes before the money arrives.
english: Start with money that is available at the beginning. Add a receipt when you expect the money to arrive. Subtract a payment when it must leave. Carry the balance to the next date. An invoice is not cash received. Check the dates between month ends too. A good total at the end cannot pay a bill that comes before the money arrives.
afrikaans_draft: Begin met geld wat aan die begin beskikbaar is. Tel 'n ontvangs by wanneer jy verwag dat die geld sal aankom. Trek 'n betaling af wanneer dit moet uitgaan. Dra die saldo oor na die volgende datum. 'n Faktuur is nie kontant ontvang nie. Kontroleer ook die datums tussen maandeindes. 'n Goeie totaal aan die einde kan nie 'n rekening betaal wat kom voordat die geld aankom nie.

key: Ask what changes if the buyer pays late, less produce sells, or an input costs more. Change the matching card and recalculate from that point onward. A delay changes when cash arrives. A lower sale changes how much arrives. Test them together too. Write down the evidence needed for your response, and check the plan again before committing.
english: Ask what changes if the buyer pays late, less produce sells, or an input costs more. Change the matching card and recalculate from that point onward. A delay changes when cash arrives. A lower sale changes how much arrives. Test them together too. Write down the evidence needed for your response, and check the plan again before committing.
afrikaans_draft: Vra wat verander as die koper laat betaal, minder produkte verkoop word, of 'n inset meer kos. Verander die ooreenstemmende kaart en herbereken van daardie punt af. 'n Vertraging verander wanneer kontant aankom. 'n Laer verkoping verander hoeveel aankom. Toets hulle ook saam. Skryf die bewyse neer wat vir jou reaksie nodig is, en kontroleer die plan weer voordat jy jou verbind.

key: Keep the story of one sale together. First, agree what the buyer wants and how payment will work. Check what you deliver. Check the invoice against that delivery and the agreed price. When money arrives, match it to the same invoice. The payment does not create another basket of produce. Keep its date and reference so you can show what is still owed.
english: Keep the story of one sale together. First, agree what the buyer wants and how payment will work. Check what you deliver. Check the invoice against that delivery and the agreed price. When money arrives, match it to the same invoice. The payment does not create another basket of produce. Keep its date and reference so you can show what is still owed.
afrikaans_draft: Hou die storie van een verkoping bymekaar. Kom eers ooreen wat die koper wil hê en hoe betaling sal werk. Kontroleer wat jy aflewer. Kontroleer die faktuur teen daardie aflewering en die ooreengekome prys. Wanneer geld aankom, koppel dit aan dieselfde faktuur. Die betaling skep nie nog 'n mandjie produkte nie. Hou sy datum en verwysing sodat jy kan wys wat nog geskuld word.

key: Start with the work you need done and the dates. Ask what each offer includes. Buying, hiring and sharing move money at different times. A deposit may come back later, but you still need it before use. Keep the value of a tool you still own separate from cash in your hand. Check who can use a shared tool, when it is available and who pays for damage or repairs.
english: Start with the work you need done and the dates. Ask what each offer includes. Buying, hiring and sharing move money at different times. A deposit may come back later, but you still need it before use. Keep the value of a tool you still own separate from cash in your hand. Check who can use a shared tool, when it is available and who pays for damage or repairs.
afrikaans_draft: Begin met die werk wat jy gedoen wil hê en die datums. Vra wat elke aanbod insluit. Koop, huur en deel skuif geld op verskillende tye. 'n Deposito kan later terugkom, maar jy het dit steeds voor gebruik nodig. Hou die waarde van gereedskap wat jy nog besit apart van kontant in jou hand. Kontroleer wie gedeelde gereedskap kan gebruik, wanneer dit beskikbaar is en wie vir skade of herstelwerk betaal.

key: Setting money aside gives it a job. It does not create more money. If you move it between two accounts you own, the total is unchanged unless there is a fee. When you pay someone else for a repair, money leaves. Keep the amount still set aside separate from money for daily work. A reserve target is a plan, not an account balance.
english: Setting money aside gives it a job. It does not create more money. If you move it between two accounts you own, the total is unchanged unless there is a fee. When you pay someone else for a repair, money leaves. Keep the amount still set aside separate from money for daily work. A reserve target is a plan, not an account balance.
afrikaans_draft: Om geld opsy te sit, gee dit 'n taak. Dit skep nie meer geld nie. As jy dit tussen twee rekeninge skuif wat jy besit, is die totaal onveranderd tensy daar 'n fooi is. Wanneer jy iemand anders vir 'n herstelwerk betaal, gaan geld uit. Hou die bedrag wat nog opsy gesit is apart van geld vir daaglikse werk. 'n Reserweteiken is 'n plan, nie 'n rekeningsaldo nie.

key: Start by saying which business and which dates you mean. Our stall starts with money, stock, equipment and amounts owed. A cash summary follows money received and paid. A profit-and-loss view follows the period's income and costs. A balance sheet shows the position on a date: assets, liabilities and what remains for the owner. The views are connected, but their totals need not match. Borrowed money increases cash and debt. It does not become a sale. A customer can owe us for goods already delivered. That sale can be recorded before the money reaches us.
english: Start by saying which business and which dates you mean. Our stall starts with money, stock, equipment and amounts owed. A cash summary follows money received and paid. A profit-and-loss view follows the period's income and costs. A balance sheet shows the position on a date: assets, liabilities and what remains for the owner. The views are connected, but their totals need not match. Borrowed money increases cash and debt. It does not become a sale. A customer can owe us for goods already delivered. That sale can be recorded before the money reaches us.
afrikaans_draft: Begin deur te sê watter besigheid en watter datums jy bedoel. Ons stalletjie begin met geld, voorraad, toerusting en bedrae wat geskuld word. 'n Kontantopsomming volg geld wat ontvang en betaal is. 'n Wins-en-verliesaansig volg die tydperk se inkomste en koste. 'n Balansstaat wys die posisie op 'n datum: bates, laste en wat vir die eienaar oorbly. Die aansigte is verbind, maar hul totale hoef nie ooreen te stem nie. Geleende geld verhoog kontant en skuld. Dit word nie 'n verkoping nie. 'n Kliënt kan ons skuld vir goedere wat reeds afgelewer is. Daardie verkoping kan aangeteken word voordat die geld ons bereik.

key: Start with a buyer and a task you can deliver. What does the buyer need? How much, in which unit, at what quality, and by when? Interest is not an order. A high sales total does not tell you what you will keep or whether you can pay the earlier bills. Put the alternatives beside each other. Keep the missing evidence visible.
english: Start with a buyer and a task you can deliver. What does the buyer need? How much, in which unit, at what quality, and by when? Interest is not an order. A high sales total does not tell you what you will keep or whether you can pay the earlier bills. Put the alternatives beside each other. Keep the missing evidence visible.
afrikaans_draft: Begin met 'n koper en 'n taak wat jy kan lewer. Wat het die koper nodig? Hoeveel, in watter eenheid, van watter gehalte, en teen wanneer? Belangstelling is nie 'n bestelling nie. 'n Hoë verkopetotaal sê nie vir jou wat jy sal hou of of jy die vroeëre rekeninge kan betaal nie. Sit die alternatiewe langs mekaar. Hou die ontbrekende bewyse sigbaar.

key: A useful plan lets another person follow your reasoning. Say what you intend to sell, why a buyer may want it, and what you need to deliver it. Show the work and payments in order. Keep estimates separate from records. If a number or permission is missing, name it and say how you will check it. A neat document cannot turn an application into money.
english: A useful plan lets another person follow your reasoning. Say what you intend to sell, why a buyer may want it, and what you need to deliver it. Show the work and payments in order. Keep estimates separate from records. If a number or permission is missing, name it and say how you will check it. A neat document cannot turn an application into money.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Nuttige plan laat 'n ander persoon jou redenasie volg. Sê wat jy van plan is om te verkoop, waarom 'n koper dit dalk wil hê, en wat jy nodig het om dit te lewer. Wys die werk en betalings in volgorde. Hou skattings apart van rekords. As 'n getal of toestemming ontbreek, noem dit en sê hoe jy dit sal nagaan. 'n Netjiese dokument kan nie 'n aansoek in geld verander nie.

key: Keep the plan you started with. Put the actual records beside it for the same period and units. What sold? What money arrived? What was paid? Which amounts are still owed? Explain each difference with evidence before saying why it happened. Then make the next plan. Changing the old plan to match the result hides what you learned.
english: Keep the plan you started with. Put the actual records beside it for the same period and units. What sold? What money arrived? What was paid? Which amounts are still owed? Explain each difference with evidence before saying why it happened. Then make the next plan. Changing the old plan to match the result hides what you learned.
afrikaans_draft: Hou die plan waarmee jy begin het. Sit die werklike rekords daarlangs vir dieselfde tydperk en eenhede. Wat is verkoop? Watter geld het aangekom? Wat is betaal? Watter bedrae word nog geskuld? Verduidelik elke verskil met bewyse voordat jy sê waarom dit gebeur het. Maak dan die volgende plan. Om die ou plan te verander sodat dit by die resultaat pas, versteek wat jy geleer het.

english:
Ask what the customer needs: product, quantity, quality, delivery and payment date.

Compare market fees, transport, packing and unsold produce as well as the selling price.

Check the market rules and local trading and food requirements. An informal stall does not automatically have no rules or costs.

Direct selling can retain more of the sale price, but it also takes time, packing, transport and customer care.

A box scheme supplies a regular selection to agreed customers.

Agree the contents, price, payment and what happens when crops are short. Regular orders help planning only when customers and growers can keep the agreement.

Start from what you can reliably supply and what customers want.

Check the costs and household food needs before promising regular boxes.

Garden area or customer count alone does not predict income. Try a manageable arrangement and record the results.

If production changes from week to week, avoid promising a fixed delivery you cannot supply.

Offer the surplus you have and agree clear terms with customers.

Describe your growing practices honestly. Check any certification or claim the buyer requires before using a label.

'n Boksskema voorsien 'n gereelde keuse van produkte aan ooreengekome klante.

Kom ooreen oor die inhoud, prys en betaling en oor wat gebeur wanneer daar 'n tekort aan gewasse is. Gereelde bestellings help net met beplanning wanneer klante en kwekers die ooreenkoms kan nakom.

Begin by wat jy betroubaar kan voorsien en wat klante wil hê.

Kontroleer die koste en die huishouding se voedselbehoeftes voordat jy gereelde bokse belowe.

As produksie van week tot week verander, vermy om 'n vaste aflewering te belowe wat jy nie kan voorsien nie.

Bied die oorskot aan wat jy het en kom duidelike voorwaardes met klante ooreen.

Begin 'n ontwerpaanbieding met die opdrag. Wys die bestaande situasie en die bewyse wat die meeste saak gemaak het. Verduidelik dan die gekose rangskikking, 'n alternatief wat jy oorweeg het, die belangrike afweging en die eerste uitvoerbare fase. Nooi spesifieke terugvoer uit. 'n Beoordelaar kan 'n ondersteunde sterkpunt, 'n ontbrekende aanname en 'n vraag wat die plan kan verander, noem. Luister voordat jy die tekening verdedig. english:
Open-pollinated seed from a stable variety can produce similar plants when pollination is properly managed. F1 hybrids come from selected parents. Their saved seed can germinate, but the next generation varies; it may not keep the combination you wanted.

Seed sovereignty includes the knowledge and choices needed to grow, save and share suitable seed. Keep the crop and variety identity with each batch.

Choose healthy plants with useful traits. Start with a crop you know and ask a seed-saving mentor how to manage its pollination and selection.

Saadsoewereiniteit sluit die kennis en keuses in wat nodig is om geskikte saad te kweek, te bewaar en te deel. Hou die gewas en variëteit se identiteit by elke saadlot.

Kies gesonde plante met nuttige eienskappe. Begin met 'n gewas wat jy ken en vra 'n mentor wat saad bewaar hoe om die bestuiwing en seleksie daarvan te bestuur.

english: Storms are rare and unpredictable, so catch water everywhere you can. Build small curved banks just above each plant. Catch runoff from farm roads into shallow basins. Underground water tanks help you get through dry spells — try to capture every drop of rain that falls.
afrikaans_draft: Storms is skaars en onvoorspelbaar, vang dus water op oral waar jy kan. Bou klein geboë walle net bokant elke plant. Vang afloop van plaaspaaie in vlak bekkens op. Ondergrondse watertenks help jou om droë tydperke te oorleef — probeer om elke druppel reën wat val op te vang.

english: Rain falls in both winter and summer. Use shallow channels and banks along the contour. A food forest based on Spekboom copes well with drought and uses water efficiently. Small tanks with gravity-fed drip irrigation work well. On clay soil, take care not to waterlog plants.
afrikaans_draft: Reën val in die winter sowel as die somer. Gebruik vlak kanale en walle langs die kontoer. 'n Voedselwoud gebaseer op Spekboom hanteer droogte goed en gebruik water doeltreffend. Klein tenks met swaartekrag-gevoerde drupbesproeiing werk goed. Pas op dat plante op kleigrond nie waterversadig raak nie.

english: The forest makes its own water cycle through fog and the trees breathing out moisture. Keeping the tree canopy intact keeps the ground moist. Channels at the forest edge catch any runoff. Springs inside the forest give a reliable water supply all year.
afrikaans_draft: Die woud maak sy eie watersiklus deur mis en die vog wat die bome uitasem. Om die boomkap ongeskonde te hou, hou die grond klam. Kanale by die woudrand vang enige afloop op. Fonteine binne die woud gee die hele jaar 'n betroubare watervoorraad.

english: The soil holds a lot of iron but little of the nutrients plants need most (phosphorus and nitrogen). Cover the soil with mopane leaves, but only a thin layer — too much can stop other plants growing nearby. Plant acacia trees nearby; their roots add nitrogen to the soil. Moringa trees also pull nutrients up from deep soil. Add compost and biochar (charcoal mixed into soil) until the soil holds at least 2% carbon.
afrikaans_draft: Die grond bevat baie yster maar min van die voedingstowwe wat plante die meeste nodig het (fosfor en stikstof). Bedek die grond met mopanieblare, maar net 'n dun laag — te veel kan ander plante in die omgewing keer om te groei. Plant akasiabome naby; hul wortels voeg stikstof by die grond. Moringa-bome trek ook voedingstowwe uit diep grond op. Voeg kompos en biochar (houtskool wat in die grond gemeng is) by totdat die grond ten minste 2% koolstof bevat.

english: Cover the soil with stones rather than organic mulch — it is cheaper and works well here. Only add compost to the food-growing area. Succulent plants need soil that drains well, not soil that holds water. For food beds, add biochar and gypsum. Worm farms are a good way to make a strong liquid fertiliser.
afrikaans_draft: Bedek die grond met klippe eerder as organiese deklaag — dit is goedkoper en werk goed hier. Voeg slegs kompos by die voedselverbouingsarea. Vetplante het grond nodig wat goed dreineer, nie grond wat water hou nie. Voeg biochar en gips by voedselbeddings. Wurmplase is 'n goeie manier om 'n sterk vloeibare kunsmis te maak.

english: Any organic matter here is valuable — use manure from goats or camels. Plant shade trees first, before any food crops. In low-lying areas, only plant salt-tolerant species. Raised sandy beds with a wick (a strip of absorbent material drawing water up) work well for vegetables.
afrikaans_draft: Enige organiese materiaal hier is waardevol — gebruik mis van bokke of kamele. Plant eers skaduwee-bome, voor enige voedselgewasse. Plant in laagliggende areas slegs soutverdraagsame spesies. Verhoogde sanderige beddings met 'n lont ('n strook absorberende materiaal wat water optrek) werk goed vir groente.

english: Spekboom is the key plant here: you can eat it, it stores a lot of carbon, and it copes well with drought. To restore damaged land, plant cuttings of Spekboom directly — no need to grow them in a nursery first. Clay soil needs good air flow, so use raised beds for vegetables.
afrikaans_draft: Spekboom is hier die sleutelplant: jy kan dit eet, dit stoor baie koolstof, en dit hanteer droogte goed. Om beskadigde grond te herstel, plant Spekboom-steggies direk — dit is nie nodig om hulle eers in 'n kwekery te kweek nie. Kleigrond het goeie lugvloei nodig, gebruik dus verhoogde beddings vir groente.

english: The soil is acidic and nutrients wash out quickly. Add lime to raise the pH to about 6.5. Cover the soil with mulch and plant cover crops to stop nutrients washing away. A mix of biochar and compost (terra preta) greatly improves how much food you can grow. Coffee, avocado, banana and sugar cane all grow well here.
afrikaans_draft: Die grond is suur en voedingstowwe spoel vinnig uit. Voeg kalk by om die pH tot ongeveer 6.5 te verhoog. Bedek die grond met deklaag en plant dekgewasse om te keer dat voedingstowwe wegspoel. 'n Mengsel van biochar en kompos (terra preta) verbeter grootliks hoeveel voedsel jy kan kweek. Koffie, avokado, piesang en suikerriet groei almal goed hier.

english: Forest soil is rich — disturb it as little as possible. Use small, deep planting holes (keyhole beds) for vegetables rather than large cleared areas. Cover the soil with fallen leaves as mulch. Working with the forest's own structure (a food-forest approach) gives the best results. Leave most of the forest undisturbed.
afrikaans_draft: Woudgrond is ryk — versteur dit so min as moontlik. Gebruik klein, diep plantgate (sleutelgatbeddings) vir groente eerder as groot skoongemaakte areas. Bedek die grond met afgevalle blare as deklaag. Om met die woud se eie struktuur te werk ('n voedselwoud-benadering) gee die beste resultate. Laat die grootste deel van die woud onversteurd.

english: Cows on pasture or in open camps need shade: shade structures should give at least 4 to 5 m² of shade per cow.
afrikaans_draft: Koeie op weiding of in oop kampe het skaduwee nodig: skadustrukture moet ten minste 4 tot 5 m² skaduwee per koei gee.

key: Dairy farmers are legally required to test their herds for bovine TB, mainly because of export requirements, so most dairy cattle in South Africa are tested.
english: Dairy farmers are legally required to test their herds for bovine TB, mainly because of export requirements, so most dairy cattle in South Africa are tested.
afrikaans_draft: Melkboere is wetlik verplig om hul kuddes vir bees-TB te toets, hoofsaaklik weens uitvoervereistes, daarom word die meeste melkbeeste in Suid-Afrika getoets.

key: Any suspected or confirmed brucellosis-related abortion in cattle must be reported to the State Veterinary office, under the national bovine brucellosis control scheme.
english: Any suspected or confirmed brucellosis-related abortion in cattle must be reported to the State Veterinary office, under the national bovine brucellosis control scheme.
afrikaans_draft: Enige vermoedelike of bevestigde brucellose-verwante misgeboorte by beeste moet by die Staatsveeartskantoor aangemeld word, ingevolge die nasionale beesbrucellose-beheerskema.

key: Floor-housed broilers: no more than 40 kg of bird per square metre.
english: Floor-housed broilers: no more than 40 kg of bird per square metre.
afrikaans_draft: Braaikuikens wat op die vloer gehuisves word: nie meer as 40 kg voël per vierkante meter nie.

key: Newly hatched chicks must be given feed within 24 hours of hatching.
english: Newly hatched chicks must be given feed within 24 hours of hatching.
afrikaans_draft: Pas uitgebroeide kuikens moet binne 24 uur ná uitbroei voer kry.

key: Newly hatched chicks must be given access to water within 24 hours of hatching, sooner in hot weather.
english: Newly hatched chicks must be given access to water within 24 hours of hatching, sooner in hot weather.
afrikaans_draft: Pas uitgebroeide kuikens moet binne 24 uur ná uitbroei toegang tot water kry, gouer in warm weer.

key: Fresh water and the right feed always available, so birds are free from hunger and thirst.
english: Fresh water and the right feed always available, so birds are free from hunger and thirst.
afrikaans_draft: Vars water en die regte voer altyd beskikbaar, sodat voëls vry is van honger en dors.

key: Broiler houses need a minimum ventilation/airflow rate of 5 cubic metres per hour for every kilogram of bird mass in the house.
english: Broiler houses need a minimum ventilation/airflow rate of 5 cubic metres per hour for every kilogram of bird mass in the house.
afrikaans_draft: Braaikuikenhokke het 'n minimum ventilasie-/lugvloeitempo van 5 kubieke meter per uur nodig vir elke kilogram voëlmassa in die hok.

key: The ARC Irene trial compared Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo and Naked Neck under commercial feed, water and controlled lighting. Mean eggs/hen in a 52-week cycle were 195.9, 153.7, 125.5 and 138.9 respectively; first-egg ages were 138.5, 139.0, 134.5 and 129.0 days from hatch, with no significant first-egg age difference among breeds. This is managed breed context, not the yield of scavenging hens in KZN. Match feeding and housing before using a benchmark.
english: The ARC Irene trial compared Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo and Naked Neck under commercial feed, water and controlled lighting. Mean eggs/hen in a 52-week cycle were 195.9, 153.7, 125.5 and 138.9 respectively; first-egg ages were 138.5, 139.0, 134.5 and 129.0 days from hatch, with no significant first-egg age difference among breeds. This is managed breed context, not the yield of scavenging hens in KZN. Match feeding and housing before using a benchmark.
afrikaans_draft: Die ARC Irene-proef het Potchefstroom Koekoek, Venda, Ovambo en Naked Neck onder kommersiële voer, water en beheerde beligting vergelyk. Gemiddelde eiers/hen in 'n 52-week-siklus was onderskeidelik 195.9, 153.7, 125.5 en 138.9; ouderdomme by eerste eier was 138.5, 139.0, 134.5 en 129.0 dae vanaf uitbroei, sonder 'n beduidende verskil in ouderdom by eerste eier tussen die rasse. Dit is konteks vir bestuurde rasse, nie die opbrengs van skarrelhenne in KZN nie. Laat voeding en behuising ooreenstem voordat jy 'n maatstaf gebruik.

key: In extensive village systems the chickens have to find their own water and food.
english: In extensive village systems the chickens have to find their own water and food.
afrikaans_draft: In ekstensiewe dorpstelsels moet die hoenders hul eie water en kos vind.

key: In the Limpopo and KwaZulu-Natal survey, 94.9% of farmers housed their chickens at night.
english: In the Limpopo and KwaZulu-Natal survey, 94.9% of farmers housed their chickens at night.
afrikaans_draft: In die opname in Limpopo en KwaZulu-Natal het 94.9% van boere hul hoenders snags gehuisves.

key: What free-ranging hens forage met their needs for maintenance and growth but not for laying: protein in every season, calcium and phosphorus in winter.
english: What free-ranging hens forage met their needs for maintenance and growth but not for laying: protein in every season, calcium and phosphorus in winter.
afrikaans_draft: Wat vrylopende henne self gevind het, het in hul behoeftes vir onderhoud en groei voorsien, maar nie vir lê nie: proteïen in elke seisoen, kalsium en fosfor in die winter.

key: SAPA 2024 commercial strain standards cumulative to 90 weeks: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 and Lohmann Brown Lite 413. These are full-cycle objectives, not eggs per calendar year or a smallholder forecast. Purchase age, actual onset of lay, surviving laying hens, feed, water and lighting need separate records.
english: SAPA 2024 commercial strain standards cumulative to 90 weeks: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eggs/hen housed, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 and Lohmann Brown Lite 413. These are full-cycle objectives, not eggs per calendar year or a smallholder forecast. Purchase age, actual onset of lay, surviving laying hens, feed, water and lighting need separate records.
afrikaans_draft: SAPA 2024 se kommersiële stamstandaarde, kumulatief tot 90 weke: Dekalb Amberlink 429 eiers/gehuisveste hen, Dekalb Brown 428, Hy-Line Silver Brown 435, Hy-Line Brown 434 en Lohmann Brown Lite 413. Dit is doelwitte vir die volle siklus, nie eiers per kalenderjaar of 'n kleinboervoorspelling nie. Aankoopouderdom, werklike begin van lê, oorlewende lêhenne, voer, water en beligting het afsonderlike rekords nodig.

key: In free-range systems, hens must have access to the outdoor range for at least 8 hours a day in daylight.
english: In free-range systems, hens must have access to the outdoor range for at least 8 hours a day in daylight.
afrikaans_draft: In vrylopende stelsels moet henne vir ten minste 8 uur per dag in daglig toegang tot die buiteloop hê.

key: Where individual nest boxes are used, at least one nest for every 8 hens.
english: Where individual nest boxes are used, at least one nest for every 8 hens.
afrikaans_draft: Waar individuele lêneste gebruik word, ten minste een nes vir elke 8 henne.

key: Hens need at least 8 hours of continuous darkness in every 24-hour cycle to rest properly.
english: Hens need at least 8 hours of continuous darkness in every 24-hour cycle to rest properly.
afrikaans_draft: Henne het ten minste 8 uur aaneenlopende donkerte in elke 24-uur-siklus nodig om behoorlik te rus.

key: Floor housing needs litter on at least a third (33%) of the floor.
english: Floor housing needs litter on at least a third (33%) of the floor.
afrikaans_draft: Vloerbehuising het strooisel op ten minste 'n derde (33%) van die vloer nodig.

key: It is an offence to deny a duck food or water, or keep it somewhere lacking adequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat and cold.
english: It is an offence to deny a duck food or water, or keep it somewhere lacking adequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat and cold.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is 'n oortreding om 'n eend kos of water te weier, of dit op 'n plek aan te hou waar voldoende ruimte, ventilasie, lig of skuiling teen hitte en koue ontbreek.

key: Watch flocks for sudden deaths, ruffled feathers, swollen wattles/combs or a sudden drop in egg production - these are signs of avian influenza and should be reported at once.
english: Watch flocks for sudden deaths, ruffled feathers, swollen wattles/combs or a sudden drop in egg production - these are signs of avian influenza and should be reported at once.
afrikaans_draft: Hou troppe dop vir skielike vrektes, opgepofte vere, geswelde lelle/kamme of 'n skielike daling in eierproduksie - dit is tekens van voëlgriep en moet dadelik aangemeld word.

key: Keep ducks away from wild birds and open water/feed that attracts them, and control visitors' access to duck housing, to reduce avian-influenza risk.
english: Keep ducks away from wild birds and open water/feed that attracts them, and control visitors' access to duck housing, to reduce avian-influenza risk.
afrikaans_draft: Hou eende weg van wilde voëls en oop water/voer wat hulle lok, en beheer besoekers se toegang tot eendhokke, om die risiko van voëlgriep te verminder.

key: At the abattoir, ducks must be handled humanely during loading, transport, offloading, housing, immobilising and killing, under the Animals Protection Act.
english: At the abattoir, ducks must be handled humanely during loading, transport, offloading, housing, immobilising and killing, under the Animals Protection Act.
afrikaans_draft: By die abattoir moet eende menslik hanteer word tydens laai, vervoer, aflaai, behuising, immobilisering en doodmaak, ingevolge die Wet op Diere-beskerming.

key: ARC makes tilapia suitability depend on water temperature: summer grow-out can be suitable anywhere in South Africa when water exceeds 20°C; growth is poor below 18°C and winter water below 13°C can kill farmed tilapia. The Highveld reference is a summer crop; tunnels can widen the range. Measure pond water and confirm stocking species and dates. Air climate or a mapped pond does not prove harvest months, fish numbers or food kg.
english: ARC makes tilapia suitability depend on water temperature: summer grow-out can be suitable anywhere in South Africa when water exceeds 20°C; growth is poor below 18°C and winter water below 13°C can kill farmed tilapia. The Highveld reference is a summer crop; tunnels can widen the range. Measure pond water and confirm stocking species and dates. Air climate or a mapped pond does not prove harvest months, fish numbers or food kg.
afrikaans_draft: Die ARC maak tilapia-geskiktheid afhanklik van watertemperatuur: somer-uitgroei kan oral in Suid-Afrika geskik wees wanneer water 20°C oorskry; groei is swak onder 18°C en winterwater onder 13°C kan geteelde tilapia doodmaak. Die Hoëveld-verwysing is 'n someroes; tonnels kan die reeks vergroot. Meet damwater en bevestig die spesie en datums vir uitsit. Lugklimaat of 'n gekarteerde dam bewys nie oesmaande, visgetalle of kos-kg nie.

key: The indigenous Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) is not a listed invasive species and may be farmed without an alien-species permit; the faster-growing Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) is.
english: The indigenous Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) is not a listed invasive species and may be farmed without an alien-species permit; the faster-growing Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) is.
afrikaans_draft: Die inheemse Mozambique Tilapia (O. mossambicus) is nie 'n gelyste indringerspesie nie en mag sonder 'n permit vir uitheemse spesies geteel word; die vinniger groeiende Nile Tilapia (O. niloticus) is wel 'n gelyste indringerspesie.

key: Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) is a nationally listed invasive fish species: Category 1b inside National Parks, Provincial Reserves, Mountain Catchment Areas and Forestry Reserves, and Category 3 in all other areas.
english: Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) is a nationally listed invasive fish species: Category 1b inside National Parks, Provincial Reserves, Mountain Catchment Areas and Forestry Reserves, and Category 3 in all other areas.
afrikaans_draft: Nile Tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) is 'n nasionaal gelyste indringervisspesie: Kategorie 1b binne Nasionale Parke, Provinsiale Reservate, Bergopvanggebiede en Bosbou-reservate, en Kategorie 3 in alle ander gebiede.

key: Outside protected areas Nile tilapia is Category 3: it may remain in prescribed areas or provinces, but further propagation or trade is prohibited.
english: Outside protected areas Nile tilapia is Category 3: it may remain in prescribed areas or provinces, but further propagation or trade is prohibited.
afrikaans_draft: Buite beskermde gebiede is Nile tilapia Kategorie 3: dit mag in voorgeskrewe gebiede of provinsies bly, maar verdere voortplanting of handel is verbode.

key: Nile Tilapia has been listed under the NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations as requiring a permit to produce.
english: Nile Tilapia has been listed under the NEMBA Alien and Invasive Species Regulations as requiring a permit to produce.
afrikaans_draft: Nile Tilapia is ingevolge die NEMBA-regulasies oor uitheemse en indringerspesies gelys as 'n spesie wat 'n permit vir produksie vereis.

key: Producing an alien or invasive species (such as Nile Tilapia) is prohibited in areas designated under the Protected Areas Act and the Fish Sanctuary Act; a permit is required to produce it elsewhere.
english: Producing an alien or invasive species (such as Nile Tilapia) is prohibited in areas designated under the Protected Areas Act and the Fish Sanctuary Act; a permit is required to produce it elsewhere.
afrikaans_draft: Die produksie van 'n uitheemse of indringerspesie (soos Nile Tilapia) is verbode in gebiede wat ingevolge die Wet op Beskermde Gebiede en die Wet op Visreservate aangewys is; 'n permit word vereis om dit elders te produseer.

key: Producing tilapia in South Africa requires a water use licence under the National Water Act.
english: Producing tilapia in South Africa requires a water use licence under the National Water Act.
afrikaans_draft: Die produksie van tilapia in Suid-Afrika vereis 'n watergebruiklisensie ingevolge die Nasionale Waterwet.

key: It is an offence to keep a goat somewhere with inadequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat, cold or weather, or to confine/tether it in a way that causes unnecessary suffering.
english: It is an offence to keep a goat somewhere with inadequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat, cold or weather, or to confine/tether it in a way that causes unnecessary suffering.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is 'n oortreding om 'n bok op 'n plek aan te hou met onvoldoende ruimte, ventilasie, lig of skuiling teen hitte, koue of weer, of om dit op 'n manier in te hok/vas te maak wat onnodige lyding veroorsaak.

key: It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to a goat.
english: It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to a goat.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is 'n oortreding om 'n bok uit te honger, onvoldoende te voer, of water of kos aan hom te weier.

key: Every goat owner must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
english: Every goat owner must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
afrikaans_draft: Elke bokeienaar moet 'n amptelike identifikasiemerk registreer en hul bokke daarmee merk, ingevolge die Wet op Diere-identifikasie.

key: In KZN Highland Sourveld smallholder systems, winter and early-spring feed shortage can restrict goats. Autumn-kidding does feed kids through winter; spring-kidding does face late-pregnancy feed shortage, especially with late rains. Plan local winter feed and monitor weights with extension support; this is regional care context, not kg or a universal kidding calendar.
english: In KZN Highland Sourveld smallholder systems, winter and early-spring feed shortage can restrict goats. Autumn-kidding does feed kids through winter; spring-kidding does face late-pregnancy feed shortage, especially with late rains. Plan local winter feed and monitor weights with extension support; this is regional care context, not kg or a universal kidding calendar.
afrikaans_draft: In KZN Highland Sourveld-kleinboerstelsels kan voertekorte in die winter en vroeë lente bokke beperk. Ooie wat in die herfs lam, voer lammers deur die winter; ooie wat in die lente lam, kry voertekorte laat in die dragtigheid, veral met laat reëns. Beplan plaaslike wintervoer en monitor gewigte met voorligtingsondersteuning; dit is streekskonteks vir versorging, nie kg of 'n universele lamkalender nie.

key: Winter feed shortage on communal sourveld is a known welfare/production risk: does that kid in autumn must feed kids through winter, and does that kid in spring suffer poor nutrition during late pregnancy, so winter feed supplementation matters.
english: Winter feed shortage on communal sourveld is a known welfare/production risk: does that kid in autumn must feed kids through winter, and does that kid in spring suffer poor nutrition during late pregnancy, so winter feed supplementation matters.
afrikaans_draft: Wintervoertekort op gemeenskaplike suurveld is 'n bekende welsyns-/produksierisiko: ooie wat in die herfs lam, moet lammers deur die winter voer, en ooie wat in die lente lam, ly aan swak voeding laat in die dragtigheid, daarom is aanvulling van wintervoer belangrik.

key: Inside a declared FMD-affected zone, goats and their products cannot be moved into, out of, or within the zone without a state veterinary movement permit and compliance with its conditions.
english: Inside a declared FMD-affected zone, goats and their products cannot be moved into, out of, or within the zone without a state veterinary movement permit and compliance with its conditions.
afrikaans_draft: Binne 'n verklaarde FMD-geaffekteerde sone kan bokke en hul produkte nie in, uit of binne die sone geskuif word sonder 'n staatsveeartsenykundige bewegingspermit en nakoming van sy voorwaardes nie.

key: Every goat owner, including communal/smallholder owners, must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
english: Every goat owner, including communal/smallholder owners, must register an official identification mark and mark their goats with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
afrikaans_draft: Elke bokeienaar, insluitend gemeenskaplike/kleinboer-eienaars, moet 'n amptelike identifikasiemerk registreer en hul bokke daarmee merk, ingevolge die Wet op Diere-identifikasie.

key: When pigs are trucked, the SA code of practice for handling and transporting animals recommends 0.3 m² per porker, 0.4 m² per baconer and 0.8 m² per adult pig.
english: When pigs are trucked, the SA code of practice for handling and transporting animals recommends 0.3 m² per porker, 0.4 m² per baconer and 0.8 m² per adult pig.
afrikaans_draft: Wanneer varke per vragmotor vervoer word, beveel die SA-praktykkode vir die hantering en vervoer van diere 0.3 m² per vleisvark, 0.4 m² per spekvark en 0.8 m² per volwasse vark aan.

key: It is an offence to keep a pig somewhere with inadequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat, cold or weather, or to confine/tether it in a way that causes unnecessary suffering.
english: It is an offence to keep a pig somewhere with inadequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat, cold or weather, or to confine/tether it in a way that causes unnecessary suffering.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is 'n oortreding om 'n vark op 'n plek aan te hou met onvoldoende ruimte, ventilasie, lig of skuiling teen hitte, koue of weer, of om dit op 'n manier in te hok/vas te maak wat onnodige lyding veroorsaak.

key: It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to a pig.
english: It is an offence to starve, under-feed, or deny water or food to a pig.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is 'n oortreding om 'n vark uit te honger, onvoldoende te voer, of water of kos aan hom te weier.

key: In heat waves, pig houses need better ventilation/airflow and lower stocking density, and outdoor pigs need shade and shelter.
english: In heat waves, pig houses need better ventilation/airflow and lower stocking density, and outdoor pigs need shade and shelter.
afrikaans_draft: In hittegolwe het varkhokke beter ventilasie/lugvloei en 'n laer beladingsdigtheid nodig, en buitevarke het skaduwee en skuiling nodig.

key: Swill (food waste) may not be fed to pigs unless it has been boiled for at least 60 minutes or sterilised by another equally effective method.
english: Swill (food waste) may not be fed to pigs unless it has been boiled for at least 60 minutes or sterilised by another equally effective method.
afrikaans_draft: Swill (voedselafval) mag nie aan varke gevoer word nie, tensy dit vir ten minste 60 minute gekook is of deur 'n ander ewe doeltreffende metode gesteriliseer is.

key: Pigs may only be moved into a biosecure compartment from another compartment that is officially certified/approved for that purpose.
english: Pigs may only be moved into a biosecure compartment from another compartment that is officially certified/approved for that purpose.
afrikaans_draft: Varke mag slegs in 'n biosekure kompartement ingeskuif word vanaf 'n ander kompartement wat amptelik vir daardie doel gesertifiseer/goedgekeur is.

key: A pig owner must apply to register an official identification mark and mark their pigs with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
english: A pig owner must apply to register an official identification mark and mark their pigs with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Varkeienaar moet aansoek doen om 'n amptelike identifikasiemerk te registreer en hul varke daarmee merk, ingevolge die Wet op Diere-identifikasie.

key: It is an offence to deny a rabbit food or water, or keep it somewhere lacking adequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat and cold.
english: It is an offence to deny a rabbit food or water, or keep it somewhere lacking adequate space, ventilation, light or shelter from heat and cold.
afrikaans_draft: Dit is 'n oortreding om 'n konyn kos of water te weier, of dit op 'n plek aan te hou waar voldoende ruimte, ventilasie, lig of skuiling teen hitte en koue ontbreek.

key: Give breeding rabbits roughly 0.48-0.70 m2 of hutch floor space each, 50-60 cm high, not a cramped cage.
english: Give breeding rabbits roughly 0.48-0.70 m2 of hutch floor space each, 50-60 cm high, not a cramped cage.
afrikaans_draft: Gee teelkonyne elk ongeveer 0.48-0.70 m2 hokvloerruimte, 50-60 cm hoog, nie 'n beknopte hok nie.

key: At the abattoir, rabbits (like other listed animals) must be handled humanely during loading, transport, offloading, housing, immobilising and killing, under the Animals Protection Act.
english: At the abattoir, rabbits (like other listed animals) must be handled humanely during loading, transport, offloading, housing, immobilising and killing, under the Animals Protection Act.
afrikaans_draft: By die abattoir moet konyne (soos ander gelyste diere) menslik hanteer word tydens laai, vervoer, aflaai, behuising, immobilisering en doodmaak, ingevolge die Wet op Diere-beskerming.

key: The wild European rabbit (the same species as farmed New Zealand White/Californian rabbits) is only listed as an invasive species under NEMBA on South Africa's off-shore islands - it is not a listed/restricted species on the mainland.
english: The wild European rabbit (the same species as farmed New Zealand White/Californian rabbits) is only listed as an invasive species under NEMBA on South Africa's off-shore islands - it is not a listed/restricted species on the mainland.
afrikaans_draft: Die wilde European rabbit (dieselfde spesie as geteelde New Zealand White/Californian-konyne) is slegs op Suid-Afrika se eilande buite die kus as 'n indringerspesie ingevolge NEMBA gelys - dit is nie 'n gelyste/beperkte spesie op die vasteland nie.

key: Sheep driven on the hoof may not be moved more than 20 km in a single day (25 km is regarded as excessive).
english: Sheep driven on the hoof may not be moved more than 20 km in a single day (25 km is regarded as excessive).
afrikaans_draft: Skape wat te voet gedryf word, mag nie meer as 20 km op 'n enkele dag geskuif word nie (25 km word as oormatig beskou).

key: Inside a declared FMD zone, sheep and their products cannot be moved into, out of, or within it without a state veterinary permit.
english: Inside a declared FMD zone, sheep and their products cannot be moved into, out of, or within it without a state veterinary permit.
afrikaans_draft: Binne 'n verklaarde FMD-sone kan skape en hul produkte nie in, uit of binne die sone geskuif word sonder 'n staatsveeartsenykundige permit nie.

key: Against sheep scab, all small stock on the farm must be treated with a remedy registered under Act 36 of 1947, and infected sheep treated twice, eight to ten days apart.
english: Against sheep scab, all small stock on the farm must be treated with a remedy registered under Act 36 of 1947, and infected sheep treated twice, eight to ten days apart.
afrikaans_draft: Teen skaapbrandsiekte moet alle kleinvee op die plaas behandel word met 'n middel wat ingevolge Wet 36 van 1947 geregistreer is, en besmette skape moet twee keer behandel word, agt tot tien dae uitmekaar.

key: Every sheep owner must register an official identification mark and mark their sheep with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
english: Every sheep owner must register an official identification mark and mark their sheep with it, under the Animal Identification Act.
afrikaans_draft: Elke skaapeienaar moet 'n amptelike identifikasiemerk registreer en hul skape daarmee merk, ingevolge die Wet op Diere-identifikasie.

key: Wool from scab-infected sheep must be destroyed rather than sent to the buyer, where it would be marked as scab wool.
english: Wool from scab-infected sheep must be destroyed rather than sent to the buyer, where it would be marked as scab wool.
afrikaans_draft: Wol van skape wat met brandsiekte besmet is, moet vernietig word eerder as om na die koper gestuur te word, waar dit as brandsiekte-wol gemerk sou word.

key: From a 2008 national postal survey of 112 SABIO-member beekeepers (22.4% response rate) managing an estimated 19,520 hives at 2,094 apiary sites; figure is self-reported and un-weighted. Table 7 (same doc, p.13-14) shows wide variance by region/operation-focus/size for the same year: e.g. 'All' region, honey-focused, all-size operations = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr across 3 survey sites; Western Cape honey-focused = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; Western Cape pollination-focused, small operations = only 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr. The same document also quotes an earlier, more rigorously validated study: 'Their average reported yield is very low, at just 13.4 kilograms per hive' for Western Cape hives (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, cited p.2 of this working paper), and historical national bee-census data of 8.3 kg/hive/annum (1911-1988 average) rising to 24 kg/hive in the 1974/5 census (same doc, p.1). No single number can be called definitive; 25 kg/hive/yr is used as the document's own headline national estimate.
english: From a 2008 national postal survey of 112 SABIO-member beekeepers (22.4% response rate) managing an estimated 19,520 hives at 2,094 apiary sites; figure is self-reported and un-weighted. Table 7 (same doc, p.13-14) shows wide variance by region/operation-focus/size for the same year: e.g. 'All' region, honey-focused, all-size operations = 25.1-26.9 kg/hive/yr across 3 survey sites; Western Cape honey-focused = 23.6-27.9 kg/hive/yr; Western Cape pollination-focused, small operations = only 7.0-7.5 kg/hive/yr. The same document also quotes an earlier, more rigorously validated study: 'Their average reported yield is very low, at just 13.4 kilograms per hive' for Western Cape hives (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, cited p.2 of this working paper), and historical national bee-census data of 8.3 kg/hive/annum (1911-1988 average) rising to 24 kg/hive in the 1974/5 census (same doc, p.1). No single number can be called definitive; 25 kg/hive/yr is used as the document's own headline national estimate.

Tabel 7 (dieselfde dokument, bl. 13-14) toon groot variasie volgens streek/bedryfsfokus/grootte vir dieselfde jaar: bv. 'All'-streek, heuninggefokus, bedrywe van alle groottes = 25.1-26.9 kg/korf/jr oor 3 opnameterreine; Wes-Kaap heuninggefokus = 23.6-27.9 kg/korf/jr; Wes-Kaap bestuiwingsgefokus, klein bedrywe = slegs 7.0-7.5 kg/korf/jr. Dieselfde dokument haal ook 'n vroeëre, strenger gevalideerde studie aan: 'Their average reported yield is very low, at just 13.4 kilograms per hive' vir Wes-Kaapse korwe (Allsopp & Cherry 2004, aangehaal op bl. 2 van hierdie werkstuk), en historiese nasionale byesensusdata van 8.3 kg/korf/jaar (gemiddeld 1911-1988) wat tot 24 kg/korf in die 1974/5-sensus gestyg het (dieselfde dokument, bl. 1). Geen enkele getal kan as definitief beskou word nie; 25 kg/korf/jr word gebruik as die dokument se eie nasionale hoofskatting.

key: CONVERTED, arithmetic shown: took the 'Average' yield band (15-18 t/ha) and the same source's stated spacing ('Generally planted 6m x 4m or 5 m x 3 m'). At 6x4m = 24 m²/tree → 10000/24 = 416.7 trees/ha → 15000kg/416.7=36.0 and 18000kg/416.7=43.2 kg/tree. At 5x3m = 15 m²/tree → 666.7 trees/ha → 15000/666.7=22.5 and 18000/666.7=27.0 kg/tree. Combined range across both spacings, rounded: [23, 43] kg/tree. This spread reflects the two different sourced spacings, not cultivar variation.
english: CONVERTED, arithmetic shown: took the 'Average' yield band (15-18 t/ha) and the same source's stated spacing ('Generally planted 6m x 4m or 5 m x 3 m'). At 6x4m = 24 m²/tree → 10000/24 = 416.7 trees/ha → 15000kg/416.7=36.0 and 18000kg/416.7=43.2 kg/tree. At 5x3m = 15 m²/tree → 666.7 trees/ha → 15000/666.7=22.5 and 18000/666.7=27.0 kg/tree. Combined range across both spacings, rounded: [23, 43] kg/tree. This spread reflects the two different sourced spacings, not cultivar variation.
afrikaans_draft: OMGESKAKEL, berekening gewys: het die 'Average'-opbrengsband (15-18 t/ha) en dieselfde bron se gestelde spasiëring ('Generally planted 6m x 4m or 5 m x 3 m') geneem. Teen 6x4m = 24 m²/boom → 10000/24 = 416.7 bome/ha → 15000kg/416.7=36.0 en 18000kg/416.7=43.2 kg/boom. Teen 5x3m = 15 m²/boom → 666.7 bome/ha → 15000/666.7=22.5 en 18000/666.7=27.0 kg/boom. Gekombineerde reeks oor albei spasiërings, afgerond: [23, 43] kg/boom. Hierdie spreiding weerspieël die twee verskillende spasiërings uit die bron, nie kultivarvariasie nie.

key: Calculated orchard-average equivalent using the KZN guide's likely production of 50 t/ha and midpoint planting spacings: cool KZN Midlands, 5.75 x 2.75 m, about 79 kg/tree; hot areas, 7.5 x 3.5 m, about 131 kg/tree. Calculation: 50,000 kg/ha x m²/tree / 10,000 m²/ha. These values are derived, not measured individual-tree yields. The spread reflects spacing, not varieties or a production-by-age curve. Confirm local orchard yield and actual spacing before using this reference.
english: Calculated orchard-average equivalent using the KZN guide's likely production of 50 t/ha and midpoint planting spacings: cool KZN Midlands, 5.75 x 2.75 m, about 79 kg/tree; hot areas, 7.5 x 3.5 m, about 131 kg/tree. english: The Tour guide button brings the tips back. Closing a tip does not leave the sample farm. Read the page title when you move to another screen.

english: Some pages depend on your role. A page seen in a sample role does not mean your own account has access to it.

key: You can reopen the same document and explain how you recognised it.
english: You can reopen the same document and explain how you recognised it.
afrikaans_draft: Jy kan dieselfde dokument weer oopmaak en verduidelik hoe jy dit herken het.

afrikaans_draft: Stoor een keer → Lees die boodskap → Maak dieselfde item weer oop
