afrikaans_draft: Beteken dit dat die hele area rondom dit gereed is om as groentebeddingoppervlakte in 'n vooruitskatting gebruik te word?

key: Yes, use the whole parcel as growing area
english: Yes, use the whole parcel as growing area
afrikaans_draft: Ja, gebruik die hele perseel as groeiarea

key: A parcel may include a house, paths and unplanted land. Its area is not automatically the area of the beds.
english: A parcel may include a house, paths and unplanted land. Its area is not automatically the area of the beds.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Perseel kan 'n huis, paadjies en onbeplante grond insluit. Sy oppervlakte is nie outomaties die oppervlakte van die beddings nie.

key: Check the boundary and map the actual beds
english: Check the boundary and map the actual beds
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer die grens en karteer die werklike beddings

key: Yes. A pin locates the site, a boundary outlines land, and beds describe the growing area. Check which site and areas the forecast uses.
english: Yes. A pin locates the site, a boundary outlines land, and beds describe the growing area. Check which site and areas the forecast uses.
afrikaans_draft: Ja. 'n Speld bepaal die ligging van die terrein, 'n grens omlyn grond, en beddings beskryf die groeiarea. Kontroleer watter terrein en areas die vooruitskatting gebruik.

key: Add another pin to increase the area
english: Add another pin to increase the area
afrikaans_draft: Voeg nog 'n speld by om die oppervlakte te vergroot

key: Another pin does not measure more growing space. Reopen the correct place and check its mapped beds.
english: Another pin does not measure more growing space. Reopen the correct place and check its mapped beds.
afrikaans_draft: Nog 'n speld meet nie meer groeiruimte nie. Maak die regte plek weer oop en kontroleer sy gekarteerde beddings.

key: Keep the evidence beside the map
english: Keep the evidence beside the map
afrikaans_draft: Hou die bewyse langs die kaart

key: The sample uses prepared records. A completion badge shows recorded steps, not an independent check that a drawing or a financial forecast is accurate.
english: The sample uses prepared records. A completion badge shows recorded steps, not an independent check that a drawing or a financial forecast is accurate.
afrikaans_draft: Die voorbeeld gebruik voorbereide rekords. 'n Voltooiingskenteken wys aangetekende stappe, nie 'n onafhanklike kontrole dat 'n tekening of 'n finansiële vooruitskatting akkuraat is nie.

key: Now find and check your site
english: Now find and check your site
afrikaans_draft: Vind en kontroleer nou jou terrein

key: Open Map in your current workspace. Start with Places if the site is already saved. Use the sample tour above for practice.
english: Open Map in your current workspace. Start with Places if the site is already saved. Use the sample tour above for practice.
afrikaans_draft: Maak Kaart in jou huidige werkruimte oop. Begin met Plekke as die terrein reeds gestoor is. Gebruik die voorbeeldtoer hierbo om te oefen.

key: Make a plan you can check on the ground.
english: Make a plan you can check on the ground.
afrikaans_draft: Maak 'n plan wat jy op die grond kan nagaan.

key: Work through Design Studio, check a small edit and inspect the saved plan before using it.
english: Work through Design Studio, check a small edit and inspect the saved plan before using it.
afrikaans_draft: Werk deur Ontwerpateljee, kontroleer 'n klein wysiging en ondersoek die gestoorde plan voordat jy dit gebruik.

key: Illustration of two growers comparing a site sketch with their homestead garden
english: Illustration of two growers comparing a site sketch with their homestead garden
afrikaans_draft: Illustrasie van twee kwekers wat 'n terreinskets met hul opstaltuin vergelyk

key: A useful design connects the drawing with the land · illustrated example
english: A useful design connects the drawing with the land · illustrated example
afrikaans_draft: 'n Nuttige ontwerp verbind die tekening met die grond · geïllustreerde voorbeeld

key: Bring your site observations and measurements
english: Bring your site observations and measurements

key: Have the correct saved site, your field sketch and checked measurements ready. Keep a note of what already exists, what is proposed and what still needs measuring.
english: Have the correct saved site, your field sketch and checked measurements ready. Keep a note of what already exists, what is proposed and what still needs measuring.
afrikaans_draft: Hou die regte gestoorde terrein, jou veldskets en nagegaande metings gereed. Hou 'n nota van wat reeds bestaan, wat voorgestel word en wat nog gemeet moet word.

key: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Plan the growing season, then Try it now. Use that disposable design to learn the controls before editing your own farm.
english: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Plan the growing season, then Try it now. Use that disposable design to learn the controls before editing your own farm.
afrikaans_draft: Om te oefen, maak die voorbeeldtoer oop en kies Beplan die groeiseisoen, dan Probeer dit nou. Gebruik daardie weggooibare ontwerp om die kontroles te leer voordat jy jou eie plaas wysig.

key: Check the site and its base
english: Check the site and its base
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer die terrein en sy basis

key: Open the site’s Design Studio → Base
english: Open the site’s Design Studio → Base
afrikaans_draft: Maak die terrein se Ontwerpateljee oop → Basis

key: Check the site name and recognise the boundary and buildings. The sample tour starts on Planting; choose Base to review the starting information.
english: Check the site name and recognise the boundary and buildings. The sample tour starts on Planting; choose Base to review the starting information.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer die terreinnaam en herken die grens en geboue. Die voorbeeldtoer begin by Plant; kies Basis om die begininligting te hersien.

key: Compare the traced boundary, house and existing ground features with your field record. A satellite picture or a drawing is not a ground measurement. Keep uncertain dimensions marked for checking.
english: Compare the traced boundary, house and existing ground features with your field record. A satellite picture or a drawing is not a ground measurement. Keep uncertain dimensions marked for checking.
afrikaans_draft: Vergelyk die nagetrekte grens, huis en bestaande grondkenmerke met jou veldrekord. 'n Satellietfoto of 'n tekening is nie 'n grondmeting nie. Hou onseker afmetings gemerk vir nagaan.

key: Open the step guide when you need the next task. Do this selects the relevant tool. A tick shows that something has been drawn; it does not establish that its size or position is right.
english: Open the step guide when you need the next task. Do this selects the relevant tool. A tick shows that something has been drawn; it does not establish that its size or position is right.
afrikaans_draft: Maak die stapgids oop wanneer jy die volgende taak nodig het. Doen dit kies die tersaaklike gereedskap. 'n Regmerkie wys dat iets geteken is; dit bewys nie dat die grootte of posisie daarvan reg is nie.

key: You are working on the intended site and can identify existing features and missing information.
english: You are working on the intended site and can identify existing features and missing information.
afrikaans_draft: Jy werk aan die bedoelde terrein en kan bestaande kenmerke en ontbrekende inligting identifiseer.

key: Read the site before placing new work
english: Read the site before placing new work
afrikaans_draft: Lees die terrein voordat jy nuwe werk plaas

key: Sector → Read the source notes → Compare with your observations
english: Sector → Read the source notes → Compare with your observations
afrikaans_draft: Sektor → Lees die bronnotas → Vergelyk met jou waarnemings

key: Compare the display with what you have observed and recorded. Note a disagreement or an unknown instead of changing your field record to match the screen.
english: Compare the display with what you have observed and recorded. Note a disagreement or an unknown instead of changing your field record to match the screen.
afrikaans_draft: Vergelyk die skerm met wat jy waargeneem en aangeteken het. Noteer 'n verskil of 'n onbekende eerder as om jou veldrekord te verander om by die skerm te pas.

key: You can say which information was observed and which still needs checking on site.
english: You can say which information was observed and which still needs checking on site.
afrikaans_draft: Jy kan sê watter inligting waargeneem is en watter nog op die terrein nagegaan moet word.

key: Check how the parts work together: water access, paths, beds, trees and structures. Keep existing features distinguishable in your notes from work you have only proposed.
english: Check how the parts work together: water access, paths, beds, trees and structures. Keep existing features distinguishable in your notes from work you have only proposed.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer hoe die dele saamwerk: watertoegang, paadjies, beddings, bome en strukture. Hou bestaande kenmerke in jou notas onderskeibaar van werk wat jy net voorgestel het.

key: Each item has a reason and checked dimensions, or a clearly recorded question to resolve.
english: Each item has a reason and checked dimensions, or a clearly recorded question to resolve.
afrikaans_draft: Elke item het 'n rede en nagegaande afmetings, of 'n duidelik aangetekende vraag om op te los.

key: Planting → Select → Zoom in if needed → Move the item → Undo
english: Planting → Select → Zoom in if needed → Move the item → Undo
afrikaans_draft: Plant → Kies → Zoem in indien nodig → Skuif die item → Ontdoen

key: In the sample design, select a bed and read its width and height. Zoom in so the item and its handles are easy to distinguish. Drag the body to move it; edge or corner handles change its size.
english: In the sample design, select a bed and read its width and height. Zoom in so the item and its handles are easy to distinguish. Drag the body to move it; edge or corner handles change its size.
afrikaans_draft: Kies 'n bedding in die voorbeeldontwerp en lees sy breedte en hoogte. Zoem in sodat die item en sy handvatsels maklik onderskei kan word. Sleep die liggaam om dit te skuif; rand- of hoekhandvatsels verander sy grootte.

key: Check the result immediately. If you meant to move the bed but its width changed, choose Undo, confirm the original dimensions and try again at a larger zoom.
english: Check the result immediately. If you meant to move the bed but its width changed, choose Undo, confirm the original dimensions and try again at a larger zoom.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer die resultaat dadelik. As jy bedoel het om die bedding te skuif maar sy breedte het verander, kies Ontdoen, bevestig die oorspronklike afmetings en probeer weer met 'n groter zoem.

key: Use Undo to restore the practice edit. Check both the position and the dimensions. Redo repeats an undone edit; it is not a second copy. Fit map to view helps you see the whole site again.
english: Use Undo to restore the practice edit. Check both the position and the dimensions. Redo repeats an undone edit; it is not a second copy. Fit map to view helps you see the whole site again.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik Ontdoen om die oefenwysiging te herstel. Kontroleer sowel die posisie as die afmetings. Herdoen herhaal 'n ontdane wysiging; dit is nie 'n tweede kopie nie. Pas kaart in aansig help jou om die hele terrein weer te sien.

key: You can move an item deliberately and restore it without accidentally changing its dimensions.
english: You can move an item deliberately and restore it without accidentally changing its dimensions.
afrikaans_draft: Jy kan 'n item doelbewus skuif en dit herstel sonder om per ongeluk sy afmetings te verander.

key: Review the whole design and its save result
english: Review the whole design and its save result
afrikaans_draft: Hersien die hele ontwerp en sy stoorresultaat

key: Review brings the design layers into view together. Trace an ordinary route through the plan: reach the beds, fetch water and get to the structures. Check for overlaps and blocked access.
english: Review brings the design layers into view together. Trace an ordinary route through the plan: reach the beds, fetch water and get to the structures. Check for overlaps and blocked access.
afrikaans_draft: Hersien bring die ontwerplae saam in sig. Volg 'n gewone roete deur die plan: bereik die beddings, haal water en kom by die strukture. Kontroleer vir oorvleuelings en versperde toegang.

key: You have reviewed the intended version and can identify any save problem that remains.
english: You have reviewed the intended version and can identify any save problem that remains.
afrikaans_draft: Jy het die bedoelde weergawe hersien en kan enige stoorprobleem wat oorbly, identifiseer.

key: Make and inspect a plan sheet
english: Make and inspect a plan sheet

key: Glossy → Plan sheet → Underlay and labels → Design Map
english: Glossy → Plan sheet → Underlay and labels → Design Map
afrikaans_draft: Blink → Planblad → Onderlaag en etikette → Ontwerpkaart

key: Glossy opens Preview & Export. Choose the plan sheet you need, then its underlay, quality and label options. Choose Design Map to draw that sheet from the saved design.
english: Glossy opens Preview & Export. Choose the plan sheet you need, then its underlay, quality and label options. Choose Design Map to draw that sheet from the saved design.
afrikaans_draft: Blink maak Voorskou en uitvoer oop. Kies die planblad wat jy nodig het, dan sy onderlaag-, gehalte- en etiketopsies. Kies Ontwerpkaart om daardie blad uit die gestoorde ontwerp te teken.

key: Open the resulting map full screen. Check the site name, sheet title, boundary, positions, scale, legend and readable labels. Compare with the drawing and field record; an attractive picture is not evidence that a planned feature exists.
english: Open the resulting map full screen. Check the site name, sheet title, boundary, positions, scale, legend and readable labels. Compare with the drawing and field record; an attractive picture is not evidence that a planned feature exists.
afrikaans_draft: Maak die resulterende kaart in volskerm oop. Kontroleer die terreinnaam, bladtitel, grens, posisies, skaal, sleutel en leesbare etikette. Vergelyk met die tekening en veldrekord; 'n aantreklike prent is nie bewys dat 'n beplande kenmerk bestaan nie.

key: Check the saved-render date and version. A previously saved picture can show an earlier design. If you edit the design later, draw and inspect a new sheet before treating it as the current plan.
english: Check the saved-render date and version. A previously saved picture can show an earlier design. If you edit the design later, draw and inspect a new sheet before treating it as the current plan.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer die datum en weergawe van die gestoorde kaartbeeld. 'n Prent wat voorheen gestoor is, kan 'n vroeër ontwerp wys. As jy die ontwerp later wysig, teken en ondersoek 'n nuwe blad voordat jy dit as die huidige plan behandel.

key: The selected sheet is readable and represents the version you intend to discuss.
english: The selected sheet is readable and represents the version you intend to discuss.
afrikaans_draft: Die gekose blad is leesbaar en stel die weergawe voor wat jy wil bespreek.

key: Download the selected sheets and open the file
english: Download the selected sheets and open the file
afrikaans_draft: Laai die gekose blaaie af en maak die lêer oop

key: Select the saved sheet or sheets you want. Choose PDF for one document, or an available image format. Check the selection and quality before choosing Download.
english: Select the saved sheet or sheets you want. Choose PDF for one document, or an available image format. Check the selection and quality before choosing Download.
afrikaans_draft: Kies die gestoorde blad of blaaie wat jy wil hê. Kies PDF vir een dokument, of 'n beskikbare beeldformaat. Kontroleer die keuse en gehalte voordat jy Laai af kies.

key: Open the actual downloaded file. Inspect every page, including its title, legend, scale and any labels you need. A saved design, a saved rendered map and a downloaded document are different copies.
english: Open the actual downloaded file. Inspect every page, including its title, legend, scale and any labels you need. A saved design, a saved rendered map and a downloaded document are different copies.
afrikaans_draft: Maak die werklike afgelaaide lêer oop. Ondersoek elke bladsy, insluitend sy titel, sleutel, skaal en enige etikette wat jy nodig het. 'n Gestoorde ontwerp, 'n gestoorde gegenereerde kaart en 'n afgelaaide dokument is verskillende kopieë.

key: You have opened the right file and can explain what it contains and which design it represents.
english: You have opened the right file and can explain what it contains and which design it represents.
afrikaans_draft: Jy het die regte lêer oopgemaak en kan verduidelik wat dit bevat en watter ontwerp dit voorstel.

key: You meant to move a bed.
english: You meant to move a bed.
afrikaans_draft: Jy het bedoel om 'n bedding te skuif.

key: After dragging, its width has changed. What should you do?
english: After dragging, its width has changed. What should you do?
afrikaans_draft: Ná die sleep het sy breedte verander. Wat moet jy doen?

key: Keep it because the drawing looks tidy
english: Keep it because the drawing looks tidy
afrikaans_draft: Hou dit omdat die tekening netjies lyk

key: A tidy drawing does not justify a changed dimension. Check the edit against your intended plan.
english: A tidy drawing does not justify a changed dimension. Check the edit against your intended plan.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Netjiese tekening regverdig nie 'n veranderde afmeting nie. Kontroleer die wysiging teen jou bedoelde plan.

key: Undo, check the dimensions and move its body carefully
english: Undo, check the dimensions and move its body carefully
afrikaans_draft: Ontdoen, kontroleer die afmetings en skuif sy liggaam versigtig

key: Correct. Restore the original dimensions first. Zoom in and distinguish the body from the resize handles before trying again.
english: Correct. Restore the original dimensions first. Zoom in and distinguish the body from the resize handles before trying again.
afrikaans_draft: Korrek. Herstel eers die oorspronklike afmetings. Zoem in en onderskei die liggaam van die groottehandvatsels voordat jy weer probeer.

key: Change the field notes to match the screen
english: Change the field notes to match the screen
afrikaans_draft: Verander die veldnotas om by die skerm te pas

key: Check the design before acting on it
english: Check the design before acting on it
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer die ontwerp voordat jy daarop optree

key: Independent practice: in the sample farm, identify an existing feature and a proposed item. Move one bed, explain what changed, and restore it with Undo. Draw a Design Map, download one selected sheet and find its title and legend in the file.
english: Independent practice: in the sample farm, identify an existing feature and a proposed item. Move one bed, explain what changed, and restore it with Undo. Draw a Design Map, download one selected sheet and find its title and legend in the file.
afrikaans_draft: Onafhanklike oefening: identifiseer in die voorbeeldplaas 'n bestaande kenmerk en 'n voorgestelde item. Skuif een bedding, verduidelik wat verander het en herstel dit met Ontdoen. Teken 'n Ontwerpkaart, laai een gekose blad af en vind sy titel en sleutel in die lêer.

key: When the growing areas are checked, use the site’s Crop plan link to continue planning. Proposed plantings and forecast harvests remain plans until the real work is recorded.
english: When the growing areas are checked, use the site’s Crop plan link to continue planning. Proposed plantings and forecast harvests remain plans until the real work is recorded.
afrikaans_draft: Wanneer die groeiareas nagegaan is, gebruik die terrein se Gewasplan-skakel om voort te gaan met beplanning. Voorgestelde aanplantings en voorspelde oeste bly planne totdat die werklike werk aangeteken is.

key: Start with a site you recognise
english: Start with a site you recognise
afrikaans_draft: Begin met 'n terrein wat jy herken

key: Open Design Studio and choose the intended saved site. Use the sample tour first if you are practising.
english: Open Design Studio and choose the intended saved site. Use the sample tour first if you are practising.
afrikaans_draft: Maak Ontwerpateljee oop en kies die bedoelde gestoorde terrein. Gebruik eers die voorbeeldtoer as jy oefen.

key: Turn the map into a crop plan
english: Turn the map into a crop plan

key: Plan the growing work, then record what happens.
english: Plan the growing work, then record what happens.
afrikaans_draft: Beplan die groeiwerk en teken dan aan wat gebeur.

key: Check mapped beds, choose plantings and read the calendar without confusing a plan with a harvest.
english: Check mapped beds, choose plantings and read the calendar without confusing a plan with a harvest.
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer gekarteerde beddings, kies aanplantings en lees die kalender sonder om 'n plan met 'n oes te verwar.

key: Illustration of two growers checking a site sketch beside planted beds in a homestead garden
english: Illustration of two growers checking a site sketch beside planted beds in a homestead garden
afrikaans_draft: Illustrasie van twee kwekers wat 'n terreinskets langs geplante beddings in 'n opstaltuin nagaan

key: Check the growing space before planning the season · illustrated example
english: Check the growing space before planning the season · illustrated example
afrikaans_draft: Kontroleer die groeiruimte voordat jy die seisoen beplan · geïllustreerde voorbeeld

key: Have the site and growing areas ready
english: Have the site and growing areas ready
afrikaans_draft: Hou die terrein en groeiareas gereed

key: Bring your checked bed and plot measurements, what is already growing, seed-packet information and notes about available water. Keep unknown details as questions to resolve.
english: Bring your checked bed and plot measurements, what is already growing, seed-packet information and notes about available water. Keep unknown details as questions to resolve.
afrikaans_draft: Bring jou nagegaande bedding- en perseelmetings, wat reeds groei, saadpakkie-inligting en notas oor beskikbare water. Hou onbekende besonderhede as vrae om op te los.

key: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Plan the growing season. Open its crop plan. The prepared crops and dates are examples, not instructions for your own farm.
english: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Plan the growing season. Open its crop plan. The prepared crops and dates are examples, not instructions for your own farm.
afrikaans_draft: Om te oefen, maak die voorbeeldtoer oop en kies Beplan die groeiseisoen. Maak sy gewasplan oop. Die voorbereide gewasse en datums is voorbeelde, nie instruksies vir jou eie plaas nie.

key: Follow the correct site into its plan
english: Follow the correct site into its plan
afrikaans_draft: Volg die regte terrein na sy plan

key: Design Studio → Crop plan → Open the bed and plot count
english: Design Studio → Crop plan → Open the bed and plot count
afrikaans_draft: Ontwerpateljee → Gewasplan → Maak die bedding- en perseeltelling oop

key: Use Crop plan from the design you checked. Read where the beds come from. The site-specific link carries that design into the planner; another entry route may use the main saved site or ask you to choose a site.
english: Use Crop plan from the design you checked. Read where the beds come from. The site-specific link carries that design into the planner; another entry route may use the main saved site or ask you to choose a site.
afrikaans_draft: Gebruik Gewasplan vanuit die ontwerp wat jy nagegaan het. Lees waar die beddings vandaan kom. Die terreinspesifieke skakel dra daardie ontwerp na die beplanner oor; 'n ander toegangsroete kan die hoof- gestoorde terrein gebruik of jou vra om 'n terrein te kies.

key: Open the bed and plot count to see each area and width. Match these with the map and your measurements. The whole boundary area is not the same as usable growing space.
english: Open the bed and plot count to see each area and width. Match these with the map and your measurements. The whole boundary area is not the same as usable growing space.
afrikaans_draft: Maak die bedding- en perseeltelling oop om elke area en breedte te sien. Pas dit by die kaart en jou metings. Die hele grensoppervlakte is nie dieselfde as bruikbare groeiruimte nie.

key: The plan uses the intended site and growing areas, with uncertain measurements still identified.
english: The plan uses the intended site and growing areas, with uncertain measurements still identified.
afrikaans_draft: Die plan gebruik die bedoelde terrein en groeiareas, met onseker metings steeds aangedui.

key: Choose a new planting or edit the existing row
english: Choose a new planting or edit the existing row
afrikaans_draft: Kies 'n nuwe aanplanting of wysig die bestaande ry

key: + crop on the intended bed, or crop bar → Edit
english: + crop on the intended bed, or crop bar → Edit
afrikaans_draft: + gewas op die bedoelde bedding, of gewasbalk → Wysig

key: For a new planting, choose + crop on its actual bed or plot and select the crop. If the planting already appears, open its bar and choose Edit instead of adding it again.
english: For a new planting, choose + crop on its actual bed or plot and select the crop. If the planting already appears, open its bar and choose Edit instead of adding it again.
afrikaans_draft: Vir 'n nuwe aanplanting, kies + gewas op sy werklike bedding of perseel en kies die gewas. As die aanplanting reeds verskyn, maak sy balk oop en kies Wysig in plaas daarvan om dit weer by te voeg.

key: Choose This is already growing only when that describes the real crop. Planned sowing and a crop already in the ground are different records. Check any nursery or transplant information too.
english: Choose This is already growing only when that describes the real crop. Planned sowing and a crop already in the ground are different records. Check any nursery or transplant information too.
afrikaans_draft: Kies Dit groei reeds slegs wanneer dit die werklike gewas beskryf. Beplande saai en 'n gewas wat reeds in die grond is, is verskillende rekords. Kontroleer ook enige kwekery- of oorplantinligting.

key: You are adding one intended planting or editing its existing row, with its actual status clear.
english: You are adding one intended planting or editing its existing row, with its actual status clear.
afrikaans_draft: Jy voeg een bedoelde aanplanting by of wysig sy bestaande ry, met sy werklike status duidelik.

key: Sow month → How much of the bed? → Read the warnings
english: Sow month → How much of the bed? → Read the warnings
afrikaans_draft: Saaimaand → Hoeveel van die bedding? → Lees die waarskuwings

key: For a crop raised in trays, sowing and planting out happen at different times. Read the readiness window and planned transplant month. Check actual seedlings and the bed before planting out; update a delayed plan.
english: For a crop raised in trays, sowing and planting out happen at different times. Read the readiness window and planned transplant month. Check actual seedlings and the bed before planting out; update a delayed plan.
afrikaans_draft: Vir 'n gewas wat in bakke gekweek word, gebeur saai en uitplant op verskillende tye. Lees die gereedheidsvenster en beplande oorplantmaand. Kontroleer werklike saailinge en die bedding voordat jy uitplant; werk 'n vertraagde plan by.

key: The proposed timing and area are consistent with the bed, other crops and information you have checked.
english: The proposed timing and area are consistent with the bed, other crops and information you have checked.
afrikaans_draft: Die voorgestelde tydsberekening en oppervlakte stem ooreen met die bedding, ander gewasse en inligting wat jy nagegaan het.
Stoor, maak weer oop en oefen Ontdoen

key: Add to bed, Add as existing or Save changes → Reopen the crop bar
english: Add to bed, Add as existing or Save changes → Reopen the crop bar
afrikaans_draft: Voeg by bedding, Voeg by as bestaande of Stoor veranderinge → Maak die gewasbalk weer oop

key: In the sample plan, change one planned month, save and reopen it. Then choose Undo and reopen the row to confirm the original month returned. Keep your own planting evidence separately; the sample workspace resets on reload.

english: A learner moves an existing path on a base map to make room for a proposed bed. What information has been lost?
afrikaans_draft: 'n Leerder skuif 'n bestaande paadjie op 'n basiskaart om plek te maak vir 'n voorgestelde bedding. Watter inligting het verlore gegaan?

key: MAP-A is useful for discussion but lacks dimensions and verified orientation. The learner keeps its “not to scale” label and lists the measurements needed. They cannot claim a new bed fits simply because a small rectangle fits on the sketch.
english: MAP-A is useful for discussion but lacks dimensions and verified orientation. The learner keeps its “not to scale” label and lists the measurements needed. They cannot claim a new bed fits simply because a small rectangle fits on the sketch.
afrikaans_draft: MAP-A is nuttig vir bespreking maar het nie afmetings en geverifieerde oriëntasie nie. Die leerder hou sy “nie volgens skaal nie”-etiket en lys die metings wat nodig is. Hulle kan nie beweer dat 'n nuwe bedding pas net omdat 'n klein reghoek op die skets pas nie.

key: Make the existing-features map and a separate blank proposal sheet. Match each important feature to a note from D1.2. If measurement is unavailable, identify the missing measurement and the decision it prevents. For a real site, retain the original measurements when trying a new layout.
english: Make the existing-features map and a separate blank proposal sheet. Match each important feature to a note from D1.2. If measurement is unavailable, identify the missing measurement and the decision it prevents. For a real site, retain the original measurements when trying a new layout.
afrikaans_draft: Maak die kaart van bestaande kenmerke en 'n afsonderlike leë voorstelblad. Pas elke belangrike kenmerk by 'n nota uit D1.2. As meting nie beskikbaar is nie, identifiseer die ontbrekende meting en die besluit wat dit verhoed. Behou die oorspronklike metings vir 'n werklike terrein wanneer jy 'n nuwe uitleg probeer.

key: Existing and proposed features remain distinct; scale status, orientation status, units and source notes are explicit. Fit is not asserted without the relevant measurements.
english: Existing and proposed features remain distinct; scale status, orientation status, units and source notes are explicit. Fit is not asserted without the relevant measurements.
afrikaans_draft: Bestaande en voorgestelde kenmerke bly onderskeibaar; skaalstatus, oriëntasiestatus, eenhede en bronnotas is eksplisiet. Daar word nie beweer dat iets pas sonder die tersaaklike metings nie.

key: Can a neat exported map turn an estimated boundary into a surveyed one?
english: Can a neat exported map turn an estimated boundary into a surveyed one?
afrikaans_draft: Kan 'n netjiese uitgevoerde kaart 'n geskatte grens in 'n opgemete een verander?

key: no. **Reason:** export changes presentation, not the source or certainty of the boundary.
english: no. **Reason:** export changes presentation, not the source or certainty of the boundary.
afrikaans_draft: nee. **Rede:** uitvoer verander die aanbieding, nie die bron of sekerheid van die grens nie.

key: Mapping and design guides. Practise on a copy or sample first. Verify the saved feature and its measurements after editing; use Undo for an accidental edit rather than accepting a convenient distortion.
english: Mapping and design guides. Practise on a copy or sample first. Verify the saved feature and its measurements after editing; use Undo for an accidental edit rather than accepting a convenient distortion.
afrikaans_draft: Karterings- en ontwerpgidse. Oefen eers op 'n kopie of voorbeeld. Verifieer die gestoorde kenmerk en sy metings ná wysiging; gebruik Ontdoen vir 'n toevallige wysiging eerder as om 'n gerieflike verwringing te aanvaar.

key: One arrow follows a daily watering journey. Another marks a reported wind direction. Do they describe the same kind of information?
english: One arrow follows a daily watering journey. Another marks a reported wind direction. Do they describe the same kind of information?
afrikaans_draft: Een pyl volg 'n daaglikse natleiroete. 'n Ander merk 'n gerapporteerde windrigting. Beskryf hulle dieselfde soort inligting?

key: WALK-A shows containers carried to the existing patch. That supports investigating the care journey. The eastern shade snapshot and TALK-A's water report remain separate evidence. Neither gives enough information to declare a new growing position suitable.
english: WALK-A shows containers carried to the existing patch. That supports investigating the care journey. The eastern shade snapshot and TALK-A's water report remain separate evidence. Neither gives enough information to declare a new growing position suitable.
afrikaans_draft: WALK-A wys houers wat na die bestaande kol gedra word. Dit ondersteun 'n ondersoek na die versorgingsroete. Die momentopname van skadu in die ooste en TALK-A se waterverslag bly afsonderlike bewyse. Geeneen gee genoeg inligting om 'n nuwe groeiposisie geskik te verklaar nie.

key: On one overlay, draw actual care journeys and note their purpose and frequency from the household record. On another, show the relevant external influences and evidence sources. Name a place where two needs may conflict. Keep uncertain information visibly uncertain.
english: On one overlay, draw actual care journeys and note their purpose and frequency from the household record. On another, show the relevant external influences and evidence sources. Name a place where two needs may conflict. Keep uncertain information visibly uncertain.
afrikaans_draft: Teken op een oorleg werklike versorgingsroetes en noteer hul doel en frekwensie uit die huishouding se rekord. Wys op 'n ander die tersaaklike eksterne invloede en bewysbronne. Noem 'n plek waar twee behoeftes kan bots. Hou onseker inligting sigbaar onseker.

key: The learner explains the difference between a care journey and an external influence, uses site evidence, and identifies a placement trade-off.
english: The learner explains the difference between a care journey and an external influence, uses site evidence, and identifies a placement trade-off.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder verduidelik die verskil tussen 'n versorgingsroete en 'n eksterne invloed, gebruik terreinbewyse en identifiseer 'n afweging by plasing.

key: Must a small homestead contain all the zones to be a valid design?
english: Must a small homestead contain all the zones to be a valid design?
afrikaans_draft: Moet 'n klein opstal al die sones bevat om 'n geldige ontwerp te wees?

key: no. **Reason:** the tool helps organise real activities and care; the site and household determine what belongs there.
english: no. **Reason:** the tool helps organise real activities and care; the site and household determine what belongs there.
afrikaans_draft: nee. **Rede:** die hulpmiddel help om werklike aktiwiteite en versorging te organiseer; die terrein en huishouding bepaal wat daar hoort.

key: Design guide, Base and Sector stages. Adding an arrow is a way to record a claim, not a way to verify it.
english: Design guide, Base and Sector stages. Adding an arrow is a way to record a claim, not a way to verify it.
afrikaans_draft: Ontwerpgids, Basis- en Sektor-fases. Om 'n pyl by te voeg, is 'n manier om 'n bewering aan te teken, nie 'n manier om dit te verifieer nie.

key: The most convenient route to a proposed garden crosses a place where water is reported during heavy rain. What needs checking before choosing that layout?
english: The most convenient route to a proposed garden crosses a place where water is reported during heavy rain. What needs checking before choosing that layout?
afrikaans_draft: Die gerieflikste roete na 'n voorgestelde tuin kruis 'n plek waar water tydens swaar reën gerapporteer word. Wat moet nagegaan word voordat daardie uitleg gekies word?

key: Choose one proposed use. Trace the person's journey, the water it would need and the evidence about its location. List what is known, what could change seasonally, and what must be checked before implementation. Refer to the water, soil and seasonal modules for the technical questions.
english: Choose one proposed use. Trace the person's journey, the water it would need and the evidence about its location. List what is known, what could change seasonally, and what must be checked before implementation. Refer to the water, soil and seasonal modules for the technical questions.
afrikaans_draft: Kies een voorgestelde gebruik. Volg die persoon se roete, die water wat dit sou nodig hê en die bewyse oor die ligging daarvan. Lys wat bekend is, wat seisoenaal kan verander, en wat voor implementering nagegaan moet word. Verwys na die water-, grond- en seisoenmodules vir die tegniese vrae.

key: The learner connects access, care and environmental information without inventing a design threshold or treating an unresolved technical proposal as ready to build.
english: The learner connects access, care and environmental information without inventing a design threshold or treating an unresolved technical proposal as ready to build.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder verbind toegang, versorging en omgewingsinligting sonder om 'n ontwerpdrempel te versin of 'n onopgeloste tegniese voorstel as gereed om te bou te behandel.

key: “Put a new bed here” gives a location. “How can we grow food without blocking access or adding more care than we can manage?” gives a design question. Which helps compare options?
english: “Put a new bed here” gives a location. “How can we grow food without blocking access or adding more care than we can manage?” gives a design question. Which helps compare options?
afrikaans_draft: “Sit 'n nuwe bedding hier” gee 'n ligging. “Hoe kan ons kos verbou sonder om toegang te versper of meer versorging by te voeg as wat ons kan hanteer?” gee 'n ontwerpvraag. Watter een help om opsies te vergelyk?

key: The question becomes: “Can the existing patch work better while keeping the route usable?” The learner also keeps relocation and deferring expansion available for comparison. BRIEF-A supports manageable care; WALK-A supports the access concern; RESOURCES-A prevents a claim that expansion is affordable. None of these facts yet chooses the final layout.
english: The question becomes: “Can the existing patch work better while keeping the route usable?” The learner also keeps relocation and deferring expansion available for comparison. BRIEF-A supports manageable care; WALK-A supports the access concern; RESOURCES-A prevents a claim that expansion is affordable. None of these facts yet chooses the final layout.
afrikaans_draft: Die vraag word: “Kan die bestaande kol beter werk terwyl die roete bruikbaar bly?” Die leerder hou ook verskuiwing en die uitstel van uitbreiding beskikbaar vir vergelyking. BRIEF-A ondersteun hanteerbare versorging; WALK-A ondersteun die kommer oor toegang; RESOURCES-A verhoed 'n bewering dat uitbreiding bekostigbaar is. Geeneen van hierdie feite kies nog die finale uitleg nie.

key: Make a decision sheet with columns for the need, evidence reference, implication, possible responses and missing checks. Ask a partner to challenge a response: “What evidence would make you change your mind?” Keep the answer for the concept comparison in D3.
english: Make a decision sheet with columns for the need, evidence reference, implication, possible responses and missing checks. Ask a partner to challenge a response: “What evidence would make you change your mind?” Keep the answer for the concept comparison in D3.
afrikaans_draft: Maak 'n besluitblad met kolomme vir die behoefte, bewysverwysing, implikasie, moontlike reaksies en ontbrekende kontroles. Vra 'n maat om 'n reaksie uit te daag: “Watter bewyse sou jou van plan laat verander?” Hou die antwoord vir die konsepvergelyking in D3.

key: The learner traces a decision back to evidence, names a trade-off and a reason to revise. The facilitator asks for a fresh explanation if the learner only repeats a principle's name.
english: The learner traces a decision back to evidence, names a trade-off and a reason to revise. The facilitator asks for a fresh explanation if the learner only repeats a principle's name.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder volg 'n besluit terug na bewyse, noem 'n afweging en 'n rede om te hersien. Die fasiliteerder vra vir 'n nuwe verduideliking as die leerder net 'n beginsel se naam herhaal.

key: Is choosing the design with the most components a fair test of quality?
english: Is choosing the design with the most components a fair test of quality?
afrikaans_draft: Is om die ontwerp met die meeste komponente te kies 'n regverdige toets van gehalte?

key: no. **Reason:** the components must answer the brief and work together within the site's and household's limits.
english: no. **Reason:** the components must answer the brief and work together within the site's and household's limits.
afrikaans_draft: nee. **Rede:** die komponente moet die opdrag beantwoord en saamwerk binne die terrein en die huishouding se perke.

key: Evidence and design guides. The decision sheet can stay on paper with an exported map. It is the explanation of the plan, not an automatic result produced by the app.
english: Evidence and design guides. The decision sheet can stay on paper with an exported map. It is the explanation of the plan, not an automatic result produced by the app.
afrikaans_draft: Bewys- en ontwerpgidse. Die besluitblad kan op papier bly saam met 'n uitgevoerde kaart. Dit is die verduideliking van die plan, nie 'n outomatiese resultaat wat deur die app gelewer word nie.

key: Compost is placed beside a garden on a drawing. What would make that relationship useful in daily work?
english: Compost is placed beside a garden on a drawing. What would make that relationship useful in daily work?
afrikaans_draft: Kompos word op 'n tekening langs 'n tuin geplaas. Wat sou daardie verhouding in die daaglikse werk nuttig maak?

key: Draw the needs, outputs, journeys and responsible people for the elements in your brief. Circle an assumed connection and name the evidence needed to confirm it. Use the appropriate technical module before proposing a material's use.
english: Draw the needs, outputs, journeys and responsible people for the elements in your brief. Circle an assumed connection and name the evidence needed to confirm it. Use the appropriate technical module before proposing a material's use.
afrikaans_draft: Teken die behoeftes, uitsette, roetes en verantwoordelike mense vir die elemente in jou opdrag. Omkring 'n aangenome verbinding en noem die bewyse wat nodig is om dit te bevestig. Gebruik die gepaste tegniese module voordat jy die gebruik van 'n materiaal voorstel.

key: The learner explains a real connection, its care requirement and a possible conflict, without promising a closed or maintenance-free system.
english: The learner explains a real connection, its care requirement and a possible conflict, without promising a closed or maintenance-free system.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder verduidelik 'n werklike verbinding, die versorging wat dit vereis en 'n moontlike botsing, sonder om 'n geslote of onderhoudsvrye stelsel te belowe.

key: Does an arrow from animals to a garden prove that the garden needs no other fertility inputs?
english: Does an arrow from animals to a garden prove that the garden needs no other fertility inputs?
afrikaans_draft: Bewys 'n pyl van diere na 'n tuin dat die tuin geen ander vrugbaarheidsinsette nodig het nie?

key: no. **Reason:** amounts, suitability, losses, other inputs and crop requirements have not been established.
english: no. **Reason:** amounts, suitability, losses, other inputs and crop requirements have not been established.
afrikaans_draft: nee. **Rede:** hoeveelhede, geskiktheid, verliese, ander insette en gewasbehoeftes is nie vasgestel nie.

key: A learner has drawn one beautiful arrangement. What can they compare it with to decide whether it answers the brief well?
english: A learner has drawn one beautiful arrangement. What can they compare it with to decide whether it answers the brief well?
afrikaans_draft: 'n Leerder het een pragtige rangskikking geteken. Waarmee kan hulle dit vergelyk om te besluit of dit die opdrag goed beantwoord?

key: Draw alternative concepts on copies of the same base. Under each, write its intended benefit, likely burden, important unknown and what would rule it out. Ask a partner whether both options use the same evidence.
english: Draw alternative concepts on copies of the same base. Under each, write its intended benefit, likely burden, important unknown and what would rule it out. Ask a partner whether both options use the same evidence.
afrikaans_draft: Teken alternatiewe konsepte op kopieë van dieselfde basis. Skryf onder elkeen sy bedoelde voordeel, waarskynlike las, belangrike onbekende en wat dit sou uitsluit. Vra 'n maat of albei opsies dieselfde bewyse gebruik.

key: Alternatives differ meaningfully, preserve existing facts and are compared on equal assumptions. Sketches remain labelled as concepts rather than build-ready plans.
english: Alternatives differ meaningfully, preserve existing facts and are compared on equal assumptions. Sketches remain labelled as concepts rather than build-ready plans.
afrikaans_draft: Alternatiewe verskil betekenisvol, bewaar bestaande feite en word op gelyke aannames vergelyk. Sketse bly as konsepte gemerk eerder as planne wat gereed is om te bou.

key: One option looks better in a rendered picture. The other better preserves daily access. What should the decision record explain?
english: One option looks better in a rendered picture. The other better preserves daily access. What should the decision record explain?
afrikaans_draft: Een opsie lyk beter in 'n gegenereerde prent. Die ander behou daaglikse toegang beter. Wat moet die besluitrekord verduidelik?

key: Complete a comparison sheet: criterion, supporting evidence, implication for each option, remaining check and decision. Present the strongest argument for the option you did not choose. Then record the household's response.
english: Complete a comparison sheet: criterion, supporting evidence, implication for each option, remaining check and decision. Present the strongest argument for the option you did not choose. Then record the household's response.
afrikaans_draft: Voltooi 'n vergelykingsblad: kriterium, ondersteunende bewyse, implikasie vir elke opsie, oorblywende kontrole en besluit. Bied die sterkste argument aan vir die opsie wat jy nie gekies het nie. Teken dan die huishouding se reaksie aan.

key: The choice follows the brief and evidence, acknowledges a trade-off and specifies a reason to reconsider. A principle's name alone is not a justification.
english: The choice follows the brief and evidence, acknowledges a trade-off and specifies a reason to reconsider. A principle's name alone is not a justification.
afrikaans_draft: Die keuse volg die opdrag en bewyse, erken 'n afweging en spesifiseer 'n rede om te heroorweeg. 'n Beginsel se naam alleen is nie 'n regverdiging nie.

key: not without resolving that access requirement with the people affected. **Reason:** a numerical total or attractive illustration cannot erase a necessary condition.
english: not without resolving that access requirement with the people affected. **Reason:** a numerical total or attractive illustration cannot erase a necessary condition.
afrikaans_draft: nie sonder om daardie toegangsvereiste met die betrokke mense op te los nie. **Rede:** 'n numeriese totaal of aantreklike illustrasie kan nie 'n noodsaaklike voorwaarde uitwis nie.

key: A proposed bed fits on a sketch. What must be known before saying it fits on the ground?
english: A proposed bed fits on a sketch. What must be known before saying it fits on the ground?
afrikaans_draft: 'n Voorgestelde bedding pas op 'n skets. Wat moet bekend wees voordat jy sê dat dit op die grond pas?

key: MAP-A is not to scale. The busy-yard learner cannot yet prove that a new bed fits beside the route. They list the measurements needed and preserve the existing path. The correct next step is to obtain a suitable measured base, not shrink the path until the picture looks finished.
english: MAP-A is not to scale. The busy-yard learner cannot yet prove that a new bed fits beside the route. They list the measurements needed and preserve the existing path. The correct next step is to obtain a suitable measured base, not shrink the path until the picture looks finished.
afrikaans_draft: MAP-A is nie volgens skaal nie. Die besige-werf-leerder kan nog nie bewys dat 'n nuwe bedding langs die roete pas nie. Hulle lys die metings wat nodig is en bewaar die bestaande paadjie. Die regte volgende stap is om 'n geskikte gemete basis te kry, nie om die paadjie te verklein totdat die prent klaar lyk nie.

key: The learner uses consistent units, checks fit against evidence and refuses to claim missing dimensions. This task cannot be passed from the unmeasured busy-yard sketch alone.
english: The learner uses consistent units, checks fit against evidence and refuses to claim missing dimensions. This task cannot be passed from the unmeasured busy-yard sketch alone.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder gebruik konsekwente eenhede, kontroleer of iets pas teen bewyse en weier om ontbrekende afmetings te beweer. Hierdie taak kan nie met die ongemete besige-werf-skets alleen geslaag word nie.

key: Does zooming in on the app make an estimated distance more accurate?
english: Does zooming in on the app make an estimated distance more accurate?
afrikaans_draft: Maak inzoem op die app 'n geskatte afstand meer akkuraat?

key: no. **Reason:** zoom changes the view, not the measurement source.
english: no. **Reason:** zoom changes the view, not the measurement source.
afrikaans_draft: nee. **Rede:** zoem verander die aansig, nie die meetbron nie.

key: Every planned feature fits within the boundary. Is the whole plan ready to implement?
english: Every planned feature fits within the boundary. Is the whole plan ready to implement?
afrikaans_draft: Elke beplande kenmerk pas binne die grens. Is die hele plan gereed om te implementeer?

key: Walk through the proposed daily routine using the map. Mark a possible conflict, the evidence needed to resolve it and who should help. Check both normal use and a relevant disruption. Refer to the technical modules rather than supplying a guessed dimension or capacity.
english: Walk through the proposed daily routine using the map. Mark a possible conflict, the evidence needed to resolve it and who should help. Check both normal use and a relevant disruption. Refer to the technical modules rather than supplying a guessed dimension or capacity.
afrikaans_draft: Loop deur die voorgestelde daaglikse roetine met behulp van die kaart. Merk 'n moontlike botsing, die bewyse wat nodig is om dit op te los en wie moet help. Kontroleer sowel normale gebruik as 'n tersaaklike ontwrigting. Verwys na die tegniese modules eerder as om 'n geraaide afmeting of kapasiteit te verskaf.

key: The learner checks relationships and consequences, identifies an unresolved dependency and keeps the corresponding work conditional.
english: The learner checks relationships and consequences, identifies an unresolved dependency and keeps the corresponding work conditional.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder kontroleer verhoudings en gevolge, identifiseer 'n onopgeloste afhanklikheid en hou die ooreenstemmende werk voorwaardelik.

key: A map has beautiful plants but no distinction between existing and proposed features. What might the person doing the work misunderstand?
english: A map has beautiful plants but no distinction between existing and proposed features. What might the person doing the work misunderstand?
afrikaans_draft: 'n Kaart het pragtige plante maar geen onderskeid tussen bestaande en voorgestelde kenmerke nie. Wat kan die persoon wat die werk doen, verkeerd verstaan?

key: Give the plan to a partner without explaining it first. Ask them to identify what exists, what is proposed, where access runs and which work is still on hold. Record the confusion, revise the sheet and repeat the reading task.
english: Give the plan to a partner without explaining it first. Ask them to identify what exists, what is proposed, where access runs and which work is still on hold. Record the confusion, revise the sheet and repeat the reading task.
afrikaans_draft: Gee die plan aan 'n maat sonder om dit eers te verduidelik. Vra hulle om te identifiseer wat bestaan, wat voorgestel word, waar toegang loop en watter werk nog teruggehou word. Teken die verwarring aan, hersien die blad en herhaal die leestaak.

key: Another reader can correctly interpret the plan, and the learner has checked a real export. An export button being clicked is not sufficient.
english: Another reader can correctly interpret the plan, and the learner has checked a real export. An export button being clicked is not sufficient.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Ander leser kan die plan korrek interpreteer, en die leerder het 'n werklike uitvoer nagegaan. Om op 'n uitvoerknoppie te klik, is nie genoeg nie.

key: Is an AI illustration evidence that the saved plan contains the same geometry?
english: Is an AI illustration evidence that the saved plan contains the same geometry?
afrikaans_draft: Is 'n AI-illustrasie bewys dat die gestoorde plan dieselfde meetkunde bevat?

key: no. **Reason:** the illustration and measured plan have different evidential roles; inspect the actual plan and its sources.
english: no. **Reason:** the illustration and measured plan have different evidential roles; inspect the actual plan and its sources.
afrikaans_draft: nee. **Rede:** die illustrasie en die gemete plan het verskillende bewysrolle; ondersoek die werklike plan en sy bronne.

key: The busy-yard first phase begins with checking care capacity, access and the existing patch's conditions. Buying animals is outside scope. A new drainage intervention stays on hold. Improving the design record is real progress even before a physical change is justified.
english: The busy-yard first phase begins with checking care capacity, access and the existing patch's conditions. Buying animals is outside scope. A new drainage intervention stays on hold. Improving the design record is real progress even before a physical change is justified.
afrikaans_draft: Die besige-werf se eerste fase begin met die nagaan van versorgingskapasiteit, toegang en die toestande van die bestaande kol. Om diere te koop, val buite die omvang. 'n Nuwe dreineringsingryping word teruggehou. Om die ontwerprekord te verbeter, is werklike vordering selfs voordat 'n fisiese verandering geregverdig is.

key: Make an ordered list with an action, prerequisites, responsible person, readiness evidence and next review point. Ask a partner to find something that has been placed before its prerequisite. Correct the sequence and explain why.
english: Make an ordered list with an action, prerequisites, responsible person, readiness evidence and next review point. Ask a partner to find something that has been placed before its prerequisite. Correct the sequence and explain why.
afrikaans_draft: Maak 'n geordende lys met 'n aksie, voorvereistes, verantwoordelike persoon, bewyse van gereedheid en volgende hersieningspunt. Vra 'n maat om iets te vind wat voor sy voorvereiste geplaas is. Stel die volgorde reg en verduidelik waarom.

key: The learner identifies dependencies and a feasible first phase, rather than a calendar of unsupported promises.
english: The learner identifies dependencies and a feasible first phase, rather than a calendar of unsupported promises.
afrikaans_draft: Die leerder identifiseer afhanklikhede en 'n uitvoerbare eerste fase, eerder as 'n kalender van onondersteunde beloftes.

key: Is a proposed planting phase ready because the seedlings are available?
english: Is a proposed planting phase ready because the seedlings are available?
afrikaans_draft: Is 'n voorgestelde aanplantfase gereed omdat die saailinge beskikbaar is?

key: not from that fact alone. **Reason:** the destination, suitable conditions, resources and continuing care also need to be ready.
english: not from that fact alone. **Reason:** the destination, suitable conditions, resources and continuing care also need to be ready.
afrikaans_draft: nie op grond van daardie feit alleen nie. **Rede:** die bestemming, geskikte toestande, hulpbronne en deurlopende versorging moet ook gereed wees.

key: Should an unpriced item be entered as zero to make the total work?
english: Should an unpriced item be entered as zero to make the total work?
afrikaans_draft: Moet 'n item sonder 'n prys as nul ingevoer word om die totaal te laat werk?

key: no. **Reason:** zero states a known value; missing information requires a separate unknown and a follow-up action.
english: no. **Reason:** zero states a known value; missing information requires a separate unknown and a follow-up action.
afrikaans_draft: nee. **Rede:** nul stel 'n bekende waarde; ontbrekende inligting vereis 'n afsonderlike onbekende en 'n opvolgaksie.

key: The person carrying water in the busy-yard case helps review the care plan. The design does not assume they can take on extra work. If care capacity remains unknown, expansion stays conditional while the household tests its existing routine.
english: The person carrying water in the busy-yard case helps review the care plan. The design does not assume they can take on extra work. If care capacity remains unknown, expansion stays conditional while the household tests its existing routine.
afrikaans_draft: Die persoon wat in die besige-werf-geval water dra, help om die versorgingsplan te hersien. Die ontwerp neem nie aan dat hulle ekstra werk kan aanpak nie. As versorgingskapasiteit onbekend bly, bly uitbreiding voorwaardelik terwyl die huishouding sy bestaande roetine toets.

key: Make a care sheet with task, reason, responsible person, required resources, evidence-based timing or trigger, backup arrangement and record. Discuss a disruption with the household or practice partner and revise the proposal if its care cannot be supported.
english: Make a care sheet with task, reason, responsible person, required resources, evidence-based timing or trigger, backup arrangement and record. Discuss a disruption with the household or practice partner and revise the proposal if its care cannot be supported.
afrikaans_draft: Maak 'n versorgingsblad met taak, rede, verantwoordelike persoon, vereiste hulpbronne, bewysgebaseerde tydsberekening of sneller, rugsteunreëling en rekord. Bespreek 'n ontwrigting met die huishouding of oefenmaat en hersien die voorstel as sy versorging nie ondersteun kan word nie.

english: Plant certified seed potatoes and earth up the stems as they grow to prevent greening.

english: Cool, dry, well-ventilated storage at ambient 25-30°C — traditionally heaped corms under shade or covered with straw/plantain leaves.

english: Plant individual cloves pointy-side up; a cool spell early on helps bulbs form properly.

english: Well-cured bulbs (dried several weeks, dark/dry/ventilated), then kept unrefrigerated in a cool, dry, dark, well-ventilated place (e.g. mesh bags).
afrikaans_draft: Goed gekuurde bolle ('n paar weke gedroog, donker/droog/geventileer), dan buite die yskas gehou op 'n koel, droë, donker, goed geventileerde plek (bv. gaassakke).

key: Give climbing types a trellis; pick pods while still glossy for the sweetest peas.
english: Give climbing types a trellis; pick pods while still glossy for the sweetest peas.
afrikaans_draft: Gee rankende soorte 'n latwerk; pluk peule terwyl hulle nog blink is vir die soetste ertjies.

english: Harvest the central head before the flowers open, then side shoots keep coming.

english: main heads 1–2 weeks; side sprouts 3–4 weeks longer

english: A traditional leafy green (imbuya/thepe), not the grain amaranth grown elsewhere. DAFF's own spacing figures for this crop conflict with each other and its printed seed rate is too dense to be plausible for amaranth's tiny seed, so treat the spacing here as a starting point to confirm locally, not a verified field plan. english: A dual-purpose legume: young leaves (imifino) can be picked from three to four weeks after sowing, and dry grain follows later. No yield figure is given because the only South African trial found disagreed twenty-fold between its two sites. No named SA cultivars were found.

Geen opbrengsyfer word gegee nie, want die enigste Suid-Afrikaanse proef wat gevind is, het twintigvoudig tussen sy twee terreine verskil. Geen benoemde SA-kultivars is gevind nie.

english: A very fast root crop, ready in three to four weeks — good for filling gaps between slower crops. No published yield figure was found, so it stays manual and will not drive auto-suggest ranking. Brassicaceae family, same as cabbage and turnip.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Baie vinnige wortelgewas, gereed in drie tot vier weke — goed om gapings tussen stadiger gewasse te vul. Geen gepubliseerde opbrengsyfer is gevind nie, so dit bly handmatig en sal nie die rangorde van outomatiese voorstelle bepaal nie. Brassicaceae-familie, dieselfde as kool en raap.

english: A short-season legume grain grown for dry seed. No seed rate or yield figure was found in any sourced document, so it stays manual and will not drive auto-suggest ranking. The source's own row-spacing guidance is inconsistent (18cm in one place, 75cm-1.2m in another) — confirm locally before committing a full bed.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Kortseisoen-peulgraan wat vir droë saad gekweek word. key: Pod maturity is uneven; up to five successive hand-pickings are typical rather than one single harvest date.
english: Pod maturity is uneven; up to five successive hand-pickings are typical rather than one single harvest date.
afrikaans_draft: Peule word ongelyk ryp; tot vyf opeenvolgende plukrondes met die hand is tipies eerder as een enkele oesdatum.

english: An indigenous leafy green (Cleome gynandra), its own botanical family (not a Brassica despite the resemblance). DAFF states no South African cultivars have been developed yet and no yield figures are known, so it stays manual. Days-to-harvest is counted from seedling emergence in the source, not from sowing — treat the range as approximate.
afrikaans_draft: 'n Inheemse blaargroente (Cleome gynandra), in sy eie botaniese familie (nie 'n Brassica nie, ten spyte van die ooreenkoms). DAFF sê nog geen Suid-Afrikaanse kultivars is ontwikkel nie en geen opbrengsyfers is bekend nie, so dit bly handmatig. Dae tot oes word in die bron getel vanaf die opkoms van saailinge, nie vanaf saai nie — beskou die reeks as benaderd.

key: Menus, pop-ups and Lima now work fully from a keyboard and keep your place.
english: Menus, pop-ups and Lima now work fully from a keyboard and keep your place.
afrikaans_draft: Kieslyste, opspringvensters en Lima werk nou volledig met 'n sleutelbord en hou jou plek.

key: Turn AI glossy maps on or off in Settings. Saved maps stay available.
english: Turn AI glossy maps on or off in Settings. Saved maps stay available.
afrikaans_draft: Skakel AI-blinkkaarte aan of af in Instellings. Gestoorde kaarte bly beskikbaar.

key: The platform owner can enable or suspend AI maps for each organisation.
english: The platform owner can enable or suspend AI maps for each organisation.
afrikaans_draft: Die platformeienaar kan AI-kaarte vir elke organisasie aanskakel of opskort.
